Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Network Data Analyst to join our Network Data Insights and Analytics team. The role will evaluate log and alert data from network components globally, providing insights for proactive decision making. Leveraging advanced features of network monitoring tools, the role will produce meaningful reports and insights for IT and Business stakeholders. The role will partner with development teams in designing and producing network dashboards, reports, and presentation content for the Network Observability product line. The Network Data Analyst will partner with Capacity Planning, Network Monitoring, and Network Automation teams to ensure effective performance measurements of critical network components, such as routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other core network components.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a member of a development team for delivering executive dashboards end-to-end with actionable insights.

  • Be an energetic, approachable self-starter who is passionate about data, data mining, and AIOps network monitoring tools.

  • Subject matter generalist for network monitoring tools, leveraging tooling capabilities to expose opportunities and generate meaningful insights that influence decisions for network growth and enhancements.

  • Develop visually appealing and organized network analytics across different personas which include executives, product leaders and DevOps engineers.

  • Develop and implement proactive activities using automation, AIOps tools, performance management tools, and intelligent alerting mechanisms.

Professional Competencies:

  • Possess superior interpersonal and communication skills, writing clear and concise presentations and interfacing with peer, management, stakeholders and executives.

  • Possess desire to build powerful, simple, well-designed reporting services that will provide value to stakeholders.

  • Ability to coordinate work tasks with others for timely completion and to avoid potential setbacks.

  • Ability to articulate complex thoughts and ideas accurately and clearly, being able to quickly detect and correct instances of miscommunication.

  • Ability to adapt current work processes to meet emerging needs and the ability to evaluate new ideas and proposed methods for practicality and ease of implementation.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with data visualization tools including Tableau, Spotfire, Power BI, Grafana or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with two or more of the following network monitoring, reporting and observability tools: Sev-One, ThousandEyes, Moogsoft, Dynatrace, NetBrain, ELK.

  • Foundational level certifications in AIOps, Data Science, or similar.

  • Exposure to a large global network infrastructure of Routers, switches, LAN/SD-WAN, Firewalls, etc.

  • Experience in building actionable dashboards in any of the BI Platforms.

  • Exposure to SQL queries and it use in building dashboards and reports.

  • Exposure to one or more general purpose programming languages including but not limited to: Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.

  • Passionate about data and good data evangelist.

  • HS Diploma required.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can't be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Business Analyst to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. The qualified applicant will become part of Peraton's Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Infrastructure Managed Services (IMS) Program, for the US Coast Guard (CG). This initiative is modernizing and consolidating the operational environment under a common technology framework in order to better support the services provided to CGs customers This position is 100% remote. This position will review, analyze, and evaluate user needs to create systems solutions that support the overall business strategies. This position will also be responsible for documenting system requirements, defining scope and objectives and creating system specifications that drive system development and implementation.

Day to Day Work Responsibilities:

  • Provides Analysis functions and provides business area knowledge and technical expertise to team members engaged in the analysis, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of business information systems.
  • Provides business area and technical expertise to management and customers to facilitate planning, set direction, define business initiatives, and develop solutions to customer business information systems needs and requirements.
  • Assists the customer in the definition of business requirements, and their translation to information systems functions / features; establishes project objectives and identifies/quantifies benefits and develops business requirement documentation and coordinates system installation, evaluates existing systems and procedures, and recommends changes to management.
  • Meets regularly with customers to ensure timely and effective response to requests for service and high levels of customer.
  • Manage and create Change Requests (using ServiceNow), initiate Incident Management tickets.
  • Provide support for software releases and deployments.
  • Provide production level technical and business support when required due to various issues.

  • Bachelor's degree with 5 years relevant experience, master's degree with 3 years relevant experience or high school diploma/GED with 9 years relevant experience

  • Experience in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Previous experience and exposure to Web Services using JSON REST, testing using Junit

Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver.

Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable.

Position Summary

The HCB IT Delivery organization, within CVSH’s DDAT organization, is seeking a Technical Business Analyst to help realize the product features for a Conversational AI platform that is helping our members to get answers to their health insurance questions through the channel of their choice. In this role you will be responsible for helping to align features and user stories to the solution design. In this role you will have a holistic understanding of the application and serve as an expert on the end-to-end implementation of the application.

You will make an impact by:

  • Participating in feature refinement sessions with key stakeholders to ensure the specified needs are clearly articulated, identify gaps, and propose adjustments as needed.
  • Recommending technical solutions based on business requirements and prioritization.
  • Creating/proposing solutions for new features with considerations around scale and costs
  • Identifying data needs for use cases, partnering with Integration architects to map enterprise services to the user interface.
  • Designing logical navigation flows within the chat bot.
  • Creating/updating design documentation in Lucid.
  • Addressing issues/risks/dependencies in solution recommendations.
  • Supporting user onboarding, training, and adoption activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in a Business Analysts or Architect (preferably Business Architect) role
  • Ability to work Hybrid Model (in office Tuesday / Wednesday / Thursday)
  • Understanding of architecture patterns to enable scalable solutions for data management, BI, and analytics.
  • Deep understanding of data lifecycle management (operational databases, warehouses, integration and governance, pipelining, analytics enablement, and reporting)
  • Critical thinker, with the ability to make decisions on technology aligned to business needs for analytics and data engineering functions.
  • Highly motivated, independent worker with a pulse on industry trends and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a highly matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Business or Information Architect.
  • Understanding of data and analytics tools including Tableau, Alation, DataRobot, Trifacta.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science and engineering or STEM.

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$124,372.50 - $247,200.00


This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

In addition to your compensation, enjoy the rewards of an organization that puts our heart into caring for our colleagues and our communities. The Company offers a full range of medical, dental, and vision benefits. Eligible employees may enroll in the Company’s 401(k) retirement savings plan, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan is also available for eligible employees. The Company provides a fully-paid term life insurance plan to eligible employees, and short-term and long term disability benefits. CVS Health also offers numerous well-being programs, education assistance, free development courses, a CVS store discount, and discount programs with participating partners. As for time off, Company employees enjoy Paid Time Off (“PTO”) or vacation pay, as well as paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Number of paid holidays, sick time and other time off are provided consistent with relevant state law and Company policies.

For more detailed information on available benefits, please visit jobs.CVSHealth.com/benefits

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 08/26/2024

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

JOB SUMMARY (On-Site)

The Data Governance Analyst develops and implements data management strategies, policies, and processes to ensure accurate, complete, secure, and reliable system data. Works with departments to assist in resolving data quality problems and is a key driver of process improvement and efficiencies for data management. Provides useful tools and data analysis to drive the business forward by creating solutions for each departmental need.

FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Will independently identify data integrity issues and do the investigative work needed to understand the root cause and provide solutions.
  • Documents current processes and recommends new processes for collecting, modifying, and maintaining our data assets.
  • Guides and educates department data owners on data management initiatives and best practices.
  • Conducts data quality assessments and provides solutions to data owners.
  • Provides tools and guidance to data owners for cleaning historical data.
  • Works with IT on setting up automation and controls to ensure data integrity.
  • Develops user-friendly tools with controls for collecting manually entered data.
  • Monitors data quality metrics to ensure processes are being followed and to ensure the integrity of our data.
  • Creates all internal audit procedures and reporting to determine the best frequency to maintain data integrity.
  • Will work with PowerAutomate, PowerApps, Snowflake, Power BI and Zapier.
  • Manages user roles and permissions within JDE, Snowflake, and BI Dashboards.
  • Creates ad hoc reporting and data analysis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION/LICENSURE/CREDENTIALS

  • Bachelors degree in finance, computer science, information systems, or related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • 3 years of experience in data management, data governance, or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 3 years of experience using tools for automating workflows preferred (PowerAutomate, etc.)

SPECIAL KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS

  • Basic understanding of manufacturing and/or distribution processes
  • Working knowledge of data base concepts (Preferably JDE file structure)
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently
  • Strong work ethic supported by strong time management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple commitments and responsibilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong operational knowledge of business software
  • Ability to communicate effectively within all levels of the organization
  • Successful project management experience

The Hiller Companies, LLC has an immediate opening for Business Applications Analyst II.

Hiller offers fire protection and life safety products and services that are preserving lives and property all around the world. Headquartered in Mobile, Alabama, Hiller extends its reach globally as well as in domestic markets with offices across the United States. For more than 100 years, we have been laser-focused on one goal making the world a safer place. We are proud to be on the forefront of technology and innovation by creating adaptable safety solutions. As we continue to grow and expand our life safety footprint, we pledge to keep our customers top of mind while striving to design, install and service the most compliant, reliable systems available.

Job Summary: The Business Applications Analyst II is responsible for streamlining operational procedures and enhancing the assigned software system. Moreover, they play a key role in mentoring Business Applications Administrators and Analysts, sharing their expertise and providing guidance on challenging technical matters.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead the engagement with business stakeholders to understand needs, objectives, and pain points related to the assigned business software.
  • Conduct comprehensive analyses of existing processes, workflows, and data structures to identify areas for improvement and optimization.
  • Define and document clear and concise business requirements for the software, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with senior analysts, developers, and other teams to design and implement solutions that align with the identified business requirements.
  • Lead the creation of functional specifications, use cases, and other relevant documentation to guide the development and testing process.
  • Oversee the configuration and customization of the software to meet specific business needs.
  • Take ownership of project planning, execution, and monitoring of software-related initiatives, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgets.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including developers, quality assurance, and end-users, to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Provide leadership, supervision, and mentorship to junior team members, driving project success and professional growth.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans to validate the software's functionality, accuracy, and performance.
  • Collaborate with the development team to resolve any defects or issues found during testing, ensuring high-quality software deliverables.
  • Lead the development of training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users, facilitating a smooth transition to the new software system.
  • Ensure the maintenance of thorough and up-to-date documentation related to system functionalities, processes, and configurations.
  • Proactively monitor the performance of the software system, identifying opportunities for enhancements, optimizations, and innovative solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the organization, promoting a culture of innovation and excellence. Continuing education in fields that develop skills for the role is expected.
  • Provide expert-level user support, addressing complex queries and assisting with issue resolution to maximize software usage efficiency, focusing on issues related to fire life safety code requirements.
  • Collaborate with software vendors, as required, to address issues, manage software updates, and ensure compliance with service-level agreements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education, Licensure & Certifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related preferred.

Experience:

  • 3+ years experience as a Business Applications Analyst or in a related role, with a track record of successful software implementations in the service industry or a related domain.

Stryker is seeking to hire a Data Analyst, Digitalization to support Stryker’s Mako Robotic Assisted Surgery Operations in Weston, Florida.

Who We Want:

  • Analytical problem solvers. People who go beyond just fixing to identify root causes, evaluate optimal solutions, and recommend comprehensive upgrades to prevent future issues.
  • Curious learners. People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to be ready for what’s next.
  • Collaborative partners. People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, data and insights to drive continuous improvement in functions.
  • Self-directed initiators. People who take ownership of their work and need no prompting to drive productivity, change, and outcomes.

What you will do:

As the Data Analyst, Digitalization you will support the operations team in developing business analytics solutions. You will lead and execute on projects that support the digitalization of the operations processes.

  • Lead projects through the concept design, analysis and implementation of projects that provide new or enhanced technology solutions supporting the internal operations/functions of the company.
  • Leverage data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create visually engaging dashboards and reports that convey complex information to diverse audiences
  • Gather and use data and metrics to identify opportunities and drive process improvements.
  • Collaborate in close partnership with business leaders to design, develop, implement, and support applications and technologies.
  • Facilitate development discussions based on detailed functional and technical design specifications with both internal and outsourced teams.
  • Analyze data for patterns, trends, and anomalies to inform business strategies and initiatives
  • Assist in developing data-driven tactical and strategic guidance for business stakeholders
  • Work collaboratively with others to achieve business objectives using communication and diplomacy skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 4 years of experience in predominately analytics role or similar in supply chain and/or medical device industry

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong understanding of Data Analytics and Analytics Tools
  • Possess project management skillset to facilitate and manage projects
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Applications (PowerBi, SQL, etc.)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills
  • Strong ability to work with cross-functional teams
  • Self-motivated with excellent initiative and attention to detail

Overview:
GovCIO is hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst with a strong knowledge base in analyzing contractual commitments and concentrating on the logistical aspects of operations and knowledge of data visualization tools for strategic planning. This position will be a fully remote position within the United States with 10-25% travel. Core hours of operation are Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM ET.
Responsibilities:
  • Capture data and create customized reports and/or dashboards
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative data analysis and reporting of patterns, insights, and trends to leadership via dashboards and reports.
  • Analyze and use business intelligence tools that incorporate data from internal and external sources.
  • Use data and stakeholder requirements to solution and to improve business processes
  • Analyze contractual commitments, customer specifications, design changes, and other data to plan and develop logistic program activities from conceptual stage through life cycle of product
  • Collect, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources, including structured and unstructured data sets, to drive insights into logistics and data performance
  • Develop and implement program activities, collaborate with subcontractors, production departments, and field service personnel to ensure meeting of contractual commitments
  • Manage a small team, tasking them to grow toolset and capabilities within the contract
Qualifications:
Required Skills and Experience
  • Bachelors with 8+ years (or commensurate experience)
  • Analytical Thinking – Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis and the ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions
  • Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors; ability to effectively write/technical writing; and ability to understand and translate technical approaches and methodologies
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a vast array of personnel, distilling technical concepts to simple terms that are relevant to each audience
  • Must be able to work collaboratively with various stakeholder groups
  • Experience presenting to high level customer personnel
  • Ability to use project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, MS Teams, SharePoint, Power BI and capacity models
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance with Internal Revenue Service


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Advanced skill using business intelligence applications and/or cloud services
  • Advanced knowledge of reporting capabilities using power tools and software
  • Extensive attention to detail
  • Excellent time management

About TikTok U.S. Data Security
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. U.S. Data Security (“USDS”) is a subsidiary of TikTok in the U.S. This new, security-first division was created to bring heightened focus and governance to our data protection policies and content assurance protocols to keep U.S. users safe. Our focus is on providing oversight and protection of the TikTok platform and U.S. user data, so millions of Americans can continue turning to TikTok to learn something new, earn a living, express themselves creatively, or be entertained. The teams within USDS that deliver on this commitment daily span across Trust & Safety, Security & Privacy, Engineering, User & Product Ops, Corporate Functions and more.

Why Join Us
Creation is the core of TikTok's purpose. Our platform is built to help imaginations thrive. This is doubly true of the teams that make TikTok possible.
Together, we inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we all believe in and aim towards achieving every day.
To us, every challenge, no matter how difficult, is an opportunity; to learn, to innovate, and to grow as one team. Status quo? Never. Courage? Always.
At TikTok, we create together and grow together. That's how we drive impact - for ourselves, our company, and the communities we serve.
Join us.

The TikTok LIVE team's mission is to work hand-in-hand with creators & influencers, agencies, and partner organizations to create an environment that brings communities together in real-time to create meaningful and interactive connections around the globe.

In order to enhance collaboration and cross-functional partnerships, among other things, at this time, our organization follows a hybrid work schedule that requires employees to work in the office 3 days a week, or as directed by their manager/department. We regularly review our hybrid work model, and the specific requirements may change at any time.

Responsibilities
  • Conduct data analyses to highlight gaps in current workflows and surface next priorities in ecosystem
  • Lead data driven projects from end to end
  • Collaborate with Product, Trust&Safety, Ops, Policy, and other teams to ensure successful deployment of new ecosystem efforts
  • Provide data analytics to support internal and partner teams

  • BA/BS degree with 3-5 years of working experience
  • 2-3 years of experience in analytics, working with SQL or other data processing languages
  • 2-3 years of experience in leading data-driven projects
  • Effective written, verbal, and professional communication skills
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working on UCG or PGC products
  • Experience leading complex data-driven projects that involve multiple cross-functional teams
  • Experience in content quality and safety
  • Experience working in ambiguity, achieving results in a fast-paced environment, and continually adapting to changing business needs
Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or support.

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://shorturl.at/ktJP6

This role requires the ability to work with and support systems designed to protect sensitive data and information. As such, this role will be subject to strict national security-related screening.

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $101080 - $220611 annually.

​

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

​

Our company benefits are designed to convey company culture and values, to create an efficient and inspiring work environment, and to support our employees to give their best in both work and life. We offer the following benefits to eligible employees:

​

Overview:
PepsiCo operates in an environment undergoing immense and rapid change. Big-data and digital technologies are driving business transformation that is unlocking new capabilities and business innovations in areas like eCommerce, mobile experiences and IoT.

The key to winning in these areas is being able to leverage enterprise data foundations built on PepsiCo’s global business scale to enable business insights, advanced analytics and new product development. PepsiCo’s Data Management and Operations team is tasked with the responsibility of developing quality data collection processes, maintaining the integrity of our data foundations, and enabling business leaders and data scientists across the company to have rapid access to the data they need for decision-making and innovation.

What PepsiCo Data Management and Operations does:
  • Maintain a predictable, transparent, global operating rhythm that ensures always-on access to high-quality data for stakeholders across the company
  • Responsible for day-to-day data collection, transportation, maintenance/curation and access to the PepsiCo corporate data asset
  • Work cross-functionally across the enterprise to centralize data and standardize it for use by business, data science or other stakeholders
  • Increase awareness about available data and democratize access to it across the company
Job Description

As a member of the data engineering team, you will be the key domain expert overseeing PepsiCo's business process and drive a strong discussion for how Supply Chain, Financial, Consumer, Channel, Category business needs to be defined and prioritize by working very closely with business leads, data science team and data engineering team. You'll develop an in-depth understanding of business processes in and translate business requirements to data engineering team in technical way.
Responsibilities:
Accountabilities:
  • Discover, analyze, and scope data requirements & representing them in conceptual and logical data models

Company Description


At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better healthcare, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. At Northwestern Medicine, we pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, we take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?


Job Description


The Access Program Analyst reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Access Program Analyst, provides analytical and operations improvement support to the Manager of Access. This position facilitates data analysis, trends, supporting materials to lead improvement efforts in patient access to clinical services. The Business Analyst makes recommendations for improvement and participates in the implementation and ongoing monitoring of improvements pertaining to access strategies, improvements and goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather data using interviews, document analysis, surveys, site visits, business process description, workflow analysis, EDW reporting, Epic reporting, etc.
  • Critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, and abstract up from low-level information to a general understanding and recommendation
  • Proactively communicate and collaborate with external and internal customers to analyze information needs and functional requirements
  • Participate in new patient access goal development and implementation
  • Utilize data sources and analyze trends in provider and practice level access, volume and utilization data
  • Coordinate with regional partners to implement optimization tactics that drive master template changes, optimize new patient appointment availability and allow ease of scheduling
  • Collaborate with Epic IT team to monitor and evaluate questionnaire and template change requests
  • Establish ongoing meetings/touchpoints with Practice leadership to review access performance trends and identify opportunities.
  • Serve as a resource to practice leadership and access division leadership for access data analytics and performance improvement.
  • Utilize enterprise-wide requirements systems (EPIC, EDW, etc).
  • Successfully manage and engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Work independently with users to define concepts and under direction of managers.
  • Drive and challenge processes and operations assumptions of how they will successfully execute their plans.
  • Serve as the conduit between IT, departmental leadership, and Access staff.
  • Ability to create, monitor, and analyze data for forecasting projections, trend analysis, and decision-making purposes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by OC, Manager, and Director.

Qualifications


Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Strong analytical and project management skills

Preferred:

  • Master's degree
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated customer service skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Additional Information


Northwestern Medicine is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Are you looking for the opportunity to help the association continuously improve our processes and support departments in achieving organizational goals?

Horizon Farm Credit is actively seeking a Process Improvement Analyst to join our growing Process Improvement Group. One position available, qualified candidate may work in any available Horizon Farm Credit branch location. To view locations, click here Locations | Horizon Farm Credit . This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule after 6 months of successful employment. Candidate may work 3 days at home and 2 days in the office.

Overview: In this position, you will collaborate with executive leaders, process owners, project management, and technology teams to identify and discuss key business areas and processes that require improvement. You will be responsible for designing and implementing efficient workflows and procedures and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure successful process change.

Areas of responsibility include:

Identifying Areas for Improvement

  • Identify areas within the Association or department’s processes that can be improved.
  • Examine existing processes to improve productivity and efficiencies.
  • Conduct thorough evaluations and analyze data to gain insights for process improvements.
  • Identify and analyze business needs, conduct requirements gather, and define scope and objectives.

Analyze Data & Gathering Requirement for Process Enhancement

  • Perform data gathering, root cause analysis and performance trending in order to develop appropriate process changes.
  • Collect relevant information from multiple sources, such as databases, reports, and employee feedback.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements for enhancing the identified processes.

Collaborate with Stakeholders

  • Work closely with employees, managers, and leadership team to gain buy-in and support for the proposed improvements.
  • Communicate the benefits of change clearly, addressing any concerns during the transition.

Implement Process Change

  • Partner with executive leaders, process owners, project managers, and technology to ensure recommendations are implemented.
  • Develops methodology to measure the change and identify measures of success. Establishes Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of process improvements and track ongoing quantifiable gains from implementation

Build Culture of Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborates with full leadership team to inform of key aspects of process improvement methodology to build culture supportive of the process into muscle memory building standard work into the quality system.
  • Routinely works with frontline staff from various departments to understand current practices.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging best practices to continuously enhance the organization’s processes.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Education and/or experience equivalent to a Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • Generally, two to four or more years of experience in planning, implementation and evaluations of improvements is required.
  • Familiar with Lean/Six Sigma practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient interpersonal relations, organization, and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to managing multiple priorities effectively and efficiently with a high degree of accuracy to meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to initiate, organize and prioritize work and maintain confidentiality.
  • Adaptable and flexible to a changing work environment.
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Regular, predictable, and reliable attendance is required.

Who are we?

Horizon Farm Credit is an expert in agriculture, with over 100 years of serving rural America. As a premier rural lender, we're constantly growing and seeking new members for our team. As part of the Horizon Farm Credit team, you have the opportunity to make a difference for agriculture and rural communities.

What can we offer you?

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages for full-time employees including:

  • Medical insurance with dental and vision care options
  • 401 (k) with significant employer matching
  • Paid time off, holidays and volunteer time to support work/life balance
  • Tuition reimbursement and training opportunities
  • Student loan reimbursement
  • Leadership and career development opportunities
  • Paid maternity and bonding leave
  • Paid short term disability
  • Fun and inclusive work environment

Salary Range: $85,000 – $125,000, Depending on previous experience.

Equal Opportunity Employer including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Summary Of Position

The Operational Data Analyst manages company-wide databases related to various customer and regulatory reporting requirements. Develops and implements standardized optimized processes and improvements in company-wide data reporting which may include algorithm development. Analyzes various data and provides trend and variation reporting to internal customers. Compensation commensurate with experience. This position will be in Houston, Texas and reports to the Senior Vice President of Engineering and Planning.


Pilot Water Solutions (“PWS”) is the most reliable name in water midstream. PWS is a full service, full life cycle water midstream company with assets across the Permian, Eagle Ford, Rockies, Haynesville, and Appalachia. With strategically located assets in the core of its basins, Pilot Water Solutions is positioned to meet the needs of its customers with best-in-class service and reliability.?


Essential Job Requirements

  • Advanced data management skills
  • Expert with Excel and other data base management software
  • Proven ability to optimize data reporting and develop new processes.
  • Knowledge (or ability to quickly learn) of power usage calculations.
  • Knowledge of asset management software such as Maximo
  • Ability to develop algorithms.
  • Ability to use data analytical software such as Spotfire.
  • Proven collaboration skills with multiple internal groups
  • Documents all related job processes to ensure others can follow the workflow.
  • Provides back up support for production SCADA management.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree
  • Advanced database and data management software skills (SQL knowledge is a plus)
  • Ability to work with others on a team to accomplish established goals.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, maintain detailed and accurate records, and prepare clear and concise written reports.
  • Develop and maintenance processes and procedures.
  • Knowledge of Python coding

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of oil and gas, water management, and midstream industry experience
  • Bachelor of Data Engineering degree is a plus

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to sit, stand for long periods of time.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and be deemed insurable by the Company's insurance provider.
  • Must be able to lift a minimum of 15 lbs. on occasion to archive documents as needed.
  • May be required to speak frequently to respond to inquiries using a desk phone.
  • May require fine manipulation by hand for typing purpose.
  • Travel to Midland, TX as needed.

Equipment Used

  • Computer
  • Telephone
  • Copier/Fax/Scanner
  • Standard office supplies

Working Conditions

  • Works primarily indoors

This is responsible work eliciting, analyzing, identifying and validating the business needs of departmental operations, procedures, policies, work methods and organizational structures related to business processes. An incumbent in this classification conducts productivity analyses, operational analyses and other specialized field studies to determine the most effective and economical methods needed for performance of essential functions.
Work involves responsibility for proactively generating and compiling reports based on findings of studies and reviews. An employee in this classification develops recommendations to improve processes of existing operations or rather defines new processes. Integrates communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of Information Technology system investments and to assist in implementing new computer systems. Reports to a higher level administrator.

Essential Functions

Identifies strengths and weaknesses of department's information technology and business processes, and suggests strategies to improve.
Develops and documents functional specifications and decisions regarding projects requiring business process analysis.
Leads trials to implement or test newly developed and existing processes or applications.
Ensures issues are identified, tracked, reported on and resolved in a timely manner.
Works with department personnel to identify and record required changes.
Researches and benchmarks the effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes and formulates strategies to achieve quality and maintain efficiency.
Designs prototype for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow.
Formulates and implements quality assurance policies, procedures and methodologies and provides ongoing support to users.
Participates in the design, development, implementation, and support of information systems.
Works with the Information Technology Department and Technology vendors in: gathering requirements, conducting status meetings, creating / maintaining project issues & tasks, reviewing designs, developing test plans/scripts, testing, and implementation.
Prepares flow charts, graphs, comprehensive reports and presentations for management, as requested.
Conducts studies of departmental operations and management systems through analysis of organizational structure, information flow, records management, work methods, job descriptions, staffing patterns and functions.
Devises and designs business process requirements for all IT-related business, financial, and operations systems critical to core organizational functions. This includes researching and analyzing data in support of business functions, process knowledge, and systems requirements.
Takes input from key stakeholders and appropriately and accurately applies comments/feedback.
Assists in the facilitating communication between operating departments, IT Department, the project lead and vendors.
Creates change management plans.
Gathers issues, reviews processes, and analyzes data in order to determine the cause and effect of system issues.
Coordinates cross-divisional system and/or process issues and brings them to a successful completion and resolution.
Coordinates the department's software training, and may assist in training departmental users in regards to system changes and enhancements.
Serves as a liaison between everyday users and the IT Department.
Ensures that adequate business controls are in place and to provide day-to-day support and guidance to users.
Researches and benchmarks operations of other municipalities and private organizations, and
provides guidance to business clients regarding process and best practices.
Translates technical information into non-technical terms to achieve quality and maintain efficiency.
Identifies functional solutions necessary to address business objectives, needs and rules; designs and documentations system specifications including user interfaces, security and control, performance requirements and data conversion.
Uses information and expertise to recommend innovative integrated business solutions in accordance with citywide goals and objectives.
Performs other related duties as required.

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Public Administration, Business Administration, or related field and four (4) years of experience which must have included the review of business processes. Experience must demonstrate track record of working closely through the prototype and implementation phases of computerized information systems.

OR

Equivalent combination of education and experience beyond a high school diploma or its equivalent and one (1) year of the required experience.

Experience or certifications in specialized areas may be required depending on departmental needs.

Job Summary


It is an exciting time to join Cal State Fullerton as we are an in demand comprehensive University that is driven to shape the future of education and foster a vibrant community of diverse students, faculty, staff, and administrators who uphold values of inclusive excellence, free speech, and an environment free from discrimination. We are continuously seeking individuals from various career disciplines that share the University’s mission and core values. We warmly welcome you to consider joining the Titan Community where minds expand and opportunities flourish.

About the Position:

The Office of Institutional Effectiveness and Planning leads systematic and integrated efforts to examine the effectiveness of university programs, curricula, services and operations; provides meaningful data to support strategic planning and decision-making at all levels of the university; plays a critical role in demonstrating accountability to accreditation, external entities and the general public; fosters a campus-wide culture of data-informed decision-making, continuous improvement, and teaching and learning innovations. We seek an exceptional individual to join our team as the Senior Data Analyst (Associate, Academic and Institutional Studies II -Range A). The ideal candidate in this role should have a positive attitude and an active, energetic mind that is characterized by highly ethical practices and a commitment to diversity, openness, flexibility, integrity, and kindness.

The Senior Data Analyst performs a wide range of high-level research projects and data analytics in alignment with university priorities and strategic plan and contributes to building a culture of inquiry and data-informed decision making. Under minimal supervision, the Senior Data Analyst takes initiatives to conduct actionable research, innovate data analytics practices, tools, and technology, and performs data visualization or other data “storytelling” projects in the areas of institutional effectiveness, student success, enrollment management, quality assurance, and strategic decision-making. The Senior Data Analyst works both independently and in collaboration with staff at Office of Institutional Effectiveness and Planning on conducting analytical studies utilizing innovative and sound methodological design, and leads or contributes in the following areas: research design, data collection and cleaning, database creation, data analysis, analytical interpretation, and disseminating findings (via oral or written means) to university partners to facilitate decision-making and institutional effectiveness, all with very general direction or oversight by the Director of Institutional Research. The Senior Data Analyst responds, investigates, analyzes, and reports on data inquiries from university constituencies, completes external surveys and ad hoc requests, develops and maintains dashboards, and collaborates with team members to innovate analytics practices at the university. Other duties as assigned.


Essential Qualifications


Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university with four years of progressively responsible technical or professional analytical experience which demonstrates ability to conduct substantive studies of problems and issues in assigned areas. Demonstrates thorough knowledge of the techniques and treatment of data such as simple correlation methods, trend analysis, frequency distribution analysis, sampling techniques, hypothesis testing and methods of interval estimation. Demonstrates ability to reason logically and capacity for independent and creative thinking on research problems. Demonstrates skills in project management, research planning and design, data collection, analysis, report preparation and graphic presentation of results. Experience using qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, design, and techniques. Experience using statistical software (SAS, SPSS, etc.). Experience developing, organizing and maintaining relational database and/or data warehouse systems, preferably in a university environment. Computer skills including spreadsheets, word processing, and integrated database applications. Demonstrates ability to manage multiple tasks in a collaborative and transparent manner. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Sensitivity to issues of diversity in a university community. Ability to work well in a diverse, collegial and consultative team environment. Detail oriented and ability to prioritize and organize work to meet deadlines, and functions effectively in a high-pressure, outcome-driven environment, with minimal supervision. Ability to use judgment, discretion, and decision-making skills in dealing with confidential and sensitive issues.

A background check (including a criminal records check) must be completed satisfactorily and is required for employment. CSU will make a conditional offer of employment, which may be rescinded if the background check reveals disqualifying information, and/or it is discovered that the candidate knowingly withheld or falsified information. Failure to complete the background check satisfactorily may affect the continued employment of a current CSU employee who was conditionally offered the position.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree (MA, MS, MBA, MPA, Ed.D., Ph.D.) in the social sciences or another discipline from an accredited college or university that includes a heavy emphasis on statistical analysis, research methodology, information system, decision science, data mining, and computer applications. A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in research, evaluation, and data analysis in a higher education environment, preferably within a comprehensive university setting. Experience in use of web-based interfaces for data transfer. Ability to write SPSS syntax to produce analyses, or experience analyzing multiple large complex datasets, SQL, and Peoplesoft. Experience conducting mixed-method research (quantitative and qualitative) and distributing research findings at professional conferences. Experience developing Tableau Dashboards (or similar data visualization tools). Experience working with finance and budget data, Human Resource or workload data, and Peoplesoft database and applications. Mastery in use of Microsoft Office suite including the ability to import data/tables from other sources. Experience with the development, modification, and maintenance of websites. Experience in survey design and analysis. Proven teamwork skills in a fast-paced environment. Professional experience at a California State University campus.


License/Certifications


A Valid California Driver’s License.

Role description

Business Intelligence Analyst

Specialist I - Product Implementation


Who We Are:

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of over 39,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in over 30+ countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.


You Are:

The Business Intelligence Analyst provides user direction, analyzes data, and develops BI content for one or more functional units within client accordance with enterprise data governance processes. The BI Analyst also develops dashboards, dashboard components, metrics, and data pipelines. Responsibilities include analyzing and synthesizing information, and creating reports, presentations, and other materials. The BI Analyst creates reports and dashboards with tools such as Epic Slicer Dicer, Epic Workbench, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Reporting Services, and Power BI, and creates ad hoc SQL queries.


The Opportunity:

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and the marketing team. ensuring that the product contributes to the success of the customer.
  • Conduct and document pre-implementation process review of customer workflow.
  • Provide in- depth process reviews and ensure implementation of improved processes.
  • Consult with customer to identify and communicate hardware and software requirements prior to implementation.
  • Conduct training sessions with customers pre- and post-implementation.
  • Enable team collaboration working with cross-functional teams.
  • Manage implementation milestones and activities per project schedule.
  • Conduct presentations reviewing customer workflow to internal work groups in relation to the implementation.
  • Provide feedback to product managers utilizing customer feedback.
  • Deliver virtual and onsite training around product setup and best practices.
  • Provide professional implementation and support services to clients resulting in smooth, well-coordinated implementations
  • Consult customers to design and recommend solution architecture. Recommend configuration approach and design
  • Review customer deliverables

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.


What you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, or related field.
  • Preferred but not required: (will train the right candidate) Epic Cogito Certification:
  • Level 1: Less than 2 years of BI experience, no Epic certification.
  • Level 2: 2 years of BI experience, with or without Epic certification.
  • Level 3: 5 or more years of BI experience, with or without Epic certification.
  • Level 4: More than 5 years of combined experience with lead/supervisor responsibilities and Epic certified.
  • Experience analyzing data and creating reports.
  • Experience writing SQL queries.
  • Experience creating reports with tools such as Epic Slicer Dicer, Epic Workbench, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Reporting Services, and Power BI.
  • Ability to work with a computer terminal for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations.
  • Ability to work independently with little supervision.
  • Ability of solve problems
  • Excellent technical aptitude
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Flexible and effective in a team environment
  • Required Certification/Registration:
  • Must acquire Epic Cogito Certification within 12 months, 6 months is preferred.
  • Must acquire Epic Clinical Data Model Certification with 18 months.

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. As required by applicable law, UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $98,000-$148,000


Our full-time, regular associates are eligible for 401K matching, and vacation accrual and are covered from day 1 for paid sick time, healthcare, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance benefits.


What we believe:

We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone to champion diversity and inclusion, and to place people at the center of everything we do.

Humility:

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity:

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity:

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

UST reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance.

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

Do the best work of your career as a champion for small and mid-size businesses.

BILL is a leader in financial automation software for small and midsize businesses (SMBs). As a champion of SMBs, we are dedicated to automating the future of finance so businesses can thrive. Hundreds of thousands of businesses trust BILL solutions to manage financial workflows, including payables, receivables, and spend and expense management. With BILL, businesses are connected to a network of millions of members, so they can pay or get paid faster. Through our automated solutions, we help SMBs simplify and control their finances, so they can confidently manage their businesses, and succeed on their terms.

BILL is a trusted partner of leading U.S. financial institutions, accounting firms, and accounting software providers. We have operations in San Jose, CA, Draper, UT, Houston, TX and are continuing to expand into other geographic locations. If you’re looking for a place that helps you do the best work of your career, look no further than BILL.

Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company

Our Product Platform Analytics team is growing! We’re looking for a curious analyst to join us and contribute to shaping the future direction of the company. You will be joining the Intelligence Pillar, focusing on the strategic and intelligent use of data at BILL. Demonstrated thought leadership in solutioning with the product teams, data driven insight identification, and the ability to deliver business impact is highly desired. Part of this role is tactical; you’ll be responsible for driving self-serve capabilities, measuring impact of experiments and improving the data ecosystem. As a team we are curious, bring a learning mindset, and hold ourselves accountable.


List of Responsibilities/Duties:

  • Develop interactive dashboards that enable teams to analyze data and gain insights into customer behavior, product performance, and business trends.
  • Use your data visualization skills to tell clear stories that communicate insights
  • Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and secondary metrics to measure the impact of new products on customers
  • Promote a culture of experimentation and A/B testing to drive innovation and optimize product performance.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to product leadership, providing data-driven recommendations and helping to prioritize initiatives that drive outcomes rather than just outputs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams - such as marketing, sales, engineering, data warehousing - to ensure that our data is well architected, of high quality and reusable to help related teams move more quickly.

We’d love to chat if you have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science
  • 1+ years of experience in analytics and/or data science, with a demonstrated track record of using data to drive business impact
  • Proficiency in SQL; experience with data modeling (dbt) or Python a plus
  • Experience with data visualization tools, such as Tableau, to create compelling and insightful dashboards.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and/or design teams
  • The ability to translate technical results and insights into clear and compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

The estimated salary range for this role is noted below for our San Jose based role. Our ranges for each role and job level are based on a variety of factors including candidate experience, expertise, and geographic location and may vary from the amounts listed above. The role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, flexible spending & health savings account, paid holidays, paid time off, and other company benefits.

San Jose pay range
$95,700—$114,400 USD

Let’s talk about benefits

  • 100% paid employee health, dental, and vision plans (choose HMO, PPO, or HDHP)
  • HSA & FSA accounts
  • Life Insurance, Long & Short-term disability coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 11+ Observed holidays and wellness days and flexible time off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program with employee discounts
  • Wellness & Fitness initiatives
  • Employee recognition and referral programs
  • And much more

For positions that are in office we support a hybrid work environment with on-site and remote work days. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page for each location and discover BILL.

We live our culture and values every day

At BILL, we’re different by design—it's our culture. Our CEO is a trusted entrepreneur who lives our cultural values: Humble, Authentic, Passionate, Accountable, and Fun. People here love being their authentic selves, contributing unique experiences, sharing ideas, perspectives, and intellectual curiosity. We celebrate our diversity as the heart and soul of how we work, grow, and succeed together. Inspiring people with meaningful career experiences they love really does make the dream work and our successes just keep getting better. There’s no limit to what we can build and where we can go from here. We’d love you to join us.

BILL is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer where everyone is welcome. Our innovation and technology are inspired by an inclusive culture unlike any other. Everyone brings a different personal story and perspective and this diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, and experiences is where our greatest ideas come from. We welcome people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, abilities, genders, and sexual orientations to make us an even more vibrant company. We want everyone to bring their authentic selves here, to share our values, shape our vision, drive innovation, and become part of a culture we celebrate every day.

Our promise to our candidates is to be transparent, diligent, and engaging while guiding individuals through each step of our hiring process. At BILL we strive to achieve an inclusive and positive candidate experience that aligns with our core values and focuses on diversity.

If you require a reasonable accommodation for your application, interviews, or another aspect of the hiring process, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com.

BILL Culture:

  • Humble - We check our egos at the door. We are curious. We listen, accept feedback.
  • Authentic - We earn and show trust by being real—embracing our authentic selves.
  • Passionate - We care deeply about each other and our customers.
  • Accountable - We are duty-bound to each other, our customers, and society.
  • Fun - We wrap it all together by building connections and enjoying time spent together.

This position is fully grant-funded with a grant end date of August 31, 2025.


Classification: Admin/Prof

Exemption Status/Test: Exempt

Job Grade: 5

Department: Texas Education Exchange

Reports To: Director


Job Goal:

Provide data quality analysis to ensure that the data in/out that is used through the Texas Education Exchange Platform-as-a-Service is accurate and meets user requirements.


Qualifications:

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Math, Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology


Experience:

Three years of related work experience in the area of data quality analysis, preferably within the education sector


Special Knowledge and Skills:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience in data analysis and reporting utilizing the Ed-Fi Data Standard, preferred
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple projects, priorities, and meet deadlines with attention to detail
  • Proven experience in quality assurance tools and methodologies
  • Experience in developing new test processes for software and data products
  • Experience working with large volumes of data and testing data flow across multiple systems
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud services such as AWS and relational databases (SQL)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, etc.
  • Ability to document complex business and technical processes
  • Ability to collaborate with development teams, business partners, software engineers, and others stakeholders to enhance and improve data science and analytics principles and practices

Major Responsibilities:

  • Support our new data governance model and statistical plan strategy through research, collection of data elements, development and maintenance of the data dictionary and element tables, quality control, and reporting
  • Conduct data analysis for data in/out across the Texas Education Exchange platform to ensure data integrity for the platform and TSDS/PEIMS reporting requirements
  • Review submitted data to detect accuracy problems and anomalies and help development and software partners correct data, both current and historical
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including development and software partners, to ensure data integrity
  • Consult on data improvement solutions to enhance the products and services of the platform
  • Conduct user training, as needed
  • Assess requirements and provide feedback to enhance requirements for customized reporting to assist in and support the creation and maintenance of current and future use-case and product development
  • Provide technical assistance and services as specified by any applicable state grant that funds this position.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

None


Physical Demands/Environmental Factors/ Mental Demands:

Frequent use of standard office equipment; prolonged sitting; occasional bending/stooping, pushing/pulling, and twisting; repetitive hand motions (keyboarding and use of mouse); occasional light lifting and carrying (less than 15 pounds); may work prolonged and irregular hours; work with frequent interruptions; maintain emotional control under pressure.

raw_job_description:
Rhombus Power is purposefully transforming defense and global security enterprises with Guardian, our Artificial Intelligence platform for strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making at the speed of relevance.

We provide relevant, actionable, and AI-powered insights at each step in the defense decision-making cycle. Equipped with Guardian's AI-powered tools- from infrastructure to data to insights - our clients are able to solve their most complex, interconnected challenges and achieve decision and operational superiority.

Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions to transform global security.

Learn more about Rhombus and watch a demonstration of Guardian, our AI Platform here - https://youtube.com/watch?v=3PxY6su1Q-Q

See the following articles to learn more about what we do:

https://foreignpolicy.com/2023/06/19/ai-artificial-intelligence-national-security-foreign-policy-threats-prediction/

https://federalnewsnetwork.com/air-force/2023/12/new-decision-advantage-tool-will-change-how-air-force-makes-investment-decisions/

https://apnews.com/article/us-intelligence-services-ai-models-9471e8c5703306eb29f6c971b6923187

Location

Washington, DC - This position will be based onsite at our DC office.

Job Description

As a Strategic Intelligence Analyst (SIA) at Rhombus, you will work as a member of the Strategic Intelligence Team, which is part of our Analysis Department.

As an SIA, you will transform Rhombus Guardian's unique AI-derived raw data into meaningful and critical, single and all-source intelligence reports that help advance US national security. Our data is fused with regional, functional, technical expertise, and a myriad of open-source information.

Our SIA's regularly write and present briefs and reports to company executives and our clients. SIA's are expected to represent Rhombus internally and externally in intelligence-related matters, and build collaborative networks to showcase how our solutions help answer our customers' most difficult intelligence questions.

There is ample opportunity to grow within the Analysis Department, and we are currently hiring for a wide range of experience levels.

Responsibilities

  • Identify intelligence gaps, evaluate information from multiple sources (including Rhombus unique AI-derived data) monitor trends and interpret events related to geographies and/or issues.
  • Create, write, and publish single and all-source intelligence products that help answer our customer's most complex intelligence questions.
  • Discover, and analyze raw open-source data streams that compliment Rhombus' raw data or can help in solution development.
  • Conduct intelligence analysis on raw data using a myriad of open-source tools and proprietary approaches.
  • Brief finished all-source intelligence products.
  • Answer in oral and written format all intelligence-related tasking by the senior intelligence analyst, department heads, Vice President of Operations, and other senior Rhombus leaders.
  • Mentor junior intelligence analyst on writing, briefing, and analytical tradecraft.
  • Identify collection and data requirements.
  • Advance Rhombus' national security solutions (applications) by providing methodological improvements and fixes that drive product development.

Qualifications

  • At minimum, BA or BS in International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, or similar social science.
  • Experience with intelligence writing
  • Experience with producing (from raw to finished) all-source and single-source intelligence products, including graphics, is highly preferred.
  • Technical intelligence and data analysis skill sets including, geospatial analysis, Python, STATA, or R is highly desired.
  • Comfortable using and developing qualitative and quantitative analytical methodologies.
  • Experience providing briefings on highly complex national security topics is preferred, but not required.
  • We are seeking candidates that would be eligible for a DoD Secret or Top Secret (w/SCI) security clearance. If you currently hold a clearance, please indicate the level and sponsoring agency.
  • We're looking for candidates with proven analytical skills, are excited to solve problems, and have excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills.
  • SIA's are expected to plan work, be flexible under demand, and meet deadlines.

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental, vision coverage for employee and dependents
  • 401k matching program
  • PTO and Holidays
  • Bonus and other incentive programs
  • Access to mental health program
  • Access to Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care, Dependent and Commuter

About Rhombus

Rhombus Power Inc. (Rhombus) is a startup located in the heart of Silicon Valley at Stanford Research Park in Palo Alto. We use cutting-edge cross-disciplinary approaches to solve pressing Big Data and Sensing problems in security, energy, and healthcare. Our advisory board includes two Nobel Laureates and a Draper Prize winner.

Rhombus compensates, motivates, and develops employees, who are trusted, empowered, and involved. Employees have clear roles and expectations – and their roles are flexible enough to move at the speed of innovation in order to meet and exceed client expectations. We have a unique culture of global purpose, rooted in the innovation and progress of Silicon Valley.

Rhombus knows that diversity is a condition for success. We are committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.
