Cooley is seeking a CRM Business Analyst to join the IS Market Data Management team.
Position summary: Cooley Information Services (IS) embraces a culture of customer service excellence and all members of the department are expected to move this agenda forward. To that end, the CRM Business Analyst is expected to recognize that the Cooley IS department is a service organization first and foremost and will be evaluated on this requirement equal in importance to the technical or operational responsibilities outlined in this document.
Under the supervision of the CRM Services Manager, the CRM Business Analyst will be a driving force in optimizing our Salesforce platform to streamline processes and deliver data-driven insights. Your understanding of Sales Cloud, reporting expertise, and legal industry experience (or willingness to learn) will be crucial for supporting our business development, marketing, and operations teams. Specific duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
Position responsibilities:
  • Business Process Analysis: Collaborate with legal teams (e.g., business development, operations, marketing) to understand their business needs, challenges, and opportunities. Document, analyze, and map current business processes within the context of Salesforce capabilities
  • Requirements Gathering and Solution Design: Translate business needs into clear requirements that leverage standard Salesforce functionality, custom configurations, and potential integrations with legal-specific tools
  • Reporting and Analytics: Develop robust Salesforce dashboards and reports to provide actionable insights into business development performance, lead generation, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators
  • Backlog Management and Prioritization: Support the CRM Services Manager in maintaining the Salesforce product backlog. Collaborate to prioritize user stories, ensuring alignment with business objectives and value delivery
  • User Training and Support: Create user-friendly training guides and documentation. Conduct training sessions for new and existing users on Salesforce best practices and tailored workflows. Provide ongoing support to resolve user issues
  • Data Integrity: Maintain data accuracy in Salesforce, develop data cleansing processes, and implement data quality controls
  • Project Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, developers, and stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation of Salesforce initiatives and ongoing enhancements
  • All other duties as assigned or required

Skills and experience:
Required:
  • After orientation at Cooley LLP, exhibit proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, iManage and other firm applications
  • Available to work overtime, as required
  • 3+ years direct applicable experience (hands-on experience with Salesforce, preferably with a focus on Sales Cloud)
Preferred:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a business or technology-related field
  • Experience in a professional services or law firm environment
  • Salesforce Certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
  • Experience with Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot) is a plus
Competencies:
  • An understanding of the value of data and an eye for uncovering insights that will help drive business growth
  • Proficiency with data modeling, SOQL, object relationships, and other Salesforce data management concepts to ensure optimal data structure and reporting.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate with staff at all levels.
  • In-depth knowledge of Salesforce configuration, customization, process automation, and object modeling.
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Superior communication skills with the ability to engage legal professionals, business users, and technical teams.
  • Intellectual curiosity with the ability to derive connections and synthesize information and facts.
  • Ability to foster a culture of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to keep current with new developments, master new technologies, and adapt to change
Cooley offers a competitive compensation and excellent benefits package and is committed to fair and equitable employment practices. EOE.
The expected hourly pay range for this position with a work schedule of 40 hours per week is $38.50 - $56.50 ($80,080.00 - $117,520.00 annually). Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience and skillset of the candidate.
We offer a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD&D, long-term care coverage, backup care for children and/or adults and other parental support benefits. In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive firm-paid life insurance, AD&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as 20 days of Paid Time Off (“PTO”) and 10 paid holidays each year. We provide generous parental leave and fertility benefits. New employees will attend a detailed benefit orientation to learn more about our many benefits and resources.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Business Analyst plays a pivotal role in driving solution development and optimization across various business functions. Tasked with analyzing requirements throughout the solution lifecycle, they ensure seamless development, implementation, and performance of applications and systems. This role supports the Project Management Office and will serve as a liaison between the business and vendor, and technical aspects of assigned projects.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

May perform any or all of the following duties:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and IT teams to develop comprehensive requirements for process or system solutions, employing various methodologies. Document requirements meticulously to ensure traceability and assess the viability of proposed solutions.
  • Provide insights into evolving applications and systems, mapping current processes to desired future states. Identify gaps, opportunities for enhancement, and the impact of requirements on existing components.
  • Support solution design sessions, advocating for necessary data or services. Research and recommend third-party vendors when appropriate.
  • Assist in solution integration, acceptance testing, and post-implementation support, defining user acceptance criteria and coordinating training efforts.
  • Drive continuous process improvement by staying abreast of industry best practices and recommending enhancements aligned with business goals.
  • Demonstrate self-leadership, foster collaboration among stakeholders, and adapt to evolving responsibilities.
  • Participates in company meetings, webinars, and conference calls.
  • Other duties and/or special projects as assigned in response to changing business conditions and/or requirements.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS/CORE COMPETENCIES

§ Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, MIS, or related field (Additional equivalent work experience may be substituted for the degree requirement).

§ 5+ years’ experience working on and/or managing IT project(s) involving the implementation of SDLC project life cycle methodologies (Waterfall, Agile).

§ Experience working with back-of-house restaurant solutions involving both inventory and labor management solutions, as well as SQL skills to query, update or delete data is desired.

§ Experience implementing complex COTS (Commercial Off-the-Shelf), 3rd Party Vendor software preferred.

§ Experience managing a matrix team of associates, contractors and vendors with various skills and disciplines.

§ Ability to build relationships, influence and negotiate without authority across all levels of IT and business units.

§ Restaurant industry experience highly preferred.

§ Well organized with strong attention to detail.

§ Excellent analytical, logical thinking and problem-solving skills.

§ Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

§ Thorough understanding of project management principles and planning.

§ Thorough understanding of information technology procedures and practices.

§ Proficient with, or able to quickly become proficient with, a range of general and specialized applications, software, and hardware used in the organization and the industry.

§ Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software. Smartsheet experience preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Restaurant Support Center that is a fast-paced, high volume of activity and a deadline-driven environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Sitting for extended periods of time, using telephone, typing and/or operating a computer and/or mouse

This position is within Austin Energy’s Data Office. The Data Office is Austin Energy’s dedicated hub for advancing data management, analysis, and business intelligence strategies.

As a key component of our commitment to excellence, innovation, and operational efficiency, the Data Office plays a pivotal role in shaping the utility’s future through the strategic collection, secure storage, insightful analysis, and effective utilization of data.

The successful candidate will contribute their expertise and insights to further elevate Austin Energy’s data management capabilities and advance our organization’s data-driven initiatives.

Working with Austin Energy provides a number of health and welfare benefits such as low-cost medical, dental, vision, paid leave time, a highly competitive retirement plan, career development opportunities and more. Please click HERE for more information.

This position requires a criminal background investigation.

This position is classified as EXEMPT and may require to work additional hours outside of the normal schedule to include nights, weekends, and /or holidays.

If you are selected for this position and meet the Driver Safety Standards in the City of Austin Driver Safety Program, you may drive when necessary to multiple locations as part of your regular job duties. Otherwise, you are responsible for getting to and from these locations.

This has been designated as an Essential Employee position. In the event of a City-designated emergency, Essential Employees provide services that impact the public health, safety, utility services, and welfare of members of the Austin community and other employees and ensure the continuity of essential operations. $37.14 – $47.35 per hour.

External

Department
Austin Energy

Regular/Temporary
Regular

Grant Funded or Pooled Position
Not Applicable

Category
Technical

Location
4815 Mueller Blvd, Austin TX 78723

Preferred Qualifications
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Proficiency in designing / maintaining relational databases and systems.
  • Knowledge of data management architectures such as Data Lakes.
  • Knowledge of establishing quality expectations for central data stores.
  • Proficiency in statistical software and programming languages.
  • Skill in creating data visualizations and reports using BI analytics tools.
  • Ability to implement data collection and management techniques.
  • Experience leading data-related projects, providing guidance to others.
  • Skill in data modeling, database design tools such as Visio, SQL.

Other:
Ability to travel to more than one work location.

Duties, Functions and Responsibilities
Essential duties and functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include the following. Other related duties may be assigned.
  • Designs, creates, and maintains relational databases and data systems.
  • Collaborates with City IT analysts to identify data issues and prioritize improvements.
  • Informs solution design and improvements to meet data quality goals.
  • Leads and oversees data classification and data-mining activities to enable more accurate analysis.
  • Determines necessary actions required to generate and publishes open data on the City’s open data portal.
  • Creates data visualizations and reports to present to audiences using presentation tools.
  • Creates standards and patterns for data distribution and retention.
  • Implements statistical models to identify and reveal trends, patterns, and relationships in data to provide guidance to others for decision making processes.
  • Enables access to City and external data sources.
  • Suggests analytics opportunities and best practices.
  • Contributes to management of central data stores and metadata to establish quality expectations.
  • Identifies opportunities to increase data quality, including automation and data entry procedural training.
  • Creates and implements techniques for data collection, accuracy and management.

Responsibilities- Supervision and/or Leadership Exercised:
  • May provide leadership, work assignments, evaluation, training, and guidance to others.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Must possess required knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience and be able to explain and demonstrate, with or without reasonable accommodations, that the essential functions of the job can be performed.
  • Knowledge of data integration tools, data management architectures such as Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Data Hub Management, and data exploration techniques (binning, pivoting, summarizing, and finding correlations).
  • Knowledge of analytics, visualization and business intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of data structures, patterns and data models and related industry-standard methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Source-to-Target Mapping, Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) processing and Change Data Capture (CDC) concepts.
  • Knowledge of statistical software, database queries and programming languages (e.g., Java, C++, Scala, SQL, Hive, Python and R), XML, JSON and XSD’s.
  • Knowledge of Big Data concepts, frameworks, products, and tools.
  • Knowledge of data models and structures as well as database design tools (e.g., Visio, SQL, tec.)
  • Skill in data modeling, database and data management, SQL coding, data warehousing, reporting, data warehousing, relational databases, and data integrity skills.
  • Skill in data analysis, data visualization, data mining, reporting, and data integrity skills.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts with clients to increase their understanding of their operations.
  • Ability to consider and incorporate the implications of analysis into recommendations for business decisions.
  • Ability to see the big picture and make decisions based on strategy and value delivered.
  • Ability to turn data insights into recommendations for both clients and internal stakeholders based on context.
  • Ability to adhere to required compliance to all change management policies and procedures.
  • Ability to adhere to required compliance to all information security policies and procedures.


Criminal Background Investigation
This position has been approved for a Criminal Background Investigation.

US-OH-Fairfield
Description

Make a difference with a career in insurance

At The Cincinnati Insurance Companies, we put people first and apply the Golden Rule to our daily operations. To put this into action, we’re looking for extraordinary people to join our talented team. Our service-oriented, ethical, knowledgeable, caring associates are the heart of our vision to be the best company serving independent agents. We help protect families and businesses as they work to prevent or recover from a loss. Share your talents to help us reach for continued success as we bring value to the communities we serve and demonstrate that Actions Speak Louder in Person®.

If you’re ready to build productive relationships, collaborate within a diverse team, embrace challenges, and develop your skills, then Cincinnati may be the place for you. We offer career opportunities where you can contribute and grow.

Build your future with us

The Cincinnati Insurance Companies' Planning Analytics and Risk Management department has an open position of Associate Data Scientist – Innovation. This position will be based in our corporate headquarter in Fairfield, Ohio, reporting to the Director of Innovation and Research.

This newly formed innovation analytics team supports our strategic innovation across the company, covering commercial and personal line P&C insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance. The work may impact any stage of the insurance life cycle, ranging from agency relationship, marketing and risk selection, pricing, underwriting, loss control and risk mitigation, service and operation, retention, claims, and fraud. The team’s goal is to bring new data, analytics, and technology into the corporation to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the overall business. The team will also support the analytics need for any new insurance and reinsurance product.

Many departments at our headquarters in Fairfield, Ohio, offer hybrid work options, empowering associates to work from home several days a week. Depending on your role and responsibilities, hybrid options may be available for those working at headquarters.

Salary: The pay range for this position is $75,000 - $100,000 annually. The pay determination is based on the applicant’s education, experience, location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. Eligible associates may also receive an annual cash bonus and stock incentives based on company and individual performance.

Be ready to:

  • work very closely with various business teams depending on the fast-changing needs
  • learn the business and pain points from the domain experts
  • utilize analytics thinking and skills to identify possible solutions
  • develop prototypes together with business and IT that can make an impact to the business
  • massage and understand the data
  • design and build machine learning models
  • evaluate the model performance and develop practical cost benefit analysis
  • analyze operational process and build RPA tools (or search for available tools)
  • perform ad hoc data analyses and reporting

Be equipped with:

  • passion in numbers and quantitative analysis
  • knowledge and experience in deep learning (image segmentation and NLP experience preferred)
  • good coding skills
  • strong problem-solving skills and a forward-looking mindset
  • good people skills and excellent communication skills
  • knowledge in the insurance industry a big plus

Bring education and experience from:

  • a graduate level degree in a quantitative field such as math, physics, computer science, or economics; PhD preferred

Enhance your talents

Providing outstanding service and developing strong relationships with our independent agents are hallmarks of our company. Whether you have experience from another carrier or you’re new to the insurance industry, we promote a lifelong learning approach. Cincinnati provides you with the tools and training to be successful and to become a trusted, respected insurance professional – all while enjoying a meaningful career.

Enjoy benefits and amenities

Your commitment to providing strong service, sharing best practices, and creating solutions that impact lives is appreciated. To increase the well-being and satisfaction of our associates, we offer a variety of benefits and amenities.

Job Description:
The Global Client Group (GCG) leads Dimensional’s efforts to acquire long-term client relationships and increase the firm’s reach in the marketplace. Team members work closely with both institutions and financial advisors to offer focused, specialized support and ensure the delivery of a consistently impeccable client experience. Everyone is empowered to offer up and execute on innovative ways to produce results.
The Analyst, Business Insights will support sales data processes that are critical to the firm’s strategic sales efforts. Working with the global sales operations team, sales teams, and technology team, the analyst will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy of internal data systems related to client assets, cash flows, and CRM data. The daily work will involve processing incoming data from vendors, working with the sales teams to proactively maintain client data, and other related functions to support efficient data governance, sales operations, and reporting. The role falls within the GCG Sales Operations division, which supports the day-to-day operational needs of the sales group in the areas of business insights, product management, intermediary relationships, client onboarding, reporting and administrative services.
Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with sales teams to maintain critical client and asset data in various sales systems, including CRM and other internal reporting systems
  • Proactively identify data gaps and help eliminate data discrepancies across sales systems
  • Communicate data analysis and updates for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Help maintain and improve process maps and documentation regarding sales data governance
  • Help define requirements for business processes and projects involving customer data in Dynamics CRM and other internal systems, such as Dimensional’s client asset reporting system.
  • Partner closely with the technology team to assist with writing use cases and user acceptance testing.
  • Assist with developing business intelligence capabilities for enablement of US sales channels, which include RIAs, broker dealers, banks, institutions, retirement plans, and consultants.
  • Meet regularly with stakeholders to understand needs and develop professional working relationships within the GCG and other groups globally
  • Assist with data governance and ad hoc user requests
  • Identify areas to improve data automation and partner with colleagues to implement solutions
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree required; coursework in mathematics, statistics, information systems, computer science, or finance/accounting is preferred
  • 1-2 years’ experience in consulting, data analytics, business analysis, or similar role (includes internships)
  • Excellent computer skills (advanced Excel, querying data, working with databases, Visio or equivalents, and automation) with the ability to quickly learn and become proficient in new programs
  • Experience with CRM (especially Microsoft Dynamics), programming languages (Python, R) and/or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) a strong plus
  • Demonstrated interest in helping sales teams make process-driven, data-informed decisions
  • Proactive in nature, and capable of managing multiple projects and meeting deadlines
  • Documented analytical and quantitative skills; strong background with large data sets and the data analysis process
  • Ability to gather requirements amid ambiguity
  • Detail-oriented while maintaining a big picture focus
  • Ability to independently define and manage change within existing business processes
  • Interpersonal communication, verbal, and written skills; adept in explaining technical concepts to non-technical users
  • Work equally well in a team environment and independently

Data Analyst - WidePoint Integrated Solutions Corp. - Portsmouth/Norfolk, VA Hybrid Candidate must be able to commute to Portsmouth/Norfolk, VA

WidePoint Corporation (WYY) is a leading provider of wireless mobility management and cybersecurity solutions. We offer secure, cloud-based, enterprise-wide information technology-based solutions that enable enterprises and government agencies to deploy fully compliant IT services in accordance with government-mandated regulations and advanced system requirements.

We are looking for a highly motivated Data Analyst in the Portsmouth/Norfolk, VA area that can operate in a fast-paced and demanding environment of a micro-cap publicly-traded company.

Position Summary

The Data Analyst manages WidePoint data, develops reports, and troubleshoots data issues. In addition, the Analyst provides an in-depth analysis of potential savings of optimizations or the effect of changes to client policy, zero use Policy/International Policy, and makes recommendations and projects the impact of possible changes.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:
  • Supports the assigned client(s) in the management of the Cellular Wireless Managed Services (CWMS) program.
  • Providing support to the assigned client(s) end users in the procurement, management, and disposal of mobile cellular devices.
  • Interprets data, analyzes results using statistical techniques, and provides ongoing reports.
  • Identifies, analyzes, and interprets trends or patterns in complex data sets.
  • Provides an in-depth analysis of potential savings of optimizations or the effect of changes to client policy, zero use Policy/International Policy, and makes recommendations and projects the impact of possible changes.
  • Uses data to help identify problems or inefficiencies in end user support processes, and make recommendations to improve policies, processes, and procedures.
  • Update the SAMs Database with Final Eventing Returned Assets.
  • Update all new inventory stock to ServiceNow (SNOW).
  • Update the ECC Code for Service Now on all assets uploaded to Warehouse Inventory.
  • Responsible for onsite stock:
  • Tracking inventory levels to submit proper orders to Carrier and maintain the assigned client(s) approved stock levels.
  • Accessory stock (OtterBox cases) orders to maintain proper case inventory.
  • Works with management to prioritize business and information needs.
  • Locates and defines new process improvement opportunities.
  • Use data to support the assigned client(s) in:
  • The management and reporting of client property.
  • Developing, tracking, and maintaining a training program.
  • Drafting monthly newsletter highlighting program events or changes.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)
The minimum qualifications include:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or related field required.
  • Three (3) years of related experience is required.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Familiar with Microsoft SharePoint and MS Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively and work as part of a team.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and technical support skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to fifteen (15) pounds at times.

Note: This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other position-related instructions and to perform any other position-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this position successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will" relationship.

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

raw_job_description:
Join the Cleveland Clinic team, where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and provide patient-first healthcare. Cleveland Clinic is recognized as one of the top hospitals in the nation. At Cleveland Clinic, you will work alongside dedicated caregivers, receive endless support and appreciation, and build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

The Market Intelligence Analyst, will assists in the commercialization of a large portfolio of inventions by supporting market intelligence activities focused on assessing the viability of new medical technologies as part of a cross functional team. The primary focus of this position will be on biopharma therapeutics and diagnostic technologies.

The ideal caregiver is someone who:

  • Has three years of experience in one or more of the following areas: healthcare market research, financial analysis, business modeling, or technology commercialization. OR Advanced degree may offset up to 2 years' experience.

  • Is experience with healthcare industry and regulations and trends.

  • Has advanced data analytics capability (e.g. Excel, Access, SQL) is a plus.


This is a rewarding opportunity that offers growth-oriented projects, mentorship, support, and resources. You will experience great exposure to both the institute and department leadership and have numerous opportunities for career growth.


At Cleveland Clinic, we know what matters most. That's why we treat our caregivers as if they are our own family, and we are always creating ways to be there for you. Here, you'll find that we offer: resources to learn and grow, a fulfilling career for everyone, and comprehensive benefits that invest in your health, your physical and mental well-being and your future. When you join Cleveland Clinic, you'll be part of a supportive caregiver family that will be united in shared values and purpose to fulfill our promise of being the best place to receive care and the best place to work in healthcare.

Responsibilities:

  • Assists in the commercialization of a large portfolio of inventions by supporting market intelligence activities focused on assessing the viability of new medical technologies.
  • Conducts market research studies to provide timely and accurate information in the assessment of business opportunities across a large portfolio of intellectual property.
  • Collects, compiles and analyzes data from primary and secondary sources to construct procedure and product sales models, target market profiles, demographic and epidemiological models, competitive technology profiles, pricing and reimbursement analyses, and investment benchmark analyses.
  • Conducts prior art searches and patentability assessments.
  • Prepares reports, presentations and informational briefs to communicate market research findings and recommendations to internal and external clients.
  • Participates in strategic planning efforts and supports operational decision marking for portfolio technologies and companies.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Biomedical Engineering, Physical or Life Science, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.

Certifications:

  • None required.

Complexity of Work:

  • Requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgment, and the ability to work under limited supervision.
  • Necessitates understanding of specific needs and requirements to apply subject matter expertise.
  • Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action.

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires frequent sitting, normal or corrected vision and manual dexterity sufficient to perform work on a personal computer.
  • Requires the ability to walk to various locations to attend meetings.

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

Pay Range: $27.65 - $42.17 / hour

The pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the anticipated range for new hires. While the pay range is displayed as an hourly rate, Cleveland Clinic recruiters will clarify whether the compensation is hourly or salary. A successful candidate's actual compensation will be determined after taking factors into consideration such as the candidate's work history, experience, skill set, and education. This is not inclusive of the value of Cleveland Clinic's benefits package, which includes among other benefits, healthcare/dental/vision and retirement.

Introduction:
Welcome to Gallagher – a global leader in insurance, risk management, and consulting services. With a growing team of more than 45,000 professionals worldwide, we empower businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you can build a career whether it’s with our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team. Experience The Gallagher Way, a culture fueled by shared values and a collective passion for excellence. Join one of our dynamic teams, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping Gallagher's future and unlocking unparalleled opportunities for both clients and yourself.

We believe that every candidate brings something special to the table, including you! So, even if you feel that you’re close but not an exact match, we encourage you to apply.
How you'll make an impact:
  • Facilitates all necessary team meetings (sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews/retrospectives, etc.) to ensure cross-team collaboration and execution of the projects.
  • Reviews and stays on top of current and incoming projects from the Senior Digital Project Strategist to independently create project milestones for internal team reviews, materials for the kick-off, schedule kick-off and/or status meetings with the teams and coordinate required work between the teams to fulfill the project scope and timing expectations.
  • Manages all incoming and existing integrated projects from intake to release while keeping all parties informed of status, escalates conflicts and risks, including foreseeable delays, to appropriate stakeholders; communicates project priorities and due dates to the Digital teams and client stakeholders to set and meet expectations and ensure alignment of efforts and priorities.
  • Ensures coordination with our GTS team to ensure development needs are met within the project's timeline/sprints.
  • Enforces adherence to procedures and guidelines for workflow processes and deadlines ensuring standardized approach and delivery.
  • In coordination with Digital team leadership, collaborates on and maintains project management guidelines/best practices and process documentation with the goal of continuous improvement to the project management/agile process.
  • Coordinates and leads status updates internally for projects and maintains status reports with pertinent project metrics that are accessible to all teams involved.
  • Proactively escalates and addresses issues where timelines are in jeopardy or other information is needed for the team to proceed as scheduled to avoid project delays.
  • Maintains strong working relationship with the Senior Digital Project Strategist ensuring open lines of communication regarding project, requirements, issues, obstacles, and status.
  • Extensive experience with agile tracking software or project management systems including Smartsheets, Workfront, Trello, and Monday.com as the preferred technologies.
  • Prior project management experience and/or agile management experience managing multiple, multifaceted feature projects, agency experience preferred.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to work under tight deadlines while managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
About you:
Required:
  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of related experience required.
  • In-depth knowledge of the insurance brokerage business.
Highly Preferred:
  • BA (Bachelor of Arts) or BS in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 5-10 years relevant project management experience in a marketing or agency setting with a solid understanding of website digital projects necessary.

Compensation and benefits:

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:

  • Medical/dental/vision plans, which start from day one!
  • Life and accident insurance
  • 401(K) and Roth options
  • Tax-advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA)
  • Educational expense reimbursement
  • Paid parental leave

Other benefits include:

  • Digital mental health services (Talkspace)
  • Flexible work hours (availability varies by office and job function)
  • Training programs
  • Gallagher Thrive program – elevating your health through challenges, workshops and digital fitness programs for your overall wellbeing
  • Charitable matching gift program
  • And more...

We value inclusion and diversity

Click Here to review our U.S. Eligibility Requirements

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

raw_job_description:
What You'll Do:

Insights and Marketing Analytics at Criteo

Criteo is in search of a passionate, highly motivated Data Analyst to join our Insights & Marketing Analytics (IMAX) team in New York. The IMAX team is a specialized, global team of insights and analytics professionals located in New York and Barcelona. This global team is responsible for the insights that fuel Criteo-created content; the creation, execution, and analysis of customer, shopper, and marketer surveys; the analysis of Criteo’s own paid media; and the evangelization of data-driven methods and data storytelling across all of Criteo. While the IMAX team directly supports the needs of the global Marketing team, we also interface with commercially-facing teams (such as Sales and Account Strategy), with Criteo clients, and with the marketplace itself via conferences, via the press, and via industry influencers.

Your role at Criteo

You will be working closely with the global Marketing team to create the insights that fuel our message in the marketplace. You will own the analysis behind some of our most important pieces of recurring and ad-hoc thought leadership. You will see your work directly cited in the press, at industry conferences, and by our commercial teams. Examples of such work are available on our website.

You’ll work closely with the IMAX and Content teams to turn Criteo’s extraordinary commerce dataset into market-facing insights. You will also directly support Criteo’s in-house surveys of customers, shoppers, and marketers, on a global basis. You will create, launch, and maintain interactive tools using Tableau (or other technologies) that allow the broader set of global Criteo’s to access your work at scale.

The position combines traditional technical data analytics work, including the use of SQL, Excel, Hive, R/Python, with the “softer” part of data science storytelling with data.

This position involves dealing with a considerable amount of complex, real-world data and requires a candidate who is comfortable thinking of new and innovative ways to analyze data and solve problems. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about data storytelling and embrace the concept of the “full stack” data analytics professional as a career choice.

What you will be doing

  • Develop a deep knowledge of how to analyze trends across client, product groups, and verticals in all of Criteo’s global markets
  • Develop automations in Python to increase department efficiency and allow projects to scale
  • Understand how Criteo creates data across various data stores (Vertica / Hive / Presto). Serve as IMAX point person regarding the meaning of data and best practices around data access.
  • Contribute to new ways of using Criteo’s vast storehouse of data, including developing higher quality approaches to existing offerings as well as innovating to create new market-worthy content “from scratch.”
  • Create custom tables in databases to increase the quality of IMAX analysis. Support IMAX data for the global Criteo analytics community
  • Own and maintain reports/code in Tableau, Python or other relevant technologies
  • Liaise with other teams as needed, including non-IMAX Analytics, Product Marketing, Sales, and Account Strategy
  • Work with IMAX and Marketing team members to develop our strategic approach to content. Align our initiatives with Criteo’s overall direction and ensure that IMAX projects contribute to business results.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, etc.)
  • Strong interest in combining analytical/technical skills with softer/communication skills
  • Relevant work experience, with skills being more important that the specific industry
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and ability to structure and solve difficult problems with minimal supervision
  • Understanding of how to extract data from relational databases (i.e. SQL), including data which spans multiple tables
  • Interest in internet advertising and, more broadly, in Marketing as a discipline.
  • Strong experience with Python, in both the context of creating automation and using Python for data analysis and visualization.
  • Knowledge of business intelligence tools: Excel / Tableau / Looker a plus
  • Ability to engage in some international travel, including to Europe and the United States.

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

Criteo is the global commerce media company that enables marketers and media owners to deliver richer consumer experiences and drive better commerce outcomes through its industry leading Commerce Media Platform.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices around the world or from home, our incredible team of 3,600 Criteos collaborates to develop an open and inclusive environment. We seek to ensure that all of our workers are treated equally, and we do not tolerate discrimination based on race, gender identity, gender, sexual orientation, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, political opinion, pregnancy, migrant status, ethnicity, marital or family status, or other protected characteristics at all stages of the employment lifecycle including how we attract and recruit, through promotions, pay decisions, benefits, career progression and development. We aim to ensure employment decisions and actions are based solely on business-related considerations and not on protected characteristics. As outlined in our Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, we strictly forbid any kind of discrimination, harassment, mistreatment or bullying towards colleagues, clients, suppliers, stakeholders, shareholders, or any visitors of Criteo. All of this supports us in our mission to power the world’s marketers with trusted and impactful advertising encouraging discovery, innovation and choice in an open internet.

Why Join Us:

At Criteo, we take pride in being a caring culture and are committed to providing our employees with valuable benefits that support their physical, emotional and financial wellbeing, their interests and the important life events. We aim to create a place where people can grow and learn from each other while having a meaningful impact. We want to set you up for success in your job, and an important part of that includes comprehensive perks & benefits. Benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo. When determining compensation, we carefully consider a wide range of job-related factors, including experience, knowledge, skills, education, and location. These factors can cause your compensation to vary.

For employees based in the US, certain roles at Criteo are eligible for additional rewards, including quarterly or annual bonus and restricted stock units. US-based employees receive access to healthcare, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, family forming and wellness benefits, Flexible Work financial support, learning opportunities, and a robust annual leave plan including volunteer time off and summer vacation days.

The US base salary pay range for this position per year is:

$111,760 - $153,670

We’re looking for an experienced and practical Data Governance Analyst to help support the implementation and management of our data governance strategy. This role requires experience in data management, data governance frameworks, and prior global program management expertise. In this role, you will be supporting the privacy and data governance team in aligning and maintaining data policies, procedures, and standards across multiple business and support functions. You will work closely with the business units, engineering, procurement, information security, and human resources teams. raw_job_description:
The New York State Division of Criminal Justice Services is currently seeking to fill a full-time lead crime analyst position. The lead analyst will work on-site at the Southern Tier Crime Analysis Center in Binghamton, NY, under a staffing contract with The Finn Institute. The Center is staffed with a team of crime analysts and sworn law enforcement members who support area law enforcement agencies in their efforts to track and reduce Part I Crime.

Duties:

  • Supervise, direct, assign tasks, and evaluate performance of crime analysts who may be assigned to report to the Lead Analyst, when applicable.
  • Identify, organize, and complete projects that enhance overall Center operations, efficiencies, and services.
  • Review crime analysts’ and CAC operations to identify processes where efficiency can be improved.
  • Assist and coordinate analysts in the development of crime analysis products, bulletins, and pattern analysis.
  • Independently perform a variety of research and analytical tasks.
  • Collect, compile, validate, interpret, and analyze data and trends using standard practices and techniques of crime and/or law enforcement intelligence analysis.
  • Perform statistical, spatial, and/or qualitative analyses, making use of standard software packages.
  • Prepare and deliver reports and presentations of analytic results and may be required to testify in court proceedings.
  • Provide crime analysis and intelligence support to law enforcement as they respond to, investigate, and otherwise address criminal activity.
  • Flexibility to work evening/weekend shifts may be required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university in Criminal Justice, Criminology, or a related field, plus two (2) years' experience with Geographic Information Systems, crime analysis, database management, and related research; OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Geographic Information Systems, or a related field, plus two (2) years' experience in crime analysis, research, and interpretation of law enforcement data.

Compensation:

  • Starting salary $79,325.
  • Employer-subsidized health insurance in compliance with the Affordable Care Act, dental insurance, and life insurance.
  • Retirement plan [401(k)].
  • Twelve (12) paid holidays plus seventeen (17) leave days annually.

Interested parties should send a letter of interest and an up-to-date resume to Hiring Manager; materials may be sent via e-mail to contact@finninstitute.org. Review of applications will begin immediately and the position will remain open until filled. Questions may be directed to contact@finninstitute.org.

The Finn Institute is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

Minorities and women are strongly encouraged to apply.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $79,325.00 per year

Schedule:

  • 8 hour shift

Work Location: In person

You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.

With the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. When you join Team Amex, you become part of a global and diverse community of colleagues with an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities and each other. Here, you’ll learn and grow as we help you create a career journey that’s unique and meaningful to you with benefits, programs, and flexibility that support you personally and professionally.

At American Express, you’ll be recognized for your contributions, leadership, and impact—every colleague has the opportunity to share in the company’s success. Together, we’ll win as a team, striving to uphold our company values and powerful backing promise to provide the world’s best customer experience every day. And we’ll do it with the utmost integrity, and in an environment where everyone is seen, heard and feels like they belong.

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

The U.S. Consumer Services Team is responsible for our suite of consumer products, services, and experiences in the U.S., including our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Global Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, our Global Dining and Resy businesses, U.S. Consumer Banking, and best-in-class marketing programs across customer, prospect, and partner channels. The USCS team is focused on making membership an indisputable competitive advantage and helping each other become better leaders every day.

The objective of the US Consumer Control Management Governance team is to establish the Operational Risk and Controls strategy for US Consumer set up a foundational governance structure that ensures operational risks are identified, assessed, and managed in compliance with enterprise Operational Risk Management programs and reporting.

US Consumer Control Management is looking for an Analyst of Governance focused on ensuring control management is embedded in the day-to-day operations of our organization. It will involve extensive collaboration with multiple partners across numerous business units, functional areas, and geographies.

The Sr. Analyst, US Consumer Services Governance will:

  • Support Operational Risk Reporting and Analytics functions within Governance group for US Consumer Services business.

  • Track certain operational risk issues with KRI limits and risk appetite for US Consumer to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholds

  • Support the implementation of parts of the operational risk framework to enable effective risk management and decision making in the Business unit.

  • Assists in the development of portions of BU-specific procedures and additional standards (i.e., escalation protocols), related to the execution of the Operational Risk Management programs.

  • Support the ad hoc internal and external exam management process, working with
    the Enterprise functions (e.g., data request compilation)

  • Review processes to ensure and monitor the integration of regulatory changes & updates into the Operational Risk framework and training materials.

  • Assist to develop and issue basic level reporting “” to monitor the performance of risk management initiatives within Business unit.

  • Identify trends, themes, insights that indicate emerging operational risks by analyzing data and trends and share insights, better practices, themes, etc. across the enterprise.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ Years experience in operational risk management (e.g., within Risk and/or Internal Audit function) Understanding of critical operational risk management lifecycle activities.

  • Project management, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • Experience in process governance, with an understanding of processes that align with policies, regulatory frameworks, and/or operational standards.

  • Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to analyze data, identify trends, and evaluate risk scenarios effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business, Risk Mgmt., or related field; advanced degrees (e.g., MBA, MSc) or certifications are advantageous.

  • Experience in at least one of the following:

    • Translating operational risk strategy and programs into performance trends and themes

    • Developing compelling reporting materials and insights regarding risk management performance and adherence to guidelines and standards

    • Tracking and identifying issues with Key Risk Indicator (KRI) limits and risk appetite to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholds.

    • Performing or supporting an audit or review of operational processes, risks, and controls

  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, including extensive formula and pivot table creation.

  • Ability to take initiative and work within ambiguous situations. High degree of resourcefulness and the capacity to lead with a solution-based approach.

ORMCM

Salary Range: $55,000.00 to $105,000.00 annually + bonus + benefits

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

We back our colleagues and their loved ones with benefits and programs that support their holistic well-being. That means we prioritize their physical, financial, and mental health through each stage of life. Benefits include:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • 6% Company Match on retirement savings plan
  • Free financial coaching and financial well-being support
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • 20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

For a full list of Team Amex benefits, visit our Colleague Benefits Site.

We back our colleagues with the support they need to thrive, professionally and personally. That's why we have Amex Flex, our enterprise working model that provides greater flexibility to colleagues while ensuring we preserve the important aspects of our unique in-person culture. Depending on role and business needs, colleagues will either work onsite, in a hybrid model (combination of in-office and virtual days) or fully virtually.

raw_job_description:
• 5+ years of Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
  • 7+ years of SQL experience
  • Experience building measures and metrics, and developing reporting solutions
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
  • Passion for gaming
This position location may be flexible depending on candidate requirements.

Amazon is all-in on games, and our mission is to be the most customer-obsessed company in the games industry. At Amazon Games, we’re creating compelling games like New World, a sandbox MMO set on a supernatural continent, as well as several - as of yet - undisclosed titles. Amazon Games is also delivering great game benefits to Prime members each month via Prime Gaming, and providing game developers of all sizes with the tools they need to succeed with Amazon Game Tech

Amazon Games is looking for an experienced Game Data Analyst to help bring games to market and develop business opportunities for Amazon.

As a Senior Game Data Business Intelligence Engineer on our team, you will provide insight and drive key business and game initiatives. You will work closely with product manager, game designers, and leadership to analyze and find solutions to modern gaming challenges.

Key job responsibilities
  • Partner with Product Managers to understand players and define game and product goals.
  • Use analytical languages and tools like SQL, Redshift and Tableau to dive deep and answer customer questions.
  • Present descriptive and prescriptive metrics and analysis that empower partner teams to make smart decisions about our games.
  • Coach and empower partners, peers and teammates. Spread your skills and knowledge of game analytics to everyone around you.
  • Craft the right message for your audience. Explain complex concepts in language that technical and non-technical teammates will understand and act upon.
A day in the life
About Amazon Games

Amazon Games applies the principles of Amazonian culture to the world of game design. We have a diverse team of talented, creative people pairing their love of making games with the unique strengths that come with being part of Amazon. Across all of our teams and locations, we are united by a common purpose: to share great gaming experiences with customers around the world. We believe in a future where everyone is a gamer and everyone can create, compete, collaborate and connect through games, and we are looking for the right people to help us build that future. With the power of Twitch and AWS at your fingertips, you will have the chance to innovate in gameplay, creativity, marketing, and technology, while working alongside some of the smartest and most creative minds in the industry.

About the team
The Game Analytics BI team is a group of talented and collaborative analysts. Together with Data Engineering and Data Science we support Amazon's entire portfolio of live and upcoming games. We're gamers who love using data to understand "What's fun" and bring more of that to our players.

  • Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
  • Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.
  • Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

  • At least 4 years of combined experience in reporting, data management, process improvement with significant experience working with item master data management platforms and integrations.

Posting Details

Title
Senior Systems & Data Analyst

Posting Number
S01319JP

Department
Development Operations

Job Summary
The Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) Senior Systems and Data Analyst (SSDA) partners with DAR and College departments who utilize data from DAR’s Constituent Relationship Management (CRM) system and other DAR function-specific software applications in meeting fundraising and outreach/engagement objectives by providing system and data analytical, technical, and educational support for the storage, access, analysis, extraction and reporting of meaningful advancement information. The SSDA develops and maintains a data warehouse and utilizes various application data extraction tools and reporting platforms to provide highly-specific philanthropic financial, prospect, event, volunteer, relationship, biographical, membership, communication, and engagement reporting for a wide range of audiences and purposes.

Essential Functions:
  • Receives and manages a high-volume of deadline-critical data requests from DAR and College department staff.
  • Performs data extraction, manipulation, and validation/reconciliation, and builds reports using CRM application tools (query/export), data warehouse systems and MS databases (SQL, Excel, Access), and reporting platforms (Powerbi, Crystal Reports).
  • Partners with assigned ‘Primary Program Areas’ on cyclical and new initiatives to define the most effective and efficient use of system data and processes to track progress and drive strategic action.
  • Provides ongoing customer support and education of data and processes for DAR staff as well as sharing in the system, data and process ‘training’ required to onboard newer IS Analysts and assist/collaborate with projects.
  • Owns, designs, develops, and maintains the DARIS data warehouse for the purpose of efficient and flexible access to significant and consistent DAR data.
  • Produces operational reports and data extraction for both internal departments and external
    organizations that are required on a weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis.
  • Fully participates in the implementation of function-specific DAR (or College-wide) application systems, especially from the perspective of integration with the DAR CRM. Builds exports and imports for system customizations and integrations and validates data accuracy on a regular basis.

Education/Skills Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Solid understanding of relational database file structure, design and management concepts as they relate to application software systems. Strong data extraction, reporting, and validation skills using various tools with the ability to learn and adapt to new technical tools as they evolve. Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Access and SQL. Excellent analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Creative problem-solving skills. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to clearly document technical and operational processes. Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks at the same time cooperatively with others in a fast-paced environment
and under pressure of deadlines and interruptions. Sensitive to and accepting of confidentiality requirements.

Experience Requirements and/or Equivalents
Minimum of 7 years of information systems data analyst experience, preferably in a sophisticated academic fundraising environment and preferably with the Raiser’s Edge enterprise system (Raiser’s Edge certified if possible); extensive experience with query, export and report-writing software, preferably Crystal Reports; extensive experience requiring the use of Access and Excel; experience with accounting procedures; interest in and experience with training and working with people who have a wide range of computer skills.

Standard Work Days and Hours
Hours are primarily Monday through Friday; 8:30 am to 5:00 pm with occasional work after 5:00 pm or weekends. Minimal travel required. This is an exempt position requiring time commitment necessary to satisfactorily complete job requirements.

Benefits and Pay: (FT)
  • The salary range for this position is expected to be: $74,500- $81,500 .
  • A variety of health insurance plans (Medical, Vision, Dental)
  • Generous Retirement Plan – 10.12% annual compensation contribution (Eligible after 1 year of service and age 26)
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid time off – Vacation, Personal, Holidays, and Special Days Off Paid parental leave.
  • Free fitness and wellness classes!
  • And more: https://www.bowdoin.edu/hr/benefits-perks/index.html

About Bowdoin
Bowdoin embraces diversity in all forms, and the College is home to talented students, faculty and staff—with a variety of racial, ethnic, cultural, and socioeconomic backgrounds; religious beliefs; and gender identities, among other factors.

We encourage applications from candidates committed to the support of an inclusive campus community and those who will enrich and contribute to the College’s multifaceted diversity. We value a community in which individuals of all backgrounds are warmly welcomed and encouraged to succeed.

Founded in 1794, Bowdoin has maintained its commitment to the liberal arts for well over 200 years. Bowdoin’s reputation as a preeminent liberal arts college rests on the excellence of its faculty, students, and staff; intimate size; strong sense of community; and connections to the people, history, and natural beauty of Maine.

Bowdoin’s campus is situated in a beautiful natural setting. Located in Brunswick, Maine, a town of approximately 20,000, the College is a short drive from the Maine coast, twenty-five miles from Portland and 120 miles from Boston.

Administrative Staff + Credit

No

No

No

Internal/External

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person at an AlixPartners office on Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursday and remote working options for Monday and Friday.

Location: Southfield, MI

What you'll do

In this role within Strategic Finance, the Senior Data Analyst, within the Technology and Data team, will work with financial and operational data to create insightful reports and dashboards, enabling business decision-making and supporting our global strategy. The incumbent will take ownership of projects and work with team members to deliver solutions that meet the needs of internal functions and leadership of the Firm.

The ideal candidate will have a solid data foundation with experience in data analysis, data transformation, modeling, and visualizations with an appetite for continuous learning and development. This role is an exciting opportunity to join an accomplished and professional organization with a sustained track record of growth, development and innovation. Your career here is yours to own and grow alongside the Firm.

The Strategic Finance Senior Data Analyst is a full-time role reporting to the Strategic Finance Technology and Data Director and located in Southfield, MI. Paid relocation is not available.

  • Translate business requirements into clear, accurate and actionable design/implementation plans.
  • Create models, specifications, workflows and diagrams that contributes to the successful delivery of data analytics solutions and technology.
  • Develop semantic models, analytical models, reports, dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI and other tools in alignment to business requirements.
  • Collaborate with IT and other functions in the firm throughout the development lifecycle; enforcing best practices and refining requirements where necessary.
  • Provide support of existing solutions and services provided by the Strategic Finance Data and Technology team.
  • Test and validate deliverables for completeness and data accuracy
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues. Collaborate with business functions and team members to determine root cause and propose appropriate functional solutions.
  • Additional responsibilities as identified. This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties, or responsibilities.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Finance, Data Science, Statistics or related field preferred but may consider relevant work experience in lieu of education.
  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience designing and developing dashboards and reports; 1 year using Power BI.
  • Experience in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), and M Query; certification in Power BI is preferred.
  • Solid understanding of security models in Power BI and the ability to implement row level restrictions.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with relational and non-relational databases. Experience with SQL scripting is a must. Experience with R and Python is preferred.
  • Prior experience with financial or operational data analysis in a consulting or professional services firm is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet delivery commitments while maintaining accuracy.
  • Exceptional customer service skills, including the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of customers.
  • Solid understanding and proven experience in requirements definition and management techniques including business process, use case, workflow, and data modelling.
  • Proven analytical thinking for translating data into informative visuals and reports
  • An appetite for continuous learning and development.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Core working hours are generally 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM, Monday - Friday; willingness to work outside of normal U.S. business hours, and as unique projects/needs arise.
  • Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
  • Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners' Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States. No VISA sponsorship available for this position.

The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy including vacation/personal time starting at 7.34 hours per pay period, sick time up to 80 hours annually, parental leave, and twelve holidays.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. AlixPartners is a proud Silver award-winning Veteran Friendly Employer.

Overview:
You have a passion for finding trends and providing solutions that drive profitable growth and maximize returns. As our Marketing Data Analst you’ll apply your unique blend of keen business knowledge and solid technical skills to help optimize inquiry acquisition and conversion performance.

Now you can turn your passion for statistical data analysis to help our team change lives through data driven campaigns. As our Marketing Data Analyst you’ll evaluate marketing data, identify gaps and present opportunities to improve digital, search, email and engagement channels across campaigns for its 17 campuses.

If you want to impact our goals on a daily basis and the lives we touch, we would like to make you part of our team.
Responsibilities:
  • Analyze data, identify trends and audit processes as they relate to marketing campaigns, revenue, click and conversion rates, ROI and ad spend.
  • Develop and report both scheduled and ad-hoc analysis of new and existing campaigns.
  • Improve department reporting procedures, accuracy through automation, and query optimization, as well as manage data integrity.
  • Engage with internal resource teams and experts, as well as vendors to monitor and assess conversion, spend, ROI, etc.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities to improve efficiencies, acquisition and conversion performance.
  • Research market and competitive landscape in support of program/ product development and rollout.
  • Provide internal customers and executive management with thoughtful insights into customer trends and marketing campaign performance.
  • Explain complex topics through clear and concise oral and written communication
Qualifications:
  • 3-5 years of data analytics experience, preferably in marketing and digital marketing
  • 3+ years’ experience using data to develop and measure content and inquiry/conversion marketing effectiveness
  • Experience analyzing and tracking multiple data points across platforms and sources, while coming to actionable conclusions based upon the data
  • Ability to apply context and student/customer lifecycle behavior as part of data interpretation
  • Experience setting up and implementing A/B testing
  • Experience with SQL, Excel and BI360
  • Experience with CRMs is a plus
  • Familiar with Paid (SEM) and Organic (SEO) marketing concepts
