Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for potential access to classified information. Accordingly, US Citizenship is required.

What we offer:
About Tripoint Solutions
We are technology innovators, partnered with state-of-the-art providers, such as AWS, ServiceNow, and UiPath, to drive digital transformation in the federal space. TPS teams are bringing automation and data science into areas of the government that are crying out for fresh tech—making positive impacts felt by tens of thousands of users, countless citizens, and all six branches of the military each day. Our Agile teams are responsible for envisioning, launching, and operating the massive data systems and analytics platforms used to manage $14.5B in government procurements and $200B in military real estate assets globally. At TPS, we apply the power of cloud technologies to help the government think smarter and function better—for everyone.

TPS Company Values
  • We value and respect each employee's dedicated work and unique contributions; as they directly impact who we are and what we do.
  • Your talent and innovative thinking bring leading-edge solutions to our customers.
  • Our success is driven by the dedication of our employees.
  • Employee-generated solutions have sustained our continued success and customer satisfaction
Benefit Offerings
Tripoint Solutions builds flexibility into health benefit plan choices, covers most of the monthly premiums, and helps employees build a career with impact through our generous professional development program.

We offer all full-time employees:
  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits with a national provider network
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts (FSA & HSA)
  • Company-paid Life and Disability insurance including Short-Term, Long-Term, and Accidental
  • Paid-time off (PTO)
  • 11 paid holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Eligibility to receive impact bonuses each quarter
  • Referral Program
  • Professional Development Reimbursement Program to pursue undergraduate, graduate, training, and certifications
  • Monthly transportation, parking, and cell phone service reimbursement

Job Category: Administrative, HR, Business Professionals

Established in 1997, L.A. Care Health Plan is an independent public agency created by the state of California to provide health coverage to low-income Los Angeles County residents. We are the nation’s largest publicly operated health plan. Serving more than 2 million members, we make sure our members get the right care at the right place at the right time.

Mission: L.A. Care’s mission is to provide access to quality health care for Los Angeles County's vulnerable and low-income communities and residents and to support the safety net required to achieve that purpose.
Job Summary
The Business Analyst II works closely with business units to gain in-depth business understanding of customer’s business strategy processes, services, roadmaps and the content in which the business operates. The Business Analyst is focus-driven, focusing on strategy, collaboration, prioritization based on value off internal and external customers. The position consults and collaborates with internal and external customers to address any issues that are contributing to inaccurate or inefficient procedures/ processes within the Department. This position is key to understanding the documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. It is responsible for reviewing end-to-end business processes to identify, address, and remediate operational and functional risks. This position conducts a strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats (SWOT) analysis to identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency. It is responsible for a full range of activities leading small to large size projects, assist project managers on complex projects related to operational business functions affecting internal departments and external customers at market level.
Duties
Participate and contribute in multiple projects by completing and updating project documentation; managing project scope; adjusting schedules when necessary; determining daily priorities; ensuring efficient and on-time delivery of project tasks and milestones; follow escalation process; and managing customer relationships. Ensure data is valid and reliable; develop business process improvement; monitor and update software as needed; partner with internal and external customers to accomplish long-term business strategies and goals. Identify, create, and facilitate process design changes by conducting business and systems process analysis and design at a complex level; focusing on quality improvement and data management. Identify improvement opportunities (proactive and reactive).

Oversee customer relationships and expectations through communication process; updating others through project paths. Support and align efforts to meet business and customer needs. Facilitate meetings, projects, and presentations to diverse audiences. Provide leadership to team members and peers, collaborating cross-functionally with others; articulate ideas and viewpoints to Senior Management, peers, and others; identify and initiate projects; manage resources; implement resolutions; and hold self-accountable for completing tasks and results. Provide a strategic asset to decompose strategy into value change initiatives.

Maintain an up-to date knowledge of Information Systems to develop, execute, and improve corrective action plans by providing subject matter expertise and guidance to best business practices. Stay current with customer needs and strategies; utilize formal and informal written communication methods (BRDs, emails, PowerPoint presentations, Visio workflows, executive summaries, and project logs). Provide and support business solutions; build relationships with internal/external customers and key stakeholders; monitor project progress and results; provide project analysis and root-cause of operational issues.

Demonstrate leadership and interpersonal communication skills by working collaboratively and effectively with peers, superiors and subordinates to accomplish objectives. Able to concisely, clearly and formally communicate complex concepts and formulate process solutions. Work as a subject matter expert and review all submitted problem and improvement reports; identify priority issues; evaluates opportunities for improvement, presents findings to supervisors for evaluation and prepares resolution work plan as directed. Develop and execute test plans. Monitor all solutions through to resolution.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Summary

The Sr. Data Analyst will provide senior-level support and analysis for KCNSC enterprise data projects, define processes, and adhere to them. The role is responsible for performing data analysis, data mapping, data integration, data quality, and application development for our data cataloging solution. This role will provide primary support to be focused around our Data Governance activities as determined by KCNSC Data Office management.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Utilize analytical and technical skills for translating and analyzing business needs into requirements and lead the design and implementation of ourgovernance solutions (cataloging, data quality, access management)
  • Work with project work streams, business stakeholders to design, implement and maintain best practice data governance cataloging and data quality solutionsto support the business.
  • Perform data analysis by querying data sets in databases, spreadsheets, semi-structured data, and flat file format to identify and document master data, reference data, transaction data, business rules, data integration rules, data mapping and transformations.
  • Document internal processes and audit procedures to ensure data integrity of solutions
  • Research and resolve unexpected results or internal process flaws. Effectively prioritize and deploy solutions that can replace manual process
  • Develop our application design and use for our data cataloging and data quality systems
  • Support development of master data, data cataloging and data quality processes in data management tools.
  • Support a variety of information management projects of a highly varied nature including data analysis, data mining and data optimization
  • Develop and follow standard operating procedures for regularly occurring processes
  • Mentor, Cross-train and provide back-up coverage to other team members when needed
  • Operating at the Sr Analyst level, duties/responsibilities should be carried out with autonomy and require minimal direct supervision of day-to-day tasks and only high-level direction from departmental leadership. Should have the ability to support and coach others while maintaining productivity on directly assigned work.

You Must Have

  • Bachelors Degree or 6 years equivalent experience
  • 5 years of demonstrated data management experience, including the ability to merge, clean and analyze large amounts of data
  • 3 years of demonstrated experience with application development of cataloging and/or data quality solutions

We Value

  • Technical experience should include SQL, PL/SQL, T/SQL, NoSQL programming, and database objects such as stored procedures, materialized views, functions etc. or analytics tools (Microstrategy, Tableau, PowerBI) or data management tools (MDM, Data Catalog, Data Quality tools).
  • Data Process Analysis experience should include documentation and analysis techniques such as data flow diagrams (DFD), Unified Modeling Language (UML), and analyzing system level information flow and decomposing data process dependencies within a digital ecosystem.
  • Experience working with Data management platforms (Collibra, Informatica, Denodo, etc.)
  • Experience working with data models, data warehouse, data management and data movement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage through ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and analytical skills. Strong interpersonal and collaborative work style.
  • Ability to work with and manage confidential information in a professional manner.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to lead/drive priorities.
  • Experience working on large scale business process improvement with results.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective process management solutions.
  • Proactive analytical and collaborative problem-solving skills with business acumen.
  • Ability to clearly document business process & system requirements.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both senior managerial and technical teams.
  • Ability to drive action, deliver results, with agile approach.
  • Convey information with clarity and directness, ensuring the message is understood across diverse, global teams.

FMT2021

Additional Information

  • JOB ID: 1327
  • Remote Eligibility: Hybrid
  • Travel Required: 0-10%
  • Hourly/Salary: Salary
  • Relocation Available: Yes

raw_job_description:
The Data Analyst V performs highly complex (senior level) data analysis, data research, database management, and application development assignments for the Data Management Unit within Information and Data Management Division, Office of Data, Analytics, and Performance (ODAP). Detects data trends and anomalies and provides HHSC programs and executive management with information necessary to make data-informed management decisions and explores potential program efficiencies. Work involves conducting detailed analysis of data sets, performing data needs assessment, data acquisition, cleaning and standardization, extraction, transformation and loading into database systems; designing, coding, testing, implementing and maintaining computer applications to increase efficiency through the automation of routine tasks. Mentors ODAP staff in the use of compiled datasets. Works under limited supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.


Essential Job Functions:
EJF #1: Conducts detailed analysis of data sets to extract insights and detect trends. Performs data needs assessments, acquisition, cleaning, and standardization. Leads extraction, transformation, and loading processes into database systems. Designs, codes, tests, implements, and maintains computer applications to increase efficiency.

EJF #2: Consults, collaborates, and coordinates with HHSC IT, Texas Shared Technology Services, and data trading partners to maintain and troubleshoot computer applications and data management processes. Initiates and coordinates projects to refresh and upgrade database software and server operating systems. Ensures server and database configurations are updated to maintain connectivity with HHSC systems and data trading partners. Provides triage support for applications and databases to resolve functional and performance issues.

EJF #3: Consult with ODAP staff to identify programmatic and business needs. Conducts data needs assessments. Plans, designs, and develops data systems to meet ODAP data needs. Consults and coordinates with ODAP and other HHSC staff to identify potential areas for increased efficiencies and data flow automation. Conducts data profiling and data analysis to identify data quality issues and recommend improvements. Develops project plans, objectives, and timelines and executes them. Identifies and incorporates innovative solutions to streamline workflows and processes.

EJF #4: Prepares and reviews a variety of written, oral, and graphical deliverables containing analyses of Health and Human Services data to detect data trends, outliers, and anomalies, and provides HHSC programs and leadership with information necessary to make informed decisions on streamlining workflows and processes, modification of existing data models, and recommendations on the enhancement of database system architecture. Develops and maintains data quality and data governance processes to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data in the warehouses.

EJF # 5: Trains DAP staff on ODAP Data Repository (ODAP DR) and Quality Assurance and Improvement (QAI) Datamart applications and systems. Identifies areas for learning and development and participates in training programs available to HHSC and DAP staff members. Mentors ODAP staff in the use of data systems.


Knowledge Skills Abilities:
Knowledge of the process of computer application development.
Knowledge of Oracle 19c on the Linux platform
Knowledge of data warehouse architecture of Star and Snowflake schemas used in relational, dimensional, and multi-dimensional data modeling.
Knowledge of scripting language to import and extract database information in a Linux batch environment – preferably PERL.
Knowledge of scientific research methods, statistical techniques, mathematics, geographical concepts, and their application to data analytics.
Knowledge of the various Texas Health and Human Service (HHS) programs.
Knowledge of patient level health and demographic data (e.g., Census, Vital, Medicaid, and CHIP data including eligibility, enrollment, medical claims, and encounters).
Knowledge of the principals, practices and techniques of database design and development, database structures and theories and current database technologies.
Knowledge of medical records systems or clinical coding practices.
Knowledge of Internet and World Wide Web.
Knowledge of computer programming principles, spreadsheet macros, and database design.
Skill in developing computer applications using high level interpreted languages such as Perl.
Skill in using SAS, SPSS, SQL, R, ACCESS, Business Objects, or other statistical and database management software.
Skill in using EXCEL or other spreadsheet software.
Skill in graphical, tabular, and geographical presentation of data.
Skill in verbal and written communications.
Skill in database management with Oracle, SQL Server, or similar large database systems.

Ability to analyze and solve problems.
Ability to design, develop, code, test, implement, maintain, and document computer applications.
Ability to manage, manipulate, and analyze complex databases.
Ability to Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into the data warehouse using tools like Informatica, PERL, and Linux shell scripts.
Ability to oversee and/or supervise the work of others.
Ability to plan, organize, and conduct data analytic projects.
Ability to work in a team and to communicate effectively.
Ability to develop and interpret statistical data charts, maps, and tables.
Ability to interpret and publish data analytic findings.
Ability to exercise independent judgment and show initiative.
Ability to maintain detailed and organized documentation of data analytic projects.
Ability to train staff in the use of data systems.

Registration or Licensure Requirements:
N/A


Initial Selection Criteria:
Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university. Major coursework in computer science, computer information systems, database management, information systems management, or a related field is preferred. Experience in database administration, developing and running complex queries to retrieve data from transactional databases, and/or conducting extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes may be substituted for education on a year for year basis.


Additional Information:

MOS Code:
25B, IT,3D0X4

HHS agencies use E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work.


In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview.

Develops reports and data analytic strategies, tools and processes that promote effective clinical decision making, revenue enhancement, cost efficiency, and sound business decisions and the presentation and evaluation of data to providers and leadership. Reports to Chief Administrative Officer, Service Line Administrator, Vice President of Ambulatory Services as assigned Supervises N/A Ages of Patients N'A Blood Borne Pathogens Minimal/No Potential Qualifications Education Required: Bachelor’s degree in related field Preferred: Master’s degree Licensure/Certification Required: Epic certification within one year (Resolute HB/PB, Caboodle, Cupid, Reporting Workbench or other applicable as assigned) Preferred: Certification in Performance Analytics Warehouses & Business Intelligence Tools Experience Required: Three (3) years of experience in data analytics and data modeling in Healthcare Essential Responsibilities Demonstrates compliance with Code of Conduct and compliance policies and takes action to resolve compliance questions or concerns and report suspected violations. Designs, develops, and maintains user-friendly data visualizations and dashboards using complex datasets from various sources. Designs and implements data strategy to support effective business intelligence/analytics. Ensures data validity of metrics reported internally or externally. Develops and implements data analyzes, data collection systems and other strategies that support departmental and organizational needs while enabling and optimizing efficient and flexible statistical analyzes of clinical and operational data. Generates insights for action using technical and analytical expertise to understand clinical and operational data opportunities. Develops architectural, analytical, and procedural processes that enable flexible clinical analyzes so that organizational stakeholders can understand their unique metrics of interest. Drives standardization, efficiency, and improvements in clinical and operational data reporting. Collaborates with Information Systems and Business Intelligence departments to facilitate additional reporting needs for ambulatory division initiatives. Increases the interactive nature of data analytics tools to help elevate end user data analytics expertise to support strategic planning, program management, business management and goal setting. Participates in meetings and on teams as a resource for the purposes of operational and clinical business decision making. Prepares and presents data to physicians, leadership, and clinical staff. In collaboration with various stakeholders, including end-users, application teams, Epic TSs, Super Users, and others, plays a crucial role in optimizing existing analytics, architecture, and technology. Performs other duties as assigned. Location: Eisenhower Health · Cardiac Service Line Schedule: Full Time, Day, 8 Hour Shift

Anticipated Interview Dates: In person interviews are anticipated to be held the week of 09/2/2024.

This position will run until filled with the following cutoff dates for review: 8/16/2024, 8/31/2024, 9/16, and every 15 calendar days until filled.

Do you enjoy working in a collaborative team environment where challenging and rewarding work is the norm? Do you have a passion for research and data analytics? Are you interested in leveraging large, real-world datasets to inform decision-making? Are you open to change and finding creative ways to implement continuous process improvements? If you answered yes to these questions, then we encourage you to apply for this exciting office-centric job opportunity!

The Policy Research & Data Analytics (PRDA) Division provides research, guidance, and data analytics to inform retirement-related issues and business decisions. PRDA employs research data techniques to assess the impact of potential retirement policy changes and sustainability of benefits and services, and continuously improve business processes.

Under the general supervision of the Research Data Supervisor II, Lean Operations & Research Analytics, the Research Data Analyst (RDA) II is responsible for designing and conducting iterative research projects and assignments. The RDA II has intermediate knowledge of and experience using a variety of research, analytical, and statistical methods and techniques used in data analysis and to provide comprehensive research. The RDA II manages workload consisting of iterative projects and assignments, completes work under critical timelines to meet project requirements, and writes clear and concise studies and reports. The RDA II exercises a high degree of independence, initiative, flexibility, and tact in performing the duties listed and may perform other team assignments as required and appropriate for this level.

GIS & Natural Resource Data Analyst - (24141479)


THE OUTSIDE IS IN US ALL.

Please remember to attach the required documents listed in this announcement:

Cover Letter

Resume

Applications missing the requested documents will be considered incomplete and may not progress further in the process. Documents not requested will not be considered in the recruitment process. The State Application is not a substitute for a Resume. This position is open until filled. You must apply through the State of Montana Career site.

Special Information:
Identity of applicants who become finalists may be released to the public if the Department deems it necessary. Employees who exceed 1,040 hours in a calendar year are also provided health, dental and life insurance. Other benefits include retirement, paid vacation, sick and holidays. This position may be covered by a VEBA (Voluntary Employee Beneficiary Association).

A successful applicant will be subject to a background investigation.


Women and minorities are under-represented in this job category and are encouraged to apply.


Special Information:

Do you have experience managing natural resource spatial data and creating compelling GIS products? Are you interested in fisheries, wildlife, and natural resources information? Would you enjoy working with professionals dedicated to the stewardship of natural resources in Montana? If so, the Geographic Data Services Bureau at Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks is recruiting for two GIS and Natural Resources Analysts. These positions are unique opportunities for GIS professionals with a passion for Montana’s fish, wildlife and recreational resources who want to use their experience and skills to benefit a fish and wildlife agency.


The successful applicant will have experience with, and be interested in fish, wildlife and recreational resources in Montana and share a commitment to FWP's Vision and Mission. FWP uses the Esri suite including ArcGIS Pro, and ArcGIS Online tools including Experience Builder, Field Maps, and Survey123. The ideal candidate has experience with these technologies as well as being analytical, detail oriented, creative, possess a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and excellent people skills. These positions require time management skills, the ability to collaborate successfully in a team, work independently on multiple priorities, and communicate with diverse groups of people. You must be able to clearly communicate concepts related to fisheries and wildlife science as well as GIS, data, and database concepts to individuals with both technical and non-technical backgrounds. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply. This position requires some travel and occasional irregular hours to meet project deadlines. Long hours of computer use at a desk are required. On occasion, there may be opportunity to participate in field work requiring physical exertion and possibly under adverse weather conditions.


Job Duties (narrative summary):


A typical day in this position might include planning and managing statewide GIS data and services, developing official map publications, data analysis, map production, mapping application development assistance, technical support/outreach, and cross-division and cross-agency collaboration and support.


Requirements:

  • A minimum of four (4) years of relevant GIS work experience (excluding internships and TA or lab assistant positions) managing natural resources or fish and wildlife spatial data
  • Experience creating compelling digital and hard copy map products
  • Spatial data management experience including implementing spatial analysis and GIS workflows
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL
  • Advanced experience with Esri products including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Field Maps, Survey 123, Dashboards and Experience Builder

Required application materials:

  • Detailed resume
  • Cover letter explaining how your work experience, education and career goals make you the ideal candidate for this position.

Please review the previous list of requirements when you apply and ensure you submit all required documents as incomplete applications will be rejected. Candidates progressing to an interview will be required to present a recent GIS project as part of the interview process.


Applicant Pool Statement: If another department vacancy occurs in this job title within six months, the same applicant pool may be used for the selection.
Training Assignment: This agency may use a training assignment. Employees in training assignments may be paid below the base pay established by the agency pay rules. Conditions of the training assignment will be stated in writing at the time of hire.

Salary: $ 33.03 - 33.03 Hourly

Telework Eligibility: Telework Eligible (Full-time telework is not available. Telework schedule must be supervisor approved.)
Benefits Package Eligibility: Health Insurance, Paid Leave & Holidays, Retirement Plan

Employee Status: Regular
Schedule: Full-Time
Job Type: Standard
Shift: Day Job
Travel: Yes, 10 % of the Time

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.


Citi’s Mission and Value Proposition explain what we do and Strategy explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients’ and the public’s trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve.

The IT Business Analyst is a senior-level position responsible for liaising between business users and technologists to exchange information in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning. This resource will have strong communication and diplomacy skills in order to influence internal partners to ensure right solutions are conceptualized and developed from the outset.


Responsibilities:

raw_job_description:
Job Description


Responsible for conceptualizing and creating advanced demand monitoring and customer behavior models; maintaining, enhancing, and improving the accuracy and effectiveness of existing model performance; providing consulting advice and tools to improve revenue management analyst performance and revenue maximization; and utilizing science models to support executive reporting and budget/revenue forecasting.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, enhance a variety of mathematical models (includes data collection, analysis, prototyping, testing, creation of production systems, and development of performance metrics)
  • Monitor model performance, re-calibrate, maintain, and recommend design enhancements.
  • Develop tools/reports for analysts and management to monitor business trends, forecasts, and customer behavior.
  • Aid upper management by way of ad hoc analyses to answer a variety of business-related questions
  • Consult/train analysts and management on use of science models and tools

Qualifications:

  • Minimum Education: Master’s Degree required
  • Discipline/Major: Quantitative discipline such as Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Math, Decision Sciences, or related field
  • Required Years and Area of Professional Experience: 7+ years’ experience preferred within a large corporation practicing revenue management or academic research on revenue management models and systems
  • Critical Professional Related Technical/Computer Skills: Experience in building mathematical models utilizing Data Mining/Operations Research/Statistics techniques, Proficient in SQL, Python, SAS/SPSS/R and Tableau desktop.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Self-starter who can work well across teams and move projects forward when information is incomplete or ambiguous with minimal guidance from the management team.
  • Ability to lead medium-to-large sized efforts across teams from inception to completion.
  • Ability to understand and build out the team’s analytical and technical framework in a way that efficiently and holistically supports performance objectives.
  • Ability to understand individual models as well as how those models interact across a variety of subject area.
  • Must demonstrate an ability to understand, analyze, and consider the interactions of various business variables, operational considerations, and data limitations in creating modeling that aligns with real-world behavior and allows users to draw insights, develop deeper understanding, and make better decisions that result in improved performance.
  • Ability to review modeling output against real-world behavior and make recommendations to manger, product management team, and senior-level leadership.
  • Ability to communicate sophisticated modeling concepts in easy-to-understand business terminology across various levels of users is important to the success of this role.
  • Ability to take on undefined business opportunities and develop analytical frameworks that create meaningful business context, deepen understanding of the business, create actionable opportunities, and propose solutions that are operationally feasible.
  • Ability to correctly define business problems, research and assess the effectiveness of various modeling approaches when given a specific business question, understand data limitations, anticipate downstream impacts, and create structure when existing structures do not already exist.

The range for this role’s salary $100,000-$135,000. Offers to the selected candidates will be made on a fair and equitable basis, taking into account specific job-related skills and experience.

Job Description
Job Summary (General Responsibilities):
We are looking for an experienced and talented Data Analyst to join Belkin’s e-commerce team, where you will analyze structured, semi-structured and unstructured big data sources to generate actionable insights for various strategic projects. By creating rich dashboards and data pipeline automations you’d scale analytical capabilities and enrich them through quality.
We’re looking for a data & process-driven individual who has extraordinary attention to detail and a track record of analytical problem-solving.
Specific responsibilities include:
  • Responsibilities include in 4 domains of data acquisition, analysis, communication and project management. Specifically:
  • Data Acquisition: Develop automation of reporting by building SQL/Python pipelines. Be able to produce trustworthy reports by automating quality checks
  • Data Analysis: Proficiency in using dashboarding tools like Tableau to uncover trends, creating correct metrics and analyzing them with statistical rigor to understand business performance.
  • Communication: Communicate analysis and work with business stakeholders to drive actions.
  • Project Management: Be able to manage projects and deliverables in a timely manner. Focus on communicating workload status and providing visibility to manager on the same.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data analytics and visualization.
  • Accountable for adhering to the organization and department procedures and guidelines, including maintaining a clean and safe work environment
  • Fulfill responsibilities under ISO 9001 and 14001; understand and fully support ISO system.
  • Support Company’s Affirmative Action initiatives, providing equal opportunity to employees and candidates.
  • Uphold Company’s affirmative action plan and make good faith efforts to achieve affirmative action goals and timetables.
  • Comply with Health and Safety requirements of Belkin.
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
  • Understand and follow company rules and regulations.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned and required.
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math or Statistics.
  • 3 – 5 years of experience designing and implementing data science models, with the ability to perform data extraction, data cleaning, statistical modeling and data visualization.
  • Having experience in Hypothesis testing is a plus
  • Proficiency with business intelligence tools for data visualization (e.g. Tableau, Power BI).
  • Skilled in using SQL and Python
What you’re getting into

We’ve got big collaborative spaces for your big ideas, so bring an open mind and leave your suit in the closet. We all are committed to creating unique and rewarding consumer experiences. Everyone is interested in succeeding – for the team, for themselves and for the business. Cross-functionally and across the company, everyone has common goals and aspires to be their best.

You will learn something new or at least look at things differently every day. There are so many smart and creative people around that you’ll be motivated to pursue the ideal.

Team spirit is infectious. Belkin is an extremely open workplace, where communication is essential. Not every idea will be accepted, but you’ll be asked for your point of view. Innovation thrives on multiple and varied levels. At Belkin we challenge conventional wisdom and refuse to accept that something cannot be done.

We are committed to diversity. Belkin is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace.

We believe in hard work, a fun work environment, and embracing creativity that only comes about when talented people collaborate to develop solutions. Our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.

Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for seven consecutive years as a Top 50 performing P&C company offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a small-company entrepreneurial spirit. Our purpose-driven ethos provides team members with opportunities to contribute, develop, and belong.

The Process Analyst Associate will assist with process improvement initiatives and projects to deliver results in the area of continuous improvement. This position exists to identify business process re-engineering opportunities to drive efficiencies and reduce cost.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Assist with mapping current processes to recommend process improvements.

  • Evaluate low complexity business needs and assist in the development of process improvements.
  • Conduct fact gathering through mapping and workshops and employ quantitative and qualitative data analysis to document process re-engineering efforts.
  • Conduct studies of operations and workflow processes utilizing interviews, site observations, and job shadowing techniques to map current processes.
  • Focus on improving productivity or work methods reducing costs and improving risk management and control through value stream mapping and Business Process Automation.
  • Support delivery and execution of end to end process transformation, focused on eliminating customer abrasion, reducing waste and identifying cost savings opportunities within strategic projects.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency of processes.

  • Collaborate with business unit to ensure workflow processes are defined and documented accurately.
  • Work with project participants and leadership to ensure processes consistency across the enterprise.
  • Simulate scenarios and use optimization techniques to help business unit identify and solve process challenges.
  • Partner with other analysts for enterprise-wide change management.

Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure adoption of process improvements.

  • Work with key members of the business unit to drive adoption of required processes.
  • Assist with developing training courses as needed including measurement, analysis improvement and control. Survey best practices for automate and streamline techniques and processes.
  • Identify inconsistencies and problems and bring to the attention of leadership.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

  • Bachelor's Degree from four-year college or university required with major or emphasis in Business, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.
  • Insurance industry experience is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong desire for Continuous Improvement.
  • Ability to create and interpret project plans, specifications, flowcharts, programming diagrams, etc.
  • Ability to coordinate and organize input from various channels.
  • Ability to perform negotiations, resolve conflicts and build consensus.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and create reports.
  • Analytical problem solving skills and financial acumen.
  • Ability to work with independence with strong collaboration and team-oriented skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.

COMPENSATION

The current salary range for this position is $28.37 to $44.75 an hour USD. This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at ICW Group, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors unique to each candidate; including experience, education, and location of the role and considers employees performing substantially similar work.

WHY JOIN ICW GROUP?

  • Challenging work and the ability to make a difference
  • You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging
  • We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match
  • Bonus potential for all positions
  • Paid Time Off with an accrual rate of 5.23 hours per pay period (equal to 17 days per year)
  • 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
  • Want to continue learning? We’ll support you 100%

Description: Anson County PlanningGIS AnalystSalary Grade: 72 Hiring Range ($54,805 - $95,062)Compensation commensurate with experience.


General Description of Duties

The GIS Analyst is responsible for the overall direction, management, design, development, and support of the County's Geographic Information System (GIS). As a member of the Planning staff, this role will lead efforts to integrate GIS technologies across various county departments and provide strategic direction to ensure that GIS technologies align with county objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Oversee the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of GIS applications, databases, and tools.
  • Ensure system integrity, security, and availability.
  • Coordinate GIS system upgrades, installations, and troubleshooting.
  • Update GIS web interface.
  • Lead the development and implementation of the County's GIS strategic plan.
  • Collaborate with and coordinate with county departments (Planning, Tax, Emergency Services, Utilities, 911 Communications) to determine GIS needs, oversee updates, and implement solutions.
  • Collaborate with and coordinate with GIS contractors.
  • Supervise and participate in GIS-related projects.
  • Allocate resources effectively to ensure project timelines and objectives are met.
  • Offer technical support to GIS users across the county.
  • Public and interdepartmental map making and data requests; including plotter management.
  • Conduct training sessions and workshops to improve GIS skills within the county.
  • Ensure that GIS data is current, accurate, and compliant with relevant standards.
  • Collaborate with other departments and agencies to share and acquire GIS data.
  • Manage the GIS budget, including forecasting, allocation, and monitoring expenses.
  • Act as a liaison between the county, vendors, other governmental agencies, and the public on GIS-related matters.
  • Attend meetings, workshops, and conferences to keep abreast of new GIS technologies and practices.
Requirements:

Minimum Training and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Computer Science, or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of experience in GIS system administration or a related area. Strong understanding of ESRI’s suite of GIS technologies such as ArcPRO, ArcMaps, ArcCatalog, Field Maps, Parcel Fabric etc., in addition to ancillary database technologies such as SQL Server. Familiarity with GIS standards and best practices. Demonstrated project management skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written. Familiarity with North Carolina's geographic and governmental structures is a plus.

Physical Demands

Candidate must be able to physically perform the basic life functions of stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Candidate must be able to perform medium work exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pound of force frequently. Must posses the visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, use measurement devises, do extensive reading, and perform visual inspection of maps for accuracy.

Application Process

Submit an Anson County application to Roslynn K. Ingram, HR Manager at 101 South Greene St. Suite 240 Wadesboro, NC 28170 or email hr@ansoncountync.gov. Applications may be obtained at www.co.anson.nc.us.

Closing Date: Open until filled. First review date of applications August 05, 2024.

About Rivian:
Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.
Role Summary:
At Rivian, we prioritize Quality and Reliability as the cornerstone of our mission. As a Senior Data Analyst specializing in this field, you will play a pivotal role within our dynamic, diverse, and top-tier team. Collaborating with data scientists, engineers, and operators, you will leverage big and small data from our world class factory specifically from our manufacturing processes, suppliers, and service operations to generate insights and dashboards showing the performance, quality, and reliability of our innovative product line-up on a global scale. Your expertise in front-end and visualization tool development will be instrumental in ensuring that data is accessible, available, and actionable for a wide group of cross-functional stakeholders with the purpose of driving critical changes and actions across our manufacturing floor.
Responsibilities:
  • Utilize extensive dimensional, manufacturing equipment and time series data to extract valuable statistics and insights about failures to drive improvements in production quality and customer experience.
  • Develop cutting-edge visualizations and intuitive dashboards to bring data accessibility to a whole new level across the factory, enabling stakeholders to easily interact with and derive insights from complex datasets.
  • Conduct methodical end-to-end research on algorithms, with a focus on prototyping, validation, and iterative improvement, while maintaining a practical approach to technological advancements.
  • Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques, and provide ongoing reports to ensure data content and quality meets business needs.
  • Identify data sources for potential value and invent new means to gather insights
  • Monitor key product metrics, understand root causes of changes, and create dashboards and reports
  • Acquire data from primary or secondary sources and maintain databases for analysis
  • Develop and maintain data visualizations, pipelines, and dashboard enhancements
  • Foster collaboration among peers by creating well-structured, adaptable designs and code that promote teamwork and practical solutions.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, or applicable discipline (Masters Preferred)
  • 4+ years of industry experience in a data analyst role or applicable Ph.D.
  • At least 4 years of experience with SQL, Python and Data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau. Thoughtspot, PowerBI, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience creating complex dashboards and data stories using data analytic tools
  • 4+ years of experience in data analysis, trend and root cause identification, and statistical modeling
  • Ability to communicate technical data concepts into actionable data for the busines
  • Experience with software-defined vehicles or similarly complex systems (preferred)
  • Experience in the field of manufacturing, quality (preferred)
  • Experience with front-end development and tech stack React query, NextJS, TypeScript, (preferred)
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and constantly changing development environment
Company Statements:

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Summary:


Contributes to data processes and maintenance by contributing to entering, maintaining, reconciling data, and verifying accuracy of information in collaboration with the team. Contributes to data abstraction by identifying and capturing key standard and nonstandard administrative and clinical data elements, such as patient data. Performs data processing to include performing adjustments for a variety of data and conducting routine and nonroutine data uploads. Contributes to completion of data reports by developing or using reporting data and metrics for internal and external reports.

Essential Responsibilities:


  • Pursues effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome.
  • Completes work assignments autonomously by applying up-to-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensures all procedures and policies are followed; leverages an understanding of data and resources to support projects or initiatives. Collaborates cross-functionally to solve business problems; escalates issues or risks as appropriate; communicates progress and information. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team.
  • Contributes to overall data process and maintenance by: contributing to entering, maintaining, and reconciling data; verifying accuracy of information in collaboration with the team; and responding to standard and nonstandard requests for data from various departments to support business processes.
  • Contributes to data abstraction by: identifying and capturing key standard and nonstandard administrative and clinical data elements, such as patient data; reviewing medical records to identify standard and nonstandard data required for secondary use; reviewing regulatory requirements to ensure changes are integrated correctly (e.g., metric changes); leveraging information from electronic health records and uploading for use and reduction of abstraction needs; and transferring data as needed for typical or routine data transfers.
  • Supports or leverages data processing by: conducting routine and nonroutine data uploads; maintaining and contributing to the organization and verification for a variety of data; and reconciling moderately complex discrepancies between data sources and escalating issues to a supervisor/manager as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

Experience

  • Minimum three (3) years of direct trauma registry experience.

Education

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Health Care, Information Systems, Human Resources, Operations Research, Public Health Administration, or related field AND Minimum three (3) years of experience in health care data analysis, relational database management, business process improvement, training delivery, clinical research or a directly related field, OR Minimum six (6) years of experience in health care data analysis, relational database management, business process improvement, training delivery, clinical research or a directly related field.
  • High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) required.

License, Certification, Registration

  • Certified Abbreviated Injury Scale Specialist within 12 months of hire

  • Certified Specialist in Trauma Registries within 12 months of hire from Association of Surgical Technologists

Additional Requirements:

  • N/A

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Registered Health Information Credentials, Technician.

Analyst/Programmer - Foundation
Information Technology Services

Work Schedule: Full-Time, Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; non-exempt classification.


Essential Functions: Under the direction of the Director of Information Security Management, the incumbent works with confidential information and conducts data security analysis against "Big Data" collected through network security devices, applications, and logs. The incumbent assists with setting up machine learning techniques for cyber security risk reporting and alerts. Helps to alert the University of potential cyber threats, the incumbent will leverage cutting-edge technologies to perform risk analysis through statistical profiling, inference, classification, clustering, and predictive analysis with the goal of using artificial intelligence to actively identify risks and cyber-attacks with minimal false positives. Ensures systems, procedures, programs, and processes are compliant with state and federal laws and regulations; CSU audit requirements; and ISO/NIST standards related to information security. Incumbent evaluates system security and performance to maintain compliance. Incumbent assists the director with the required annual campus risk assessment tools and reports; annual review of established campus information security programs; and compilation, submission, and remediation of information security audit responses. The incumbent participates with the director on ITS project teams to build knowledge base and experience in security best practices.


Required Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Business Systems, or other related field is required. Some experience working in the data analytics field, and working with various operating systems, such as Unix/Linux, Windows, and MacOS. Knowledge, education, or experience in information technology (IT), or a similar function with an understanding of IT internal controls and IT risk mitigation. Some working knowledge and experience with data analytics and statistical analysis applications, such as Power Bl, SPSS, or equivalent. Working knowledge and experience developing database queries for reporting using Oracle or MS SQL. Working knowledge of MS Office 365, including Word, Excel, Access, Project, Visio, and Outlook OWA. Ability to understand cyber security and technical requirements and conduct research and analysis to formalize outcomes and address needs. The incumbent must have a demonstrated interest and/or ability in working in a multicultural/multiethnic environment. A background check (including a criminal records check) must be completed satisfactorily before any candidate can be offered a position with the CSU. Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current CSU employees who may apply for the position.

As such, the University requires all employees upon date of hire to reside in the State of California. As of January 1, 2022 the CSU Out-of-State Employment Policy prohibits the hiring of employees to perform CSU-related work outside the state of California.


Desired Qualifications: Degree from an accredited college or university with an emphasis in Data Sciences/Database Management/Business Intelligence/Visual Analytics/Statistics. Project Management Certificate. Certificate in Application Development. Certificate or degree in Business Analytics. Three years of related work experience. Experience and knowledge of IT Support and IT Security. Experience with SQL/Power Bl/Oracle Bl/Tableau is highly desired. Experience working with big data. Working knowledge of Business Intelligence. Working knowledge and experience on scripting or programming for automation.

UW MEDICINE IT SERVICES has an outstanding job opportunity for a PMO BUSINESS ANALYST 3 – KPI / SLA position.


WORK SCHEDULE
  • 100% FTE – 40 hours per week
  • Day Shift – UW MEDICINE ITS SERVICES CORE HOURS ARE 07:00 – 16:00 (PST), Monday-Friday


    • POSITION HIGHLIGHTS
  • Working with Leaders, Project Managers, Technical Analysts, and customers to ensure that the technical solutions implemented by ITS consistently meet the needs of our customers.
  • Develop and help implement strategic initiatives for improved efficiency and productivity.
  • Responsible for documenting and maintaining the services IT Services provides and driving the SLA/KPI practice for IT Services under the direction of leadership.
  • Communicates responsibilities and expectations to leaders and team members, managing daily work assignments.
  • Identifies and manages issues, risks, and decisions, ensuring quality deliverables and outcomes.


    • DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION
    UW Medicine IT Services (ITS) is a shared services organization that supports all of UW Medicine. UW Medicine is comprised of Harborview Medical Center (HMC), UW Medical Center-Montlake Campus (UWMC-Montlake), UW Medical Center-Northwest Campus (UWMC-NW), Valley Medical Center (VMC), UW Medicine Primary Care (UWMPC), UW Physicians (UWP), UW School of Medicine (SOM), and Airlift Northwest (ALNW). ITS is responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the infrastructure and applications which support all these institutions, along with the implementation of new services and applications that are used to support and further the UW Medicine mission.


    PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
  • You function as the SME to define and maintain the services IT Services provides for customers.
  • You define metrics and data flow to capture the metrics.
  • You own the SLA/KPI dashboard, including requirements, audiences, and refinements/improvements definitions.
  • You function as SME while working with business users to define and document business cases for IT project requests, including clear definition of business needs, alignment to strategic objectives, benefits, and KPIs.
  • You lead and facilitate requirements meetings to perform requirements analysis and develop/document/validate technical solutions.
  • You partner with Lead, Sr. PMO Business Analyst to develop and then maintain tools, templates, standards, and reports to support Business Analyst functions.
  • You define the level of services required, identifying and documenting the metrics by which those services will be measured, and the process that will be followed when services fall below negotiated levels.
  • You create a framework for process improvement initiatives to support SLAs and KPIs, including prioritization and visibility of execution, defining and leading the process improvement work to create the right measures with the right data as well as to improve processes leading to better execution of services.
  • You partner with Lead, Sr. PMO Business Analyst to drive the ITS PMO Business Analyst function while helping to mature the Business Analyst function within the PMO.
  • Under direction from leadership, you own the SLA/KPI roadmap and maturation including adding or refining metrics in a phased approach
  • You provide leadership to PMO Business Analysts (Levels 1 and Level 2) by motivating team members to meet goals, adhering to their responsibilities and PMO as well as team standards and practices.


    • REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-oriented profession, a technology field, a business-related field, or other discipline that demonstrates analytical or communications abilities, or related field or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • 4+ years of overall experience to include the below.
  • Executing progressively more complex business analyses within an information technology environment including scope definition, requirements gathering, performing cost/benefit analysis, business process re-engineering, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience with a variety of research and analysis techniques, ideally including a mix of both quantitative and qualitative methods for understanding and documenting end-user and business owner requirements.
  • Proven customer service orientation with a history of strong business partnerships and delivering high quality products on time.
  • Experience in process improvement and standards development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, facilitate, and participate in cross-functional, cross organizational work groups to implement projects or organizational changes.
  • In depth understanding and working knowledge of various software development and service management methodologies/concepts (e.g. Agile, Kanban, ITIL, Waterfall).
  • Knowledge of healthcare clinical and administrative information systems applications.
  • Ability to apply financial concepts such as Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI) in practice.
  • Knowledge of the industry standard Business Analyst best practices (e.g., IIBA BABOK).


    • CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT
  • This is an Information Technology deadline-driven work environment.
  • The individual in this position is expected to work normal daytime hours. The work may be performed in either an office environment or by telecommuting with manager approval, during normal business hours; however, significant off-hours and weekends may be needed to resolve problems and respond to emergencies. This individual is expected to be available for emergencies (business continuity/disaster recovery efforts) on a 24x7 basis as needed.
  • Must coordinate projects without direct supervisory authority.

As a Senior Analyst I, you will be key in quantifying and communicating the value of Included Health to our clients. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of Client Analytics, you will be part of a dedicated team of 9 members. Client Analytics sits within the Client Insights division, which includes the Actuarial Team. This division is a vital component of the Business Acceleration Organization at Included Health.

The Client Analytics team translates data and business context into actionable insights, supporting client retention, growth, and business strategy optimization. We work closely with Data and Go To Market teams to deliver essential analytics and reporting.

We predominantly use SQL, Python, Looker, and Google Workspace tools to complete and share our work. We primarily use Jira, Confluence, Github, and Slack for communicating, collaborating, and managing our work and documentation.Join us in driving impactful decisions and fostering our business and client relationships!

Join us in driving impactful decisions and fostering our business and client relationships!

Some examples of things you might work on:

  • Developing reporting packages to support our business review and strategy meetings with a book of 2-4 clients
  • Diving deep into our data platform to answer client-centric performance and value questions
  • Scaling insight generation and enabling other teams self-service key data through report automation and dashboarding projects
  • Scaling insightful analyses to deliver to the market (e.g., to prospective clients, to consultants/brokers, etc.), supporting our growth
  • Partnering with teams across the company to to support cross functional efforts like ensuring new product features and underlying data are incorporated into data pipelines and reporting workflows

Responsibilities:

  • Engage with and serve as a collaborative partner to the Client Success team and other Go To Market functions to meet client reporting needs, demonstrating the value of our services
  • Translate findings of complex analyses into actionable recommendations for clients; Support our Client Success team in delivering those results during live client meetings
  • Partner with cross functional teams to resolve key data blockers that may limit the ability to deliver on analytic requests
  • Develop robust, efficient, and integrated data models, analyses, and dashboards
  • Clearly and succinctly document and maintain said documentation of repeatable processes and analyses for the benefit of future reference and peer knowledge sharing
  • Occasional travel to client sites for business review meetings and company offices for strategy and team building meetings

Required Qualifications:

  • Expert proficiency in SQL
  • You write clean and efficient code
  • You review team member’s code with high attention to detail and a critical eye
  • Exposure to Python for data analysis or automation
  • Intermediate proficiency using a data visualization / BI tool to publish interactive dashboards for internal partners and external clients
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects
  • Strong attention to detail and eagerness to learn new analytical approaches
  • Excellent written and verbal skills to communicate to and build trust with peers, clients, and other key internal and external stakeholders
  • Comfort with ambiguity and defining an approach to a given question or problem
  • Experience working with various types of raw data including (but not limited to) medical/Rx claims data, eligibility data, product data, and survey data
  • Experience creating thoughtful analyses leveraging complex data and presenting the results to clients and other key stakeholders
  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with Python for data analysis, automation, and API interaction
  • Experience building data analysis tools that leverage Google Workspace API’s
  • Experience with Looker
  • Knowledge of the employer-sponsored health space and/or working with health plans serving commercial populations is a plus but not required
  • Experience with Google Workspace tools, Salesforce.com platforms and data, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Github, and Jupyter notebooks

Physical/Cognitive Requirements:

  • Ability to effectively communicate and engage with others, with accommodations available for visual or auditory impairments
  • Ability to respond effectively to changing situations, with accommodations available for varying response times.
  • Ability to form a plan for execution of a particular analysis or deliverable
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration with clients and stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail as applied to analytics requests and review prior to delivery of results
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Curiosity
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Adaptability to changing priorities
  • Ability to maintain focus and attention on tasks, with accommodations available for individuals with attention-related conditions.
  • Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location.
  • Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
  • Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate keyboard, computer and other office-related equipment.
  • No heavy lifting is expected, though occasional exertion of about 20 lbs. of force (e.g., lifting a computer / laptop) may be required.
  • Ability to interact with leadership, employees, and members in an appropriate manner.

Remote-first culture
401(k) savings plan through Fidelity

Full suite of Included Health telemedicine (e.g. behavioral health, urgent care, etc.) and health care navigation products and services offered at no cost for employees and dependents
Generous Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")
12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave
Family Building Benefit with fertility coverage and up to $25,000 for Surrogacy & Adoption financial assistance

The Role: Veronica Beard's Data Team is seeking a Junior BI Analyst to join our growing team. As the 5th member of the Data Team, you will report to the Director of Data and collaborate closely with the Analytics Engineers and a Senior Data Scientist. In this role, you will work with a diverse range of business stakeholders from various departments including Ecommerce, Retail, Planning & Buying, CRM, Wholesale, Operations, Finance, Merchandising, and Marketing. Responsibilities: Improve data reporting company-wide: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data analysis needs and goals. Create and maintain reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders, providing clear visualizations and explanations of findings. Use BI tool and data analytics software to analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights. Provide continuous support to business stakeholders by answering ad-hoc questions and offering guidance on making the most out of the BI tools for their specific needs. Continuously learn and stay updated with industry trends, BI tools, and data analysis techniques. Onboard, educate and upskill business stakeholders with our BI tool: Lead the onboarding process of new team members by providing training and support on BI tool and data analysis methodologies used within the organization. Prepare and maintain up-to-date documentation and guides on data analysis processes (i.e data collection, data cleaning & preparation, EDA, etc.) and BI tool functionalities for easy reference by new hires. Run internal workshops, training and 'lunch and learn' sessions to both share and enhance knowledge of BI tool, data analysis techniques (i.e trend analysis, comparative analysis, etc.), and best practices. Tailor the BI tool's functionalities to meet business stakeholders’ requirements more effectively, enhancing user satisfaction and engagement. Establish a feedback loop with both internal team members and business stakeholders to gather insights on the BI tool's usage, challenges encountered, and suggestions for improvement. Analyze feedback to recommend enhancements in BI tool functionalities, reporting accuracy, and data visualization effectiveness, contributing to the continuous improvement of data-driven strategies within the organization. Support broader data initiatives and daily operations: Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to support the development and implementation of data models according to business requirements. Collaborate with Senior Data Scientist to support with daily operations tasks. Help ensure data integrity by championing Data Observability tool and supporting data discrepancy troubleshooting. Help ensure data compliance with data privacy regulations and company policies. Perks for joining the team include: Opportunity to work with modern data stack including Sigma Computing, Hex, Fivetran, dbt, GCP, HighTouch, Metaplane and Heap Analytics. Opportunity to join a data team early with important personal growth opportunities. Be part of a profitable & high growth business with hundreds of thousands of customers. Exciting challenges to work on due to the diversity of sales channels our brand operates on (Ecommerce, Wholesale and Retail Stores). Gain experience and contribute to various data areas, including data engineering and data science. Collaborate with esteemed members of the data community and experienced business stakeholders from renowned brands.
Requirements: Minimum of 1 year experience creating dashboards and reports using BI/Visualization tools (Sigma Computing experience is a plus). Proficiency in SQL (Bonus: Python). Proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheet. Ability to work on cross-functional projects and effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Basic knowledge of retail industry and/or direct-to-consumer KPIs and metrics. Knowledge of the Principles of Good Visualization. Understanding of key data engineering concepts, such as data modeling, data warehousing, ELT, and Kimball methodology. Skilled communicator with a passion for education and teaching Data storytelling and visualizations ignite your enthusiasm Team player who enjoys collaborating with diverse business stakeholders Understand the power of great data visualizations in its capacity of filtering out the noise and emphasizing the signal Deliver meticulous and high-quality work Have a growth mindset Interest for the fashion industry is a plus
The salary range for this role is between $65,000 and $75,000. The relevant salary range will vary depending on wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to, skill sets, experience, training, degrees, and certifications. The salary range is just one component of our total compensation offerings, which consist of a comprehensive benefits package as well as a short-term incentive program, clothing allowance, and merchandise discounts.

Your Platform

We’re headquartered in Santa Monica, California, housing multiple teams across many fields of Marketing, PR, Sales, Supply Chain and other corporate functions such as HR, IT, Legal, Facilities and Finance. Santa Monica is the nerve center of our company, where the best ideas combine with unrivaled rigor to create the biggest and best entertainment experiences in the world.

Your Mission is:


The Live Ops Analytics Team is adding a dedicated Sr. Analyst to work directly with our studio partners. As a member of the Live Ops Team, your mission is
to put science into decision making. You will work closely with designers, engineers, business stakeholders, and analytics peers to derive meaningful
insights and recommendations to improve gameplay design and commercial decisions. Responsibilities include:

  • Partner with studios to proactively identify and implement gameplay analytics in support of the development goals of designers and engineers
  • Partner with studio engineers and business analysts to implement game health telemetry and tracking, create new dashboards and reports, and perform deep-dive research
  • Collaborate with the live services teams to optimize game feature balance, game economies, and to identify and close out exploits
  • Deliver presentations on analytic topics and results to both technical and non-technical audiences

What you will bring to the team?
The ideal candidate will be a motivated data expert who wants to grow their analytics toolset in a fast-paced environment, is focused on delivering value to
partners, and has a passion for video games. Your success will be reflected in:


Measurable Impact: Consistently demonstrating analytics impact on revenue, engagement, and player experience.
Relationships: As an embedded team member, team success is a priority. You will rely on your excellent relationship skills to build trust with your
studio partners.
Communication: You will effectively manage your own time, stakeholder, and leadership expectations.
Translator: Your work speaks for itself; correct, clear, and concise insights leading to action.
Domain knowledge: As you understand our players’ attitudes, you are reliably able to qualitatively deduce and draw quantitative conclusions that will directly influence decision-making.


Player Skills

  • BA/BS degree required with a technical focus (e.g. data science, statistics, mathematics) or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in analytics-related work.
  • Experience working with business partners to create and communicate strategic actionable takeaways, provide solutions, and expose areas of
    improvement.
  • Deep technical skills using SQL to generate data sets - familiarity working in a notebook-based workflow a plus.

We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/.
