job_title: Applications Systems Data and Report Analyst I/II
raw_job_description:
Job Description

OPEN UNTIL FILLED

JOB SUMMARY:

The Applications Systems Data and Report Analyst performs specialized technical tasks to organize, analyze, structure, and report on the data associated with software systems developed, purchased, or licensed by the Agency. Maintains a working knowledge of the data schema for all Agency software systems and data sets, facilitating the writing of queries and reports to support business units, leadership, and the Agency Board of Directors. Effectively presents and translates data related information and reporting to Agency resource. Key stakeholder and lead technical resource in the planning, coordination, and implementation of automated efficiencies and software related projects. Ensures that data security, confidentiality, integrity, and availability are maintained at optimum levels.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Responsible for performing data management and reporting functions, structured and unstructured data analytics, and overall data schema maintenance.
  • Provide level 2 and above technical support to end-users in conjunction with Agency data and reporting needs. Also provides general technical support to users throughout the Agency .
  • Develop and maintain reports to access data to fulfill Agency, state, and federal reporting requirements using various reporting tools. Ensures external reports can be produced in compliance with requirements.
  • Develop/create standard operating procedures to ensure the consistency of data sets and associated reoccurring reports.
  • Assist in the planning, development, testing, and delivery of reports and data for routine requests as well as ad hoc requests.
  • Guide and manage system integration and implementation efforts across system platforms to ensure data schema, data security, and functional usage requirements are maintained.
  • Perform statistical data analysis and interpret data results to distinguish patterns and recognize trends.
  • Communicates with all levels of the organization. Serve as liaison between Agency staff, clinical personnel, other IT resources, and software/hardware vendors. Review system problems identified by staff and evaluate/implement appropriate methods for resolving problems. Disseminates information from software/hardware vendors necessary to keep system users updated. Coordinate Agency and vendor system and data requirements.

OTHER DUTIES:

  • Perform such other duties as assigned by supervisor.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of management information systems as related to data collection and reporting, database design, and general management. Knowledge of mental health/medical service environment helpful. Thorough technical knowledge of software installation, operation, and support (including MS Office applications, Microsoft 365 infrastructure components, Microsoft Windows OS - desktop and server, Microsoft SQL Server, 3rd party database platforms). Functional knowledge of programming and/or scripting languages.

Skills: Creating, implementing and maintaining databases; troubleshooting and correcting computer information system deficiencies; computer operating language, spreadsheets, database management, word processing, and an understanding of various other software. Proficient query and report writing skills utilizing one of the following: SQL, Microsoft Power BI, Cognos, Crystal Reports, etc.

Abilities: Solve computer information system problems; analyze informational/data recording and reporting requirements, and develop computer-based solutions to meet those needs; meet established deadlines and work effectively under pressure, communicate effectively both verbally and in writing; work effectively with other staff members; generate reports; and, maintain confidentiality. Ability to effectively manage assigned routines with minimal supervision.


Job Requirements

EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION REQUIRED:

Grade E14: Completion of AS degree/certification in a business or computer related field, preferably in computer science and supplemented by formal computer training/course work, and/or high school or general education diploma with equivalent education/technical certifications/experience. Two years' experience in technical support operations, preferably in a public and/or healthcare agency.

Grade E15: Completion of BS degree/certification in a computer related field, preferably in computer science, or equivalent education/technical certifications/experience. Three to five years' professional/administrative experience, preferably in a public and/or healthcare agency.

raw_job_description:
The Data Governance Analyst will be responsible for analyzing and cataloging data feeds for GHX's Data Platform. As part of the Data Governance team, your work will enhance data discoverability, consistency, and quality across the organization. This role will work with stakeholder teams and other Data Governance members to analyze, validate, document and report on data feeds coming into the platform. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of data governance principles, and hands-on experience with data cataloging tools and technologies. At GHX we believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Duties and responsibilities (5-8 bullets)

  • Implement and maintain a metadata catalogue for assets in the Data Platform
  • Develop and maintain metadata that describes the structure, content, and quality of data assets. Ensure that metadata is accurate, up-to-date, and easily accessible.
  • Document and build data lineage diagrams to track how data flows through the platform
  • Perform analysis on new data feeds, making sure any sensitive information has proper security controls implemented according to company/industry regulations
  • Document and report on how platform stakeholders are using the available data assets
  • Work with data stakeholders to establish and document data quality rules for incoming data feeds
  • Write flexible, reusable, and efficient code utilizing best practices such as maintaining documentation and using version control.
  • Perform other duties as assigned such as optimize queries and procedures, debug and resolve issues, analyze business requirements with teammates to formulate and support design and design documentation

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline
  • 2-4 years of professional work experience analyzing and finding insights in large data sets
  • 1-2 years of Data Governance experience
  • Familiarity with data quality management and metadata management.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Detail-oriented and thorough
  • A demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, with a track record of providing unique contributions and promoting a culture of openness and respect. GHX encourages candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and is dedicated to providing equal opportunities for qualified applicants.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Snowflake database platform
  • Familiarity with data catalog tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Microsoft Purview)
  • Familiarity with the Sigma BI tool
  • Familiarity with healthcare data rules and standards (such as HIPAA) from working with health or healthcare data (healthcare supplies procurement, purchasing, logistics, or data from EHR/EMR systems like Epic or Cerner)
  • Experience working in big data environments
  • Supply chain analysis or background

Estimated salary range: $62,000 - $78,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX's salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. Job Summary

This position performs data analysis and data visualization at an intermediate level. Essential responsibilities are aligned with practices and teams across one or more geographic areas, health benefits, and lines of business. This position spends substantial time working with a variety of healthcare data sets and will entail using a combination of evaluation, quality improvement methods, data analysis, and data visualization to meet defined clinical performance metrics, evaluate clinical programs and financing models (e.g., value-based payment models), and regulatory deliverables. This position integrates quality improvement) (QI) activities, processes, and projects with the CareOregon Quality Strategy and related regulatory and accreditation standards to promote compliance.


Essential Responsibilities

Data Analysis

  • Perform ongoing synthesis and analysis of performance information.
  • Conduct basic to advanced analysis of key metrics and program data to identify trends, make predictions, and calculate targets.
  • Develop dashboards to provide visual assessment of metric performance and regulatory compliance.
  • Using quality improvement and evaluation technical skills, evaluate line of business/regional priorities and develop strategic reporting systems for use at the staff, program manager, director, and senior leadership levels to assess the effect of key program and policy decisions.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to leadership based on data and analysis.
  • Present data in an effective and understandable way and assist others in understanding how data can be used to lead improvement.
  • May provide guidance or expertise to less experienced analysts.

Projects and Collaboration

  • Participate on projects.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders as needed.
  • Participates in and may represent QI team or LOB on cross-departmental workgroups.
  • Effectively communicate complex analyses to non-technical audiences.

QI Technical Assistance and Regulatory Compliance

  • Serve as subject matter expert on technical specifications of clinical measures; may serve as a resource on key data sets.
  • Provide QI technical assistance on development and distribution of data.
  • Present at internal/external workgroups and committees.
  • Identify training needs around quality improvement and data.
  • Develop, assess, and implement new QI and reporting systems.
  • Create process documentation for QI activities.
  • Coordinate regulatory deliverables and ensure timely submission; provide data/reports as needed.
  • SME for key regulatory deliverables and facilitates process for setting priorities and executing on process.
  • Serve as QI contact to OHA or CMS for regulatory meetings/deliverables.

Organizational Responsibilities

  • Perform work in alignment with the organization’s mission, vision and values.
  • Support the organization’s commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion by fostering a culture of open mindedness, cultural awareness, compassion and respect for all individuals.
  • Strive to meet annual business goals in support of the organization’s strategic goals.
  • Adhere to the organization’s policies, procedures and other relevant compliance needs.
  • Perform other duties as needed.

Experience and/or Education

Required

  • Minimum 4 years’ experience with data analytics and data visualization (coding and dashboard creation) with a strong focus on quality improvement or regulatory reporting, including minimum 2 years experience in a health-related field

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, math, or health-related field with minimum 3 years’ experience in data analytics and data visualization (coding and dashboard creation) with a strong focus on quality improvement or regulatory reporting

OR

Master’s degree in science, technology, engineering, math, or health-related field with minimum 2 years’ experience in data analytics and data visualization (coding and dashboard creation) with a strong focus on quality improvement or regulatory reporting, including minimum 1 year experience in a health-related field

Preferred

  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, SQL, and/or Tableau

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of data quality, data analytics, and data visualization principles
  • Knowledge of program evaluation methodologies and analytic strategies
  • Knowledge of healthcare quality metrics (e.g. CCO incentive measures, Medicare Stars measures, HEDIS or other measure sets)
  • Knowledge of population health, quality of care concepts and methodologies, and FQHCs, as well as concepts of community health and social determinants of health
  • Working knowledge of health equity, inclusion and diversity frameworks and how to apply them to data analytics

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of dashboard building for data storytelling and visualization

  • Strong SQL understanding and experience working with large relational databases and platforms
  • Advanced proficiency with computer software programs, e.g. MS Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint

This job requires working 2 days a week in the Denton, Texas corporate office and does not provide any assistance for Relocation.

Western Midstream is a master limited partnership formed to own, develop, acquire, and operate midstream assets. As a GIS Administrator at Western Midstream, you will play a crucial role in collaborating with the Spatial Data team, utilizing ESRI software to manage and optimize Geographic Information Systems (GIS).   • Conduct data quality assessments and troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Collect, validate, and maintain geospatial datasets to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Have working knowledge of FME or Python and Microsoft SharePoint with Power Automate.

  • Experience with ESRI desktop software- ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Pro
  • Ability to run geo-processing tools.
  • Skilled in data editing and running selection queries.
  • Mapping and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ArcGIS Portal

  • SharePoint and Power Automate are a plus.
  • Excellent communication and reporting skills
  • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, or GIS/Technology related field.

GIS certification program is a plus.

The percentage of travel required for this position is 0-10%

This position follows a hybrid schedule working in the office Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and working remote Wednesday and Friday. Monday-Thursday are 9 hours and Fridays are 4 hours.

CommonSpirit Health was formed by the alignment of Catholic Health Initiatives (CHI) and Dignity Health. As an integral member of CHI Health, the Data Analyst Population Health supports successful execution of project implementations that involve data interchanges between systems and external data sources in pursuit of designing, tracking and evaluating population health improvement initiatives. This role supports social care integration programs and may work directly both with internal/ external CommonSpirit resources, including CHI Health Partners, the Creighton Population Health Institute and vendor(s) supporting Population Health Technology tools.
This role will advise on required inputs into population health technology tools in a way that facilitates reporting needs for downstream stakeholders. Role Summary:

Under the general supervision of the Program Manager/Team Leader, the Business Analyst I collect, and analyses data related to business problems and processes, and assembles functional/non-functional requirements for software systems and improvement initiatives. The incumbents primary responsibility is to elicit, analyze, validate, specify, verify, and communicate the real needs of the project stakeholders, including members and end-users, and serves as the conduit for the processes and requirements that flow between the member community and the business units responsible for the systems. For enterprise projects, this position will work closely with the assigned Project Manager to ensure requirements are captured before execution and any changes thereafter are managed through the project's Change Management Plan. This position has beginning-to-intermediate job knowledge and has demonstrated the ability to handle moderate responsibilities relevant to the Business Analyst I role.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Elicit, capture, track, and document business processes and requirements for a given system using best practices by working with the project sponsor and/or product business owner.
    • Elicit processes and requirements from the business.
    • Present processes and requirements to business owners, project teams, and management and obtain agreement from all decision makers on the strategic and tactical direction of the initiative.
    • Perform decomposition of high-level business and user requirements into development and test requirements in collaboration with more-senior BAs or Project Managers
    • Facilitate systems scoping and requirements sessions, independently, with stakeholders.
    • Communicate with the Project Manager (on Enterprise Projects) on scope/requirement changes consistent with the Change Management Plan for the project.
    • Maintain requirements traceability information and tracking requirements status throughout the project.
  • Participate in requirements analysis and verification to ensure that requirement statements are complete, consistent, concise, comprehensible, traceable, feasible, unambiguous, and verifiable, and that they conform to standards.
    • Co-facilitate requirements prioritization with Project Managers and/or more-senior Business Analysts
    • Participate in peer reviews and inspections of Business Requirements Documents and DevOps Boards
    • Participate in the Analysis and validation of project / maintenance release deliverables against project requirements and vision.
    • Participate in documentation of testing requirements, analyze and prepare testing requirements and documentation needs within the format designated for the project.
  • Assist with researching and recommending improvements to business processes, organization, and rules that can increase the advantages gained from technical and non-technical solutions.
    • Document complex multi-system workflows and business processes and pro-actively identify improvements and opportunities.
    • Analyze current process standards and metrics in order to provide solutions for improvements.
    • Perform data gathering, root cause analysis and performance trending to develop appropriate process control changes.
    • Work with the team to recommend appropriate changes in process/approach.
  • Build and grow a network of SMEs across the organization.
  • Participates in teams established/defined by the PMO/more experienced BAs.
  • Demonstrate empathy by understanding the needs of the end user and seeking out problems they may encounter.
  • Contribute to the improvement of the Business Analysis process on a continuous basis.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

About You:

  • A capable independent contributor, as well as a team player
  • Analytical, quantitative, and information sourcing skills
  • Knowledge of software and system development lifecycle (SDLC) preferred.
  • Experience working on Agile Scrum/Kanban teams preferred.
  • Familiarity with Project Management Lifecycle
  • Ability to innovate while solving problems.
  • Accountable for results
  • Ability to participate on multi-disciplinary teams supporting initiatives for strategic business improvements.
  • Effective Time Management skills
  • Exercise sound judgment when performing duties and working with members and staff.
  • Continuously maintains and develops professional skills.
  • Identifies and elevates issues to PMO and QA leadership.
  • Strong Technical/Professional writing and oral communication skills
  • Collaboration with Project Managers and Business Unit Leadership
  • Strong active listening skills and self-awareness throughout the project lifecycle
  • Required Proficiency in software Development/testing tools: Azure Dev Ops, Jira/Confluence, Rally, etc.
  • Required Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365: Word, Excel, Teams, OneNote, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Familiarity with process flow and engineering diagraming tools, such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, etc.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, PowerBI, or comparable analytical/reporting tools

What You Will Need:

  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or equivalent/higher certification preferred.
  • 1-2 years of Business/Technical Analysis or Technical Project experience.
  • Bachelors degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or 4 years of equivalent experience).
  • Capable of completing Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) within two years of hire (may substitute experience).
  • Existing Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or equivalent/higher certification preferred.
  • Required Proficiency
    • Software Development/testing tools: Azure Dev Ops, Jira/Confluence, Rally, etc.
    • Microsoft Office 365: Word, Excel, Teams, OneNote, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity
    • Process flow and engineering diagraming tools, such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, etc.
    • Familiarity with Tableau, PowerBI, or comparable analytical/reporting tools.

Our Team Member Value Proposition:

In exchange for bringing your talent to Gesa, here are a just a few of the benefits and perks we offer:

  • Competitive Pay
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 20 days/year accrual of Paid Time Off - Plus 10 Paid Holidays!
  • 401(k) Match
  • Incentive Program
  • Tuition Assistance and Student Loan Repayment
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Paid Time Off to Volunteer in the Community
  • Product Discounts
  • Engaging Work Environment
  • Rewards and Recognition Program

Salary Range:

$28.16-$42.24

Overview:
Why General Motors Insurance?

At General Motors Insurance, we are building an Insurtech business that will reinvent auto insurance. We are fully owned and backed by auto industry leaders General Motors and GM Financial.

This is a truly unique opportunity to join at the foundational stage of a start-up leading the transformation of the auto insurance experience.

GM has the largest connected vehicle fleet worldwide. In the US alone, there are currently 9M+ connected GM vehicles on the road and that number is projected to triple in the next 10 years. More than that, the OnStar system currently has access to over 900 data points from the vehicle. This surge in information about vehicles and how they are driven will revolutionize auto insurance. This disruption is backed by the bold GM vision of zero crashes, zero emissions and zero congestion. We are serious about the safety and financial security of our customers.

This position will be posted until filled.
Responsibilities:
Within defined guidelines and framework, the Business Analyst II (Claims) - General Motors Insurance will work on business planning, process and projects of varying size and complexity. This role is responsible for supporting opportunities for improvement that align with the strategic initiatives of General Motors Insurance. The Business Analyst II (Claims) will assist in the creation and documentation of claims processes that deliver desired results. The Business Analyst II (Claims) may also participate in projects where they will define scope, drive business alignment and document requirements.

About the role
  • Assist in benefit analysis and defining ROI
  • Define business objectives and goals
  • Identify and document stakeholders and organization impacts
  • Perform gap analysis to determine potential solutions
  • Assist with gathering business needs
  • Aid in facilitation of gathering requirements
  • Provide input to partners assisting with solution design
  • Identify and manage existing and emerging risks that stem from business activities and the job role
  • Create and edit claims workflows and processes
  • Communicate with business partners and stakeholders on ongoing process and technology work
Qualifications:
What makes you a dream candidate?
  • You possess knowledge and understanding of auto claims processes
  • You have professional business analyst experience, including; planning, eliciting, analyzing, validating, documenting and communicating requirements
  • You are experienced working in an agile environment
  • You have understanding of SDLC, P&C industry experience, excellent project management, organizational, and time management skills
  • You are a strong collaborator across multiple business units
  • You have the ability to multi-task: juggle and manage competing tasks and demands and deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events
  • You demonstrate excellent decision making and problem solving skills with the ability to make sound judgments and take the initiative to establish priorities, meet deadlines, and make decisions within the functional area of responsibility with minimal direct supervision
  • You are detailed oriented and have excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills with all levels of the organization
  • You can and enjoy acting as a positive agent of change and consistently demonstrate the ability to adapt to changes in the work environment
  • You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills
  • You are able to communicate concepts and processes in an easy to understand manner to a diverse audience
  • You can to lead change and maintain confidentiality
Experience
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent experience required
  • 2+ years professional business analysis experience required
  • 1+ years of professional experience handling claims or working in a claims department preferred
Licenses
  • IIBA certification preferred
  • AIC or AIS Designation preferred
What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility

Work Life Balance: 100% remote

We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science & Diagnostics , a family-owned company focused on veterinary care.

Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

Must be located in or near Loveland, CO

Job Purpose/Overview
The Customer Support Call Center Data Analyst delivers on the Antech Customer Service Vision of unwavering commitment to empathetic and caring veterinary diagnostic support via the Support Enablement Team . The focus of this role is to extract and interpret critical data from Antech’s CRM and Call Center technology tools. This provides a clear focus on trends affecting the business, specific equipment, specific teams, or specific Customer Support team members. The candidate will be responsible for evaluating large volumes of data as well as partnering with various IT teams to ensure that Customer Support team members have a voice in the creation of superior workflows in the CRM environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Monitor call center performance by analyzing performance statistics and data; identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement

Evaluate and make recommendations regarding production, productivity, quality, and customer-service standards .

Complete audits and determine system improvements; assist with implementing the appropriate changes .

I nteract with Antech’s CRM to determine and retrieve all necessary data for analysis

Prepare and maintain in-depth call center analysis/reporting and present recommendations to management.

Clearly and effectively convey issues, reports, and other deliverables to management.

Have a working understanding of all job functions of the various call center teams .

Responsible for interfacing with IT as needed to maintain the call center technology .

Create , run , and maintain the recommended weekly and monthly report s .

Partner with vendors to ensure that appropriate data is being shared to contribute to the constant improvement of troubleshooting SOPs and the evolution of equipment

Create and manage a “monthly call review synopsis” to the team leads, managers , and directors of queue teams

Provide advanced administrative and analytical support for the customer service teams

Document and maintain relevant topics within the Customer Support knowledge management platform

Performs other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

BA/BS in Mathematics or Computer Science or at least equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred. Masters a plus.

Three years of experience within Call Center environments as it relates to reporting and analysis is required .

Two years of experience with Call Center systems is highly desirable.

Experience in the Veterinary industry is preferred

Prior leadership experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data. Comfortable presenting data to team members within Support Enablement as well as with Leadership of various teams in Customer Support.

Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner ; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully.

Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality.

Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions.

Writes clearly and informatively; edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Able to read and interpret written information.

Balances team and individual responsibilities; Contributes to building a positive team spirit.

Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality.

Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Commits to additional work hours when necessary to reach goals.

Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Asks for and offers help when needed.

Strong ability to evaluate complex problems and analyze customer channels, call center data, drawing conclusions and recommending creative alternatives and solutions.

Demonstrated strength in developing, documenting, maintaining , and explaining procedures/processes and/or solving problems.

Solid business process experience

Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to interface between external and internal clients .

Strong written and oral communication skills and organizational abilities

Solid technology expertise – Microsoft Suite , PowerBI , Salesforce CRM
Travel

Travel requirements could be up to 5 % of the time with peaks and valleys throughout the year.
Working Conditions
The associate is regularly required to apply manual dexterity, including hand/wrist flexibility, for computer keyboarding . The associate frequently is required to sit for extended periods of time, stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The associate is frequently required to hear and speak in order to use the telephone, make presentations and communicate with people in an office or virtual environment. The associate is occasionally required to sit and stoop, bend, kneel, or crouch . The associate must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

The associate will primarily work in a typical office environment or a remote home office . The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The associate will be required to use a computer, spreadsheets, data base management, email, video conferencing and the Internet. The associate is frequently required to use a calculator; fax, copy machine, and phone system . LOCATION 1830 Route 130 North Burlington NJ US 08016

Overview

The Senior Analyst - Store Reporting and BI role will play a critical role in providing data-driven insights to support store operations and strategic decision-making. This role involves developing and maintaining reporting systems, analyzing store performance metrics, and delivering actionable recommendations to improve business outcomes. The role collaborates closely with field leaders and is critical for improving operational execution of Burlington’s off-price business model at the store level. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience with BI tools, expert in Excel and the ability to communicate complex data effectively to various stakeholders in the retail space.

A Day in the Life

  • Execute store analytics and reporting strategy across all areas of business, including data from supporting functions (Supply Chain, HR, AP, Finance, etc.)
  • Collaborate with IT and other business partners to ensure data integrity and availability
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting systems to monitor store performance and key metrics
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement
  • Create and distribute regular and ad-hoc reports to support store and field leaders
  • Utilize BI tools (e.g., Power BI, MicroStrategy) to create dashboards and visualizations that provide clear insights into KPIs
  • Define and manage performance improvement programs from an analytical support standpoint
  • Develop, own, and maintain rigorous requirement documents for reports and dashboards
  • Continuously improve BI processes and tools to enhance data accessibility and usability
  • Identify, investigate and resolve issues with data sources and inputs
  • Create training and support stores and field on data interpretation and report usage
  • Conduct deep-dives into individual store and market issues to support field leader decisions and execution
  • 25% travel required

You'll Come With

  • B.A./M.S. in quantitative disciplines (Economics, Finance, Business, Engineering, Mathematics, etc.)
  • 4+ years of experience in highly analytical roles
  • Financial modeling
  • Practice with database creation and data integration for large data sets
  • Knowledge of data management and reporting platforms
  • Based in U.S. Eastern time zone

Come join our team. You’re going to like it here!

You will enjoy a competitive wage, flexible hours, and an associate discount. Burlington’s benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage including life and disability insurance. Full time associates are also eligible for paid time off, paid holidays and a 401(k) plan.

Location:

This is a remote position that supports the National Security Innovation Network (NSIN) through Eccalon LLC. Hybrid working arrangements are available at our headquarters location in Arlington, VA.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Scientist (Business Intelligence) to join our National Security Innovation Network (NSIN) project and will have the opportunity to serve their country by embedding with key decision makers at the top levels of the U.S. Government. As the Lead Data Scientist, you will be responsible for leading the NSIN Data Cell. This role will join a team already recognized for its standout business analytics. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for the success of internal business operations and the decisions made to meet Government goals, all to drive for greater efficiency and accuracy of executing the mission. This will require the Senior Data Analyst to build insightful reports, research ventures and innovators across the US, and present their products to Government Leadership - all while embodying high standards of Eccalon professionalism.

About the Team:

NSIN is a U.S. Department of Defense (DOD) organization with the mission to build networks of innovators that generate novel solutions to national security problems. NSIN does this by building communities of non-traditional defense problem solvers from the academic and venture communities, exposing these communities to national security problems through direct interaction with DoD end users, and supporting the further development and transition of these solutions into the DOD. The principal way NSIN achieves its mission is through two mutually supporting portfolios of programs: the Talent Portfolio and the Venture Portfolio. In addition, NSIN's Regional Network Team will be physically located in more than nine different regions throughout the United States and is responsible for building new communities of problem solvers through which NSIN executes its programs. For more information regarding NSIN, please visit our site, www.nsin.mil!

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of Data Analysts providing support to NSIN
  • Utilize NSIN?s data and information about innovation in the US for use in analyzing trends and patterns around technology investments.
  • Generate monthly reports on how well NSIN components and the overall enterprise are working based on agency KPIs and OKRs.
  • Support enterprise data migrations for large scale IT projects. Ensure overall data integrity and related attribute data are backed up.
  • Provide 1:1 assistance to the workforce regarding how to record their activities and how to utilize the data for their own products.
  • Track and respond to ad hoc product requests from leaders across the agency in a timely and polite manner.
  • Use data profiling and other discovery techniques to locate anomalies, outliers, and other instances that would cause a bottleneck in business operations.
  • Design and execute models for improved data collection, continually pivoting as needed to support the business.
  • Support the team in maintaining and supporting several activities, including entering and cleaning data, researching data conversions, establishing data specifications, updating sources, and ensuring data integrity.
  • Crosswalking field values and attributes from the origin to the destination while reconciling errors.
  • Mine data for the purposes of experimenting with predictive model prototypes.

Required Qualifications:

  • Possess at least an earned B.A./B.S. degree.
  • A minimum of five years of experience, within the last ten years, working in leading Data Analytics, Business Intelligence (BI), or Database Management, or a combination of all three in a corporate or Government setting.
  • A minimum of five years of experience communicating complex data insights in a professional or academic setting.
  • A minimum of five years of experience, within the last ten years, with relational databases, Database Management System (DBMS), and related programming languages, (e.g., SQL, R, and Python).
  • A minimum of five years of experience with one or more data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Domo, Google Analytics, Salesforce, Power BI, or equivalent tools).
  • A willingness and aptitude to operate successfully as part of a remote, team-based culture. About half of our organization is dispersed throughout the United States, and you'll need to be particularly sympathetic to the remote, asynchronous nature of your teammates' work.
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage timelines.
  • US Citizenship Required.
  • Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A TS clearance with eligibility for SCI at time of proposal submission.
  • Experience leading a team or multiple teams concurrently.
  • Experience implementing large new scale data platforms across a distributed organization.
  • Experience teaching an organization to utilize data as a key component of the decision-making process.

CACI is currently looking for a Business Analyst with agile methodology experience to join our BEAGLE (Border Enforcement Applications for Government Leading-Edge Information Technology) Agile Solution Factory (ASF) Team supporting Customs and Border Protection (CBP) client located in Northern Virginia! Join this passionate team of industry-leading individuals supporting the best practices in Agile Software Development for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

As a member of the BEAGLE ASF Team, you will support the men and women charged with safeguarding the American people and enhancing the Nation’s safety, security, and prosperity. CBP agents and officers are on the front lines, every day, protecting our national security by combining customs, immigration, border security, and agricultural protection into one coordinated and supportive activity.

ASF programs thrive in a culture of innovation and are constantly seeking individuals who can bring creative ideas to solve complex problems, both technical and procedural at the team and portfolio levels.

More About the Role:

  • Serve as an experienced Business/Systems Analyst who has worked in an Agile/Scrum environment, which developed custom software and database applications.

  • Possess both an understanding of real-world mission/business objectives and a working grasp of software development practices and technologies.

  • Serve as the focal point for the capture, analysis, and management of functional and non-functional systems requirements, and user stories.

  • Show a demonstrated skill in effective decomposition of mission/business objectives into requirements contained within a product backlog which can then be implemented in a series of short and iterative development cycles.

  • Review high-level requirements provided by the Product Owner and decompose into user stories.

  • Meet regularly with the Product Owner to review and prioritize the product backlog.

  • Clearly communicate business needs to a development team through user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Provide guidance and clarification of user stories to the development team as a proxy Product Owner.

  • Work closely with the Scrum Master to establish Release/Sprint backlogs, resolve impediments, and provide direction on scope of work to be accomplished.

  • Work collaboratively with the Product Owner and external stakeholders, as well as the product development team during the development cycle to ensure the customer needs are being met.

  • Develop product roadmaps and participate in Integrated Release Planning

  • Review and evaluate work done by development team to ensure proper scope has been met.

  • Identify use cases that are candidates for automated regression tests.

  • Lead the demonstrations to the Product Owner and stakeholders.

  • Willingness to learn and stay abreast of industry trends

You’ll Bring These Qualifications:

  • College degree (B.S.) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Five (5) or more years of experience as a business analyst on iterative software development projects.

  • Experience translating business requirements into user stories, use cases and technical requirements.

  • Experience with functional decomposition of large business needs into multiple layers of requirements/user stories.

  • Creating a product backlog that provides business value to the customer.

  • Strong skills with MS Office tools (Excel, Word, Project, Visio) and Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence)

  • Experience conducting backlog refinement sessions with stakeholders and the Product Owner to gather and validate business requirements.

  • Experience with coaching a development team to understand the business value and mission of the supported product.

  • Experience in Agile Scrum methodologies and estimating techniques.

  • Experience analyzing data and data relationships across an organization’s business areas.

  • Working knowledge of all elements of the software development life cycle, including planning, development, requirements management, CM, quality assurance, and release management.

  • Developing business processes, capability needs, and business requirements.

  • Adaptable and able to work constructively with a technically and geographically diverse team.

  • Must pass a CBP Background Investigation (U.S. Citizenship required)

These Qualifications Would be Nice to Have:

  • Working on Database/Reporting development projects

  • Technical background in data related technologies such as SQL, RDBMS

  • Certified Business Analysis Professional

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


What We Can Offer You:
  • We’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Washington Post.
  • Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives.
  • We offer competitive benefits and learning and development opportunities.
  • We are mission-oriented and ever vigilant in aligning our solutions with the nation’s highest priorities.
  • For over 60 years, the principles of CACI’s unique, character-based culture have been the driving force behind our success.

    At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.


    An environment of trust.

    CACI takes pride in fostering a diverse and accessible culture where every individual feels supported to chart their own path. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.


    A focus on continuous growth.

    Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.


    Your potential is limitless.     So is ours.

    Learn more about CACI here.

A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

As a Data Scientist at White Cap, you will play a key role in our data science team, tackling business challenges using machine learning and other statistical methods. Positioned within the Strategy group, your efforts will be vital in driving insights, informing decision-making, and contributing to key strategic initiatives.

Your role involves leveraging your data science expertise to derive actionable insights from complex data sets, aiding in driving growth and operational efficiency. You will collaborate across departments, providing data-driven guidance and predictive analytics to inform critical business decisions.

In this position, you are not just analyzing data; you are shaping the way our company views and utilizes information. By promoting a data-driven culture and staying updated with the latest industry developments, you will be a driving force in keeping White Cap at the forefront of data-driven innovation. Your work will directly contribute to our business's success, making a tangible impact through the insights and recommendations you provide.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities

  • Advanced Data Analysis and Predictive Modeling : Demonstrate proficiency in Python, Databricks, PySpark, and ML Flow for complex data analysis and predictive modeling. Leverage experience in stochastic and non-stochastic prediction models, including exploratory analysis, time series forecasting, and classification tasks (both supervised and unsupervised).
  • Machine Learning and Large Language Models (LLMs): Work with open-source libraries, including LLMs, Transformers, ML, and forecasting packages. Apply these models to a variety of datasets to extract insights, make predictions, and inform decision-making processes.
  • Innovation and Continuous Learning : Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and big data technologies. Explore new tools and techniques to improve existing processes and contribute to innovation within the team.
  • Data modelling and quality assurance: work with raw data to transform it into a format suitable for analysis and reporting; build pipelines that conduct data validation and implement quality controls.
  • Business intelligence : Experience using BI platforms (PowerBI, Tableau) to transform data into easy-to-understand visualizations, applying necessary filters and groupings to isolate business value.
  • Experimental Design and Rigor : Demonstrate strong skills in experimental design. Develop robust experiments and models with high levels of rigor to ensure accuracy, reproducibility, and reliability of results. This includes test / control baselines and performance reporting.
  • Cloud Computing and Big Data Technologies : Leverage Azure Cloud services for data storage, processing, and analytics. Implement scalable solutions and manage large datasets effectively.
  • Pricing expertise (as applicable): Has experience in pricing analytics, which includes product grouping methodologies, customer segmentation, price benchmarking; incorporates analytics expertise and practical business outcomes to arrive at solution.

Nature and Scope

  • Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
  • Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct customers of the process.
  • May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support or professional personnel.

Work Environment

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
  • Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Education and Experience

Typically requires BS/BA in a related field. Generally 2-5 years of experience in a related field OR MS/MA and generally 0-2 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 2+ years’ experience managing and maintaining complex Alteryx data models
  • 3 years of demonstrated Python and any other OOP (object-oriented language).
  • Experience with Databricks is desirable but not required.
  • Experience working with Python Data and Scientific libraries such as: Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Matplotlib.
  • 2-4 years of experience in data modeling, data science, or related fields, with specific experience in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Although portfolios are not required, they are highly encouraged and will be reviewed. Please keep your portfolio in the following formats:

  • Personal Websites
  • Github repos (please make sure they are public)
  • Google Colab notebooks (please make sure they are public)

POSITION SUMMARY:

Are you interested in diving into data, extracting the story to help others see the benefit of data-based decision-making? In this role, you are a Business Leader: you should be an effective communicator, aspiring, and able to drive insights into actions that improve Sysco’s business results.

You’ll need to mine multiple sources of data, including syndicated data (NPD, Technomic’s, etc.), derive actionable insights, and translate complex results into simple conclusions that will empower others to take action to win with our customers.

You will present key insights that will educate and influence Business and Executive leadership to identify opportunities and drive profitable growth. With a combination of analytical expertise, data and system knowledge and business acumen, you’ll answer and anticipate critical business questions and opportunities and deliver critical insights to the business in ways that make significant impacts. You will drive strategic thinking on critical growth initiatives and lead analytics and design.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define strategic analytical approach to execute critical projects, lead advanced analytics, and present key findings to business leaders
  • Own strategic recommendations from data analytics on product lifecycle management
  • Think out-of-the-box on creating and implementing new strategies driven by data
  • Drive continuous improvement projects to deliver meaningful insights based on strategic KPIs, hypotheses, and metrics
  • Collaborate with cross functional team of business leaders to define and influence category strategies through data-driven insights and advanced analytics
  • Work with leadership throughout Sysco to frame business opportunities and develop appropriate analytic strategies
  • Lead problem solving sessions to develop analytical solutions that contribute to the overall profitability of Sysco
  • Develop in-depth business, analytical and systems knowledge to improve or build analytical solutions, approaches, and business recommendations
  • Design & develop appropriate mechanisms for tracking & performance management (e.g., Tableau dashboards, reports)
  • Lead training and collaboration of cross functional stakeholders
  • Lead in the development of team culture, mentoring other associates, and development of skills and processes

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's Degree required (Business, Computer Science, or Analytics degree preferred), Master’s degree a plus
  • 4 years of relevant professional experience required

SKILLS:

  • Understanding of business value drivers and corresponding business impact
  • Strategic thinking skills (making complex decisions, innovation, dealing with ambiguity, etc.) as well as excellent analytic, and quantitative skills
  • Problem-solving skills with proven ability to influence others across the organization
  • Self-motivated individual who is comfortable working with diverse business scenarios, handling multiple priorities and have a business & consultancy mind-set, while technically (data) savvy
  • Passion about discovering new things and ability to learn quickly
  • Good communication skills, self-motivated, dynamic, reciprocal, and "can-do" attitude
  • Data management and visualization skills / tools (SQL, Tableau, PowerBI or similar)
  • Collaborative team player who can effectively work in a matrix/cross-functional organization
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Experience with syndicated data (NPD, Technomic’s, Nielsen IRI, etc.)
  • Project management capabilities preferred
  • Experience working in distribution, retail, or wholesale industry preferred

BENEFITS INFORMATION:

For information on Sysco’s Benefits, please visit https://SyscoBenefits.com

Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations.

We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. Description

Lead, Data Analytics – Interaction Analytics

The Global Product Management (GPM) organization is responsible for driving the business performance of all research products. The Research Business Analytics (RBA) team, a part of GPM, conducts analysis related to all aspects of Gartner's Research & Advisory organization. This includes analyzing client value drivers such as research content, client interactions, and the role of research in conferences and events. RBA also supports the Research & Advisory (R&A) organization by providing analysis on client retention, associate performance, budget and financial analysis (in partnership with the Finance organization), and client demand sensing. Our team plays a critical role in providing data, insights, and analytical tools to enable fact-based decision making and drive continuous improvement in our business, both operationally and strategically.

We are seeking an experienced Data Analytics Lead who is a highly analytical problem solver, possesses a strong technical understanding of data and data systems, and demonstrates exceptional leadership skills to join our growing team.

This role will primarily be responsible for end-to-end ownership of deliverables related to client interactions, as well as associated assets such as proposal reviews and conference interactions. Initiatives and projects will involve tasks such as data definition, data extraction, technical understanding of Gartner data, analysis for insights, developing recommendations, visualizing data, and scaling through automated visualizations and reporting. Sample objectives are:

  • Build end-to-end dashboards that communicate the performance of our interactions including root causes and insights of upcoming trends, areas of bright spots and opportunity

  • Standardize and automate the ways we measure impact of each interaction across the entitled licensed user base considering target role / industry / geography and other factors

  • Build mechanisms to measure current performance and improvement opportunities for interactions including what metrics matter, e.g. Inquiry cycle time, Due date achievement, Topic coverage, etc.

  • Analytically determining diminishing returns on interactions volume and frequency (by role, topic, etc.)

  • In collaboration with other teams, improve interactions reporting (e.g., interactions scorecard, operation reviews), dashboards, and automation

What you’ll do:

  • Build expertise to be the center of excellence on Gartner research and client interactions with deep knowledge of the data across source systems, the data warehouse, and dashboards / reports. Ensure the analysis is robust and reliable, providing data and guidance to other Gartner teams.

  • Partner with stakeholders from IT, R&A Strategy & Operations, Research Engagement Services, and Global Product Management to understand business needs and identify capabilities that enhance our analysis. Prioritize efforts based on business impact, fostering seamless communication and change management across relevant stakeholder organizations.

  • Structure and analyze large datasets to derive meaningful insights and actionable information.

  • Play an integral role in developing and continuously improving a methodology to measure client engagement and, thereby, impact of interactions for Gartner.

  • Execute on the approach to deliver functionality iteratively.

  • Be accountable for project plans / timelines, overall products (ex. KPI) including design and data infrastructure, prioritization for team and problem solving.

  • Continuous improvement: Proactively identify and implement improvement initiatives.

  • Communicate findings effectively, building outputs that clearly convey the root causes and provide a clear story for solving business problems.

  • Mentor other team members, providing guidance and support in their day-to-day work, and managing the workload across the team to ensure efficient and effective execution of tasks.

What you will need:

  • Experience: 5-7 years of progressive business experience involving advanced business analytics, complex problem solving, business strategy

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree required. Degree with a concentration in statistics, data science, mathematics, engineering, computer science, or operations research preferred.

  • Exceptional problem solving: Proven track record of solving complex problems, critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and innovation.

  • Strong technical understanding of data and skills to analyze as well as visualize it, including:

    • Ability to conduct statistical analysis to identify patterns and trends in data, ensuring objectivity and minimizing bias by applying appropriate models, methodologies, and calculations

    • Programming languages e.g. Python, R, SQL

    • Data visualization tools e.g. Tableau, Power BI

    • Attention to detail e.g. data hygiene, quality checks, documentation, etc.

  • Rigorous prioritization and working in fast-paced environments: Track record of success in environments with competing and continuously evolving priorities.

  • Collaboration and stakeholder management: Strong collaboration and influencing skills in a highly matrixed environment. Influencing stakeholders and team members based on a command of the facts, analysis, and implications.

  • Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication – structured, engaging and compelling.

  • Challenge the standard thinking with new ideas, approaches, and solutions which focus on process improvement and growth
  • Act as Subject Matter Expert for provider data and impacts to downstream processes
  • Perform any other job related duties, as requested

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience is required
  • Minimum of five (5) years of health care data analysis or project management experience is required

  • Six Sigma or other performance improvement experience is preferred
  • Managed care experience is preferred

The Senior Data Analyst will support our Insurance Sales, Service, and Operations teams. This individual will utilize data analytics, analysis, & reporting to provide key stakeholders with the information needed to make strategic business decisions and develop unique solutions to enhance our Agency's growth. A primary focus for this role will be supporting our Insurance Sales Center workforce management and telephony operations by building reports, analyzing data, and making recommendations to the business.

The primary duties of the Senior Insurance Analyst, Digital Transformation are to:

  • Establish data analytics processes, roles, quality criteria, and performance metrics to support Agency leadership in achieving performance objectives.

  • Identify, develop, and implement scalable data strategy, self-service tools, and workflow automation.

  • Analyze and report data associated with sales, service and operational effectiveness, member retention, and project/product performance.

  • Identify and evaluate the business value of new and existing data sources and uncover significant trends that will affect the organization in optimizing business decisions.

  • Ensure the quality and accuracy of data results and analytic methods through the establishment of testing and validation procedures and best practices.

  • Prioritize, scope, and recommend enterprise integrations and key performance indicators (KPIs) for projects across multiple business lines.

  • Participate in project plans, timelines, and deliverables, and manage Agency resources.

  • Advocate for data analytics practices and technology to senior stakeholders.

  • Select and implement (or oversee implementation) all data analytics tools and frameworks.

  • Execute quality controls and testing for ensuring project deliverables meet user expectations.

  • Working with Enterprise counterparts to assure the Agency complies with the data governance framework.

To the qualified candidate, we offer:

  • The starting base compensation for this position is $53,341 to $105,965 annually. The base pay range shown is a guideline for compensation and ultimate salary offered will be based on factors such as applicant experience and geographic location.

  • Annual Bonus eligibility

  • 8 Paid Company Holidays

  • Nearly 4 weeks of Paid Time Off

  • 401(k) plan with company match up to 7%

  • Medical, Dental, Vision & Prescription Coverage

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Complimentary AAA Membership

  • FREE Life Insurance

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) or equivalent in Insurance, Business Administration, or related field, with at least 4 years’ experience in an analytics or technical project management environment, or the equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • Proficient in analytics tools such as SQL, Excel, R, Tableau or PowerBI, Python, Adobe, or Google Analytics.

  • Proficiency with call center data analytics and analysis (speech, text, cross-channel, predictive, and performance).

  • Conduct in-depth analyses of data to identify trends, patterns, and relationships, and summarize findings clearly and concisely for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Exceptional analytical, communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities

  • Work with project teams to understand the business objectives of each project and ensure that data analytics is used to its fullest potential to achieve these goals

  • Develop detailed reports and presentations to communicate results of data analysis to key stakeholders, providing recommendations for further action based on findings

Salary: $42.59 - $57.40 Per Hour

SUMMARY

Community Programs is a program office within Health Services Administration, a division under the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services (DHS). Community Program’s mission is to improve the health and wellbeing of LA County’s people experiencing homelessness by providing housing and intensive care management services. In addition to other responsibilities this position may participate in the tracking, reporting, quality assurance, and billing efforts for CalAIM, a Medi-Cal waiver program. They will be on a team of analysts who will be providing data collection, analytic, and billing support for CalAIM services tracking and Medi-Cal billing while simultaneously building dashboards and providing regular descriptive analyses.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Reporting and Analysis
    • Assists department stakeholders to define data needs and requirements to ensure data science projects meet business needs at the community, regional, divisional, departmental, or county-wide level
    • Uses statistical programming languages and packages, computer scripting languages, and/or domain-specific languages to digest, manipulate, prepare, augment, evaluate, analyze, summarize, and visualize data
    • Conducts end-to-end predictive data modeling projects that include basic exploratory data analysis, model selection, deployment of models into production environments, and visualization of findings
    • Performs data management and manipulation, including the writing of data queries of departmental databases, data cleaning, and joining of multiple and disparate data sets
    • Extracts and organizes data and applies quality-control techniques to ensure the accuracy and completeness of all data; researches source documents and coordinates with others to resolve missing or conflicting data and other anomalies
    • Ensures regular reporting occurs within specified deadlines
    • Regularly creates deliverables for special projects and assignments, such as ad-hoc department reporting and program analyses
    • Creates documentation for the processes and procedures used for reporting and analyses
  • Tool Development and Maintenance
    • Collaborates with other department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal and external data sources
    • Helps refine program management practices through the creation of new reporting and analytical tools
    • Helps to design, build, and maintain analytical support tools to be used within the Department of Health Services, by housing and service providers, and by other external stakeholders
  • Project Support:
    • Collaborates with data administrators and other IT staff to develop data pipelines and ensure the availability of quality data
    • Convenes and facilitates discussions with stakeholders to design and implement tools and reports
    • Manages the design, development, implementation and maintenance of reports, dashboards and analysis tools
  • Program and Provider Support
    • Works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision- making.
    • Assists in coordinating with various functional teams to develop and implement products, services, tools, or business process changes resulting from the analysis.
    • Provides regular analyses of the impact of changes in management practices and policies
    • Designs program reports, analyzes performance, and provides resulting analyses to stakeholders

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate has experience working directly with a client-centric relational database and with managing individuals. They have strong technical knowledge and are comfortable doing analyses and building reports out of a SQL database. They are comfortable with a variety of analytical tools and have taken the lead on projects where the best path forward is unclear. They have a customer service mindset.

Education/Experience

A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis -AND- Two (2) years of experience in the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs leading to actionable findings and recommendations -OR- A Master’s or Doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health.

Summary

As an Lead Data/Business Analyst (Healthcare) at Gainwell, you can contribute your skills as we harness the power of technology to help our clients improve the health and well-being of the members they serve — a community’s most vulnerable. Connect your passion with purpose, teaming with people who thrive on finding innovative solutions to some of healthcare’s biggest challenges. Here are the details on this position.

Your role in our mission

  • Reviews, analyzes, and evaluates data/systems business requirements for existing and new development
  • Documents technical and business specifications and functional needs and modifies existing requirements
  • Leads the data analysis and profile efforts for new client implementations and system enhancements

  • Provides data mappings, user interface specifications, processing logic as per business requirements to the Developer

  • Tests development efforts and provides feedback to the technical team
  • Creates and documents meeting notes and distributes to team
  • Assists with provisioning new users and Operational Readiness Review tasks
  • Provides regular status reports to accounts, developers, and management as needed
  • Provides mentorship and guidance to junior Analysts on the team as needed

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of Business/data analysis experience
  • US Healthcare payor experience is a must
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must
  • Experience working with different database structures (e.g., transaction based vs. data warehouse)
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau a plus

What you should expect in this role

  • Plus: Knowledge or certifications in software development methodologies like Scrum, the capability to lead cross-functional teams to meet project deadlines, and familiarity with relational database and client-server concepts. Additionally, they should possess excellent communication skills to develop professional relationships and thrive in handling multiple engagements simultaneously.
  • Fully remote opportunity with the option to work anywhere within the United States

About Oshkosh Defense, an Oshkosh company
Oshkosh Defense stands behind those who dedicate their lives to protecting others. As an industry-leading tactical vehicle manufacturer, every day we strive to meet or exceed our customers' ever-changing needs with next generation defense technologies and advanced systems. We operate with unparalleled commitment to those who depend on our products and services worldwide to perform their missions.
JOB SUMMARY:
As a key member in the Advanced Data Analytics team, the Data Analyst will work with this and a cross-functional team to develop and execute the data analytics strategy and apply to Oshkosh Corporation products. Advanced Data Analytics wok encompasses the acquisition, processing and machine learning of engineering or service data and application to preventive maintenance and intelligent control of on or off-road vehicles.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.
  • Collaborate with other team members to execute the data science and analytics strategy in cross-segment telematics and other Corporate Engineering efforts.
  • Acquire necessary business understanding to conduct appropriate analysis through communication with internal experts, external partners, and industrial researchers.
  • Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from a variety of sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests.
  • Help identify valuable data sources and automate related tasks (ETL, reporting, etc.).
  • Conduct data science and analytics work in a Big Data (Hadoop) ecosystem.
  • Undertake the processing of structured and unstructured data. Analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns.
  • Use various machine learning algorithms to build most effective and useful models. Present information using data visualization techniques and chart/dashboard tools.
  • Prepare and concisely deliver analysis results in visual and written forms that communicate data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Recognize valuable problems requiring advanced analytical techniques to solve and help develop and investigate research strategies towards industrial solutions.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science (or STEM or related field) and three (3) or more years of proven data-centric work experience; OR graduate degree in data science (or a related field with applicable work experience).
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Understand the general concepts of statistics, data mining, machine learning, data visualization, information retrieval, artificial intelligence, and computer vision.
  • Strong proficiency with Python (Anaconda distribution) and SQL. Experience with other languages (Bash, R, Java, C++, Scala, etc.).
  • Experience with big data tools and architectures, such as Cloudera/Apache Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, Kudu, Impala, and Spark.
  • Working knowledge of telematics interfaces and streaming solutions (MQTT, NiFi, Kafka, HBASE, etc.).
  • Prior experience in industrial and/or manufacturing environments desired, and any experience with automotive or heavy duty on or off-road vehicles and controller area network (CAN) signals is a plus.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem solving skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • Display excellent interpersonal skills as well as the ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from leadership and peers.
  • Strongly motivated in learning new technologies and skills in data fields.
WORKING CONDITIONS:
  • Physical Demands: Frequent: Standing, Walking/Running, Sitting, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing; Occasional: Driving, Bending/Kneeling, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing, Fine Dexterity, Manual Dexterity.
