Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver.

Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable.

Position Summary

  • Facilitates provider and member outreach to ensure member receipt of important clinical services to improve member health outcomes.
  • Provides support for Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) quality initiatives and regulatory/contractual requirements including outreach to providers regarding members who are noncompliant in the designated outreach services.
  • Supports effective medical record capture for HEDIS medical record review and abstraction of both HEDIS Hybrid and supplemental data.
  • Identifies potential resources and initiates collaboration with providers to improve member health outcomes and HEDIS measures.
  • Assists in the development and distribution of educational information to members and providers in accordance with the HEDIS outreach work plan (mailings, text messaging, automated calls, etc.)
  • Assists in the development and standardization of outreach documentation and manages the data flow process to complete HEDIS documentation.
  • Documents member participation in outreach activities in accordance with abstraction and audit standards.
  • Conducts HEDIS provider chart request calls and mailings.
  • May develop and maintain member incentive programs to support HEDIS initiatives.
  • Assists with maintenance of incentive database to track member compliance.
  • May identify opportunities to partner with community organizations on special events and presentations (i.e., health fairs and community events).
  • Works with internal staff to schedule, organize, and staff these events.
  • Records and documents all member and provider outreach activity.
  • Ability to analyze data and report on findings to providers regarding gaps in care
  • Performs other duties as required.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years' recent and related health care marketing, outreach and/or health education experience.

  • Exceptional communication and persuading skills
  • The ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team atmosphere
  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, environment where you may have to wear multiple hats
  • Strong clerical skills, including ability to use standard corporate software packages and corporate applications. (ie. Microsoft Office, Quickbase…)
  • The ability to write an appropriate and professional email.
  • Willingness to learn.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Recent and related experience working with HEDIS criteria
  • Experience speaking with medical providers.


Education

  • Associate Degree or equivalent experience

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$19.52 - $36.78

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

In addition to your compensation, enjoy the rewards of an organization that puts our heart into caring for our colleagues and our communities. The Company offers a full range of medical, dental, and vision benefits. Eligible employees may enroll in the Company’s 401(k) retirement savings plan, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan is also available for eligible employees. The Company provides a fully-paid term life insurance plan to eligible employees, and short-term and long term disability benefits. CVS Health also offers numerous well-being programs, education assistance, free development courses, a CVS store discount, and discount programs with participating partners. As for time off, Company employees enjoy Paid Time Off (“PTO”) or vacation pay, as well as paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Number of paid holidays, sick time and other time off are provided consistent with relevant state law and Company policies.

For more detailed information on available benefits, please visit jobs.CVSHealth.com/benefits

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 08/19/2024

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Ready to help us transform healthcare? Bring your true colors to blue.

What We Need

The Lead Data Analyst will support delivery across multiple data platforms including the cloud-based Data Analytics Layer (DAL) and the on-prem Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW). The Lead Data Analyst will support new solutions, enhancements, operational changes, and the migration of existing EDW applications and solutions to the DAL. The Lead Data Analyst will work closely with technology vendor partners to support data ingestion, transformation, storage, and delivery for operational and analytical solutions. This role will work closely with data scrum teams including developers, testers, scrum masters, product owners, and subject matter experts.

As a member of the Agile scrum team, the Lead Data Analyst will conduct spike analysis to support estimation, scheduling, and backlog refinement activities. They will enhance user stories with technical specifications to support development and testing. This role will participate or lead cross-functional team meetings as a representative of the Data Analytics and Insights team to ensure capabilities, technology, resource capacity, and delivery status are communicated and understood by enterprise partners. This role will also work with developers and testers to address open questions and clarify requirements and specifications defined in user stories.

Your Day to Day
Lead cross-divisional project teams in the implementation of data driven projects for consumers, providers, and accounts.
Create data specific artifacts supporting portfolio initiatives, projects, and operational enhancements.
Act as liaison with internal and external (vendor) teams to deliver requirements, specifications, and definitions required for successful Agile implementation.
Participate in scrum ceremonies and support the definition of epics and user stories using Jira.
Build, organize, and maintain and process, technical, and solution specific content including design documents, roadmaps, data mapping, reference documents, and workflows in Confluence.

We’re Looking for:
Deep knowledge of healthcare data domains including (but not limited to) enrollment, account, claims, providers, products, digital, clinical, financial, and wellness data.
Designs, develops, and programs operational data integration, extracts, reports, dashboards, and scorecards to support complex business needs of internal partners.
Leverages an expansive knowledge of structured query language (SQL) to program and creates reports for the informatics/analyst community.
Builds deep knowledge of healthcare domain by engaging in delivery, operations, & analytics initiatives
Provides complex operational analysis on healthcare data sets and maintains Health Informatics web content.
Assists in the data definitions requirements critical to the successful implementation of data-driven projects through the development of effective working relationships with key internal and external customers.
Knowledge and understanding of data ingestion, transformation, storage, security, and exchange.
Experience developing queries using data mining and/or business intelligence tools.
Experience translating enterprise requirements into technical specifications for development teams.
Knowledge of data validation approaches to confirm and document results meet expectations.
Ability to estimate, inform, and negotiate expectations that meet enterprise partner and technical delivery needs.
Experience working on Agile teams to deliver ongoing value throughout the entire product lifecycle.

What You Bring:
Bachelors degree preferred
10+ years data analyst experience
5+ years of experience in healthcare
5+ years of experience using SQL and BI tools

What You’ll Gain:
It is our mission at Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts to foster a culture that enables associates to do their best work while living happy and healthy lives. That's why we offer you a variety of ways to support your best physical, emotional, financial, and social well-being. For more information on our benefit offerings, visit https://careers.bluecrossma.org/us/en/benefits

High school degree or equivalent required unless otherwise noted above

C-UAS Signals Data Analyst

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

What You’ll Get to Do:

As a CACI-SOAS C-UAS Signals Data Analyst, you will conduct data analysis of specialized C-UAS threat systems’ data to assist with Department of Defense (DoD) Force Protection (FP) efforts to understand, minimize and mitigate the threat posed by Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) against critical infrastructure, locations, assets and personnel. You will develop operational analytical products utilizing C-UAS system data through the exploitation and processing of the raw data and the other related C-UAS data sources that aids operational planners develop force protection efforts to detect, identify, monitor and track UAS activity. You will support assessments that could be used to obtain operationally actionable information augmenting DoD’s responsibility to mitigate the threat posed by UAS systems while ensuring to adhere to 10 USC 130i requirements/restrictions.

As required, you will interact directly with supported DoD customers to develop comprehensive analytical products that inform a variety of activities to protect critical infrastructure, providing an enhanced risk picture for DoD that enables and informs risk-based decision making for force protection efforts of possible UAS threat activity against installations, assets and personnel. As required, you will participate in the development and fielding of operational and analytical tools and techniques that enhance the organization’s ability to ingest, collate, search and tailor UAS related data to meet customer requirements.

More About the Role:

You will work as part of a multifunctional team of operations analysts, operational outreach, technologists and subject matter experts to assist DoD customers with fusing C-UAS systems’ data and operational information to enhance their effectiveness against UAS threats and force protection efforts. You will identify and analyze problems, and generate recommended solutions based upon experience working with elements of the DoD.

You will directly support DoD organizations and agencies tasked with the mission of UAS threat and security assessment with special emphasis on understanding and countering the growing threat posed by unmanned aerial systems (UAS). You will collect, collate, assemble, fuse, analyze and deliver tailored answers to requests for support. You will be expected to become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the capabilities, tactical employment and distribution of UAS that adversaries could use to disrupt, disable or defeat capabilities to defend critical infrastructure.

You will work closely with other members of your team to identify capabilities and vulnerabilities of UAS systems that could attack critical infrastructure; identify trends, patterns, and highlight vulnerabilities that could be exploited to defeat them.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications:

  • Current Top Secret/Specialized Compartmented Information (SCI) Security Clearance.
  • More than one year of C-UAS and/or Force Protection Operations-Intelligence analytic experience (tactical and/or operational levels) with DoD, US and/or interagency partners in the past five years (Department of Defense, Department of Homeland Security or Federal law enforcement agencies preferred but not required).
  • More than three years of operations-intelligence and/or security or Force Protection related analytic experience.
  • Practical understanding of unmanned aerial systems with specific emphasis on Groups 1-3 Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS), their capabilities, technical performance, and operational employment.
  • Practical understanding of geospatial Intel tools such as ArcGIS and Google Earth.
  • Bachelor’s degree and more than three years of experience, or an associate degree and five years of experience, or seven years of relevant work experience. We will also consider candidates with four years of directly relevant experience.
  • Must be a US citizen.

These Qualifications Would be Nice to Have:

  • More than three years of experience conducting operations-intelligence network analysis in support of C-UAS, HVI, attack the network or CT operations - including counter-facilitation.
  • More than three years of experience providing counter-threat operations-intelligence support and/or asymmetric threat analysis.
  • More than three years working on a Force Protection staff or as a Force Protection planner.
  • More than ten years of military experience, and/or a combination of military and IC Agency experience, including recent combat deployments, and be well-versed in all areas of military intelligence, C-UAS, security and/or force protection.
  • Practical understanding of unmanned aerial systems with specific emphasis on Groups 1-3 Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS), their capabilities, technical performance, and operational employment.
  • Practical understanding of MS Office, Excel, or other data visualization tools and big-data analytic techniques for structured and unstructured data.
  • Practical understanding of network analysis tools.
  • Familiarity with Counter-Unmanned Systems such a as Windtalker, Ninja, Skyview, Corian, Drake, Toruk Ground Segment (TGS).
  • Practical understanding of geospatial Intel tools such as ArcGIS and Google Earth.

What We Can Offer You:

  • CACI-Special Operations and Asymmetric Solutions Operating Group resides within CACI’s Operations Support and Services Sector. As the premier provider of Special Operations capabilities; Tactical Advisory and Embedded Support; intelligence Applications to Law Enforcement; security cooperation and OCONUS Training Support Delivery for the company, CACI-SOAS has a reputation for uncompromising standards of quality in its people and its performance. Joining the CACI-SOAS team is a mark of excellence for those employees who complete our rigorous Mission-Focused Staffing process.
  • CACI-SOAS’s mission places its personnel against the government’s most critical emerging challenges. Work with us, and you’ll be working with a team making a difference across the globe.
  • CACI-SOAS offers competitive benefits, generous flex time off as well as numerous learning and development opportunities.
  • As the Prime Contractor for this effort, CACI-SOAS offers unmatched stability and growth potential within the program.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

______________________________________________________________________________

What You Can Expect:


A culture of integrity.

Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

  • The Front Office Services team (FOS) is part of the Investment Management COO Office and is situated within the front office
  • You will interface directly with the Investment team, including Portfolio Managers and Traders to support their change needs
  • You will provide Investment business consultancy and project support on strategic projects and working groups
  • Act as an intermediary and escalation point for the front office into other business areas and externally
  • Provide detailed analysis and documentation to support front office change requirements
  • Manage the implementation and support testing of change occurring within the Investment department

  • Generous Holiday policies
  • Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to ClassPass
  • Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community
  • Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more
  • All-inclusive approach to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
  • Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services
  • Complimentary subscription to Headspace – the mindfulness app
  • Unique employee events and programs including a 14er challenge
  • Complimentary beverages, snacks and all employee Happy Hours

Must have skills

  • Good experience and knowledge of the asset management business, including security types, front office workflows and fund structures
  • Experience supporting Investment teams or similar Business Analyst experience in the Finance industry
  • Ability to anticipate business needs and differentiate between priorities
  • Flexibility to take on a variety of tasks with the ability to easily context switch and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience stewarding projects involving buy-in and cooperation from stakeholders across multiple areas of the business and external
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working collaboratively across different teams and departments, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to understand complex issues and problems, distill into actionable components and identify pragmatic solutions

Nice to have skills

  • Charles River OMS knowledge
  • Project management experience
  • General understanding of the middle and back office support of the investment management industry
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite including Project, JIRA, Confluence and AHA!

Potential for growth

  • Mentoring
  • Leadership development programs
  • Regular training
  • Career development services
  • Continuing education courses

For those in scope of Knowledge & Competence (MiFID II)

  • Knowledge of financial markets, financial markets function and the impact of economic figures and national/regional/global events on markets
  • Understanding of issues relating to market abuse and anti-money laundering
  • Annual attestation

If you need any reasonable accommodations during our recruitment process, please get in touch and let us know at recruiter@janushenderson.com.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000-$110,000. This range is estimated for this role. Actual pay may be different. This position will be posted until August 31, 2024.

raw_job_description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.

Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University, we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.

Opportunity:

The Senior Data Analyst will provide data-driven insights to DeVry’s management. This position will research data sources from DeVry applications and third parties. They will assess data volume, structure, quality, integrity, completeness in preparation for data preparation, ingestion, and transformation. They will participate in data governance and document meta data and -lineage using guidance from application- and data owners. They will review requirements helping them to build and enhance data models that satisfy DeVry’s information needs. They will perform ongoing data analysis, and as needed may create data dashboards helping to convey the state of data. The individual will work collaboratively with data architects, data engineers, SQL developers, and data integration specialists to provide data management-related technical assistance and recommendations.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand, and document business requirements and acceptance criteria in the form of epics and user stories for complex data projects.
  • Engage with business stakeholders, challenge assumptions and help build scalable analytical solutions.
  • Interpret, collect, wrangle, join and create new data models from a variety of different sources required for various DeVry business functions,
  • Build sufficient contextual data knowledge to provide data concierge services.
  • Document calculations, code, and lineage in Azure PurView adhering to data management best practices,
  • Validate and test data assets,
  • Identify and lead the remediation of data quality issues impacting our ability to create trusted data models,
  • Combine analytical-, exploratory skills, and data intuition to combine data from various sources to deliver new insights.
  • Enable a scalable data foundation that enables advanced analytical insights providing data as a self-service,
  • Occasionally build business friendly dashboards in Microsoft Power BI
  • Be a trusted advisor for business functions looking for data and insights.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • BS/MS in Data Management or equivalent experience
  • Proficient with SQL, Python, PowerBI
  • 5-7 years' experience as a Data Analyst including some experience in data engineering, analytics, insights and reporting, with increasing responsibility in a growth environment preferably in a Higher Education environment that uses Ellucian Banner as a Student Information System.
  • Some exposure to data governance
  • Ability to tell “data stories” demonstrating the ability to articulate business value
  • Problem solver and adaptive
  • Business knowledge and IT business analysis skills to translate business requirements into data needs
  • Ability to adapt to ambiguity and adjust plans to meet changing needs
  • Knowledge of visualization best practices
  • Must be motivated and be able to contribute in fast paced environment while maintaining quality of performance
DeVry University offers competitive wages and benefit options, including:


  • 401(k) and Roth Plan w/match
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Health Advocacy Service
  • Family and Domestic Partner Coverage
  • Tax Savings Account (FSA and HSA)
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • Life, Accident, AD&D, Critical Illness Insurance
  • Fertility Coverage
  • Wellness Programs
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Remote and Flex Work Options
  • Technology Stipend
  • Paid Tuition Program
  • Auto/Homeowners, Pet and Legal Insurance
  • Exclusive Discount Programs
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Career Development Programs
  • Mental Health Care Programs
  • Family Care Services
  • 2nd.MD, a virtual expert medical consultation service

Benefits vary based on employment status. Part-time/Visiting Professors positions may not be eligible for all benefits.
We believe diversity is essential to our educational mission and to the success of our community. We are committed to fostering a working environment where differences are respected, valued and embraced.

Job Description
There’s a reason the Oscars feature an award for Best Supporting Actor. Even the most high-profile, successful actors need assistance to do their best work.
As Oregon’s leading workers’ compensation insurance company, SAIF provides critical aid to workers, businesses, and communities across the state. Our corporate services division, which delivers an outstanding performance in ensuring that the rest of the organization runs smoothly, would be a key contender for a Best Supporting Actor award.
We’re looking for a data analyst to join our stellar cast in corporate services to help optimize processes and procedures across the organization. The key functions of this role are business analysis, data analytics, and project coordination. The role also includes development of divisional policies and procedures, strategic planning, and divisional project prioritization and goal-setting.
To succeed, you’ll need three or more years in business analysis, data analytics, project coordination, or similar roles. If this sounds like you, act now and apply!
Note: Flexible workers may be required to travel to SAIF’s offices in Salem on occasion. This position requires the selected candidate to be located in Oregon full-time.
Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with management to prioritize business and information needs.
  • Assist corporate services division (CSD) leadership in tracking key initiatives and their status through initiative reporting and updates.
  • Research requested initiative areas to ensure an in-depth understanding of the issues and best practices.
  • Identify and define new process improvement opportunities.
  • Be aware of divisional operations and processes and recommend when root cause analysis should be conducted and presented to senior leadership.
  • Assist with or lead writing reports such as root cause analysis, business case, executive summaries, project summaries and others as needed.
Data Analytics
  • Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques, and provide ongoing reports and dashboards. Convert data into relevant management information for monitoring and evaluating operational performance.
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in data sets.
  • Perform data analytical tasks for assigned projects.
  • Provide data and assist management with quarterly enterprise reporting. Analyze results for reasonableness, completeness, or discrepancies and communicate any questions or concerns to team members.
  • Work with management to establish SLAs and KPIs and manage the reporting of those metrics. Present findings to team members clearly and concisely.
Project Coordination/ Management
  • Manage one or more, low to moderately complex divisional projects. Lead assigned projects through implementation utilizing project management best practices.
  • Assist with the creation of project plans that establish objectives, define the project scope, assumptions, risks, and overall project approach including project resource needs, timelines, and communications.
  • Partner with key staff to identify, develop, and deliver communication strategies and written materials informing, educating, and promoting division initiatives, and process and systems changes.
  • Identify, track, and manage task ownership and deadlines, issues, action items, and status of all deliverables, maintaining documentation and reporting.
  • Serve as a liaison and spokesperson for the assigned project(s) and negotiate goals, objectives, and deadlines with business partners.
  • Assist in development of project budget, monitor expenditures throughout the project, and manage variances.
  • Support required elements of all corporate programs and track divisions and business partner work and timelines.
Additional functions:
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of division policies and procedures.
  • Maintain the SharePoint sites for the division.
  • Participate in division strategic planning and goal setting discussions and decisions. Work closely with the management team to understand business needs and identify future projects. Provide insight into business process strategies required to advance division initiatives.
  • Perform various administrative tasks, including draft reports and documents, PowerPoint presentations, and other supporting tasks.
  • Explore diverse perspectives and consistently behave sensitively toward differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds, and/or work styles.
  • Continually sustain the Inclusive Leadership Competencies (ILC) through the Explorer level on an annual basis.
Recommended qualifications:
  • Three or more years of experience in business analysis, data analysis, project coordination, or similar roles. Demonstrated ability to coordinate projects, support business process analysis, and effectively analyze and interpret data to clearly convey meaningful insights. Efficient in the use of Microsoft office tools and the ability to learn a variety of related software.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field.
  • Other combinations of skills and experience may be considered.

LATAM, Remote

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst Lead to join our team. This role involves leading and managing business analysis activities for Patient Support programs in the US, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering high-quality solutions

Job Description

You will be responsible for conducting comprehensive requirements gathering, analyzing business needs, and facilitating communication between stakeholders and the development team. Your expertise will ensure the successful delivery of patient support systems, focusing on product information, usage guidance, and insurance management.

Qualifications

Basic

  • Previous experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy, or Life Sciences industry
  • 5+ years of overall IT experience, including 3+ years as a systems analyst and 2+ years in application development

Preferred

  • 3+ years working for a healthcare provider, pharmaceutical company, or life sciences company
  • Salesforce Health Cloud project experience
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified Service/Sales Cloud Consultant
  • Experience with JIRA

Responsibilities

  • Lead and Manage Business Analysis Activities:
  • Lead and manage the business analysis activities within the project.
  • Coordinate with project stakeholders, including clients, developers, and other team members.
  • Ensure that the business analysis deliverables are completed on time and within scope.

Requirements Gathering and Analysis:

  • Conduct comprehensive requirements gathering through interviews, workshops, and surveys.
  • Analyze and document business requirements, ensuring they align with business objectives.
  • Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations.
  • Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and the development team.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and address any concerns promptly.

Documentation and Specifications:

  • Prepare detailed documentation, including business requirement documents (BRD), functional specifications, use cases, and user stories.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation.
  • Collaborate with the development team to design solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Validate the implemented solutions through testing and ensure they meet the documented requirements.

Testing and Validation:

  • Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) and obtain sign-off from stakeholders.
  • Identify areas for process improvement within the business analysis function and the overall project.
  • Implement best practices and methodologies to enhance project efficiency and quality.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead a team of business analysts, providing guidance and support.
  • Mentor junior business analysts and facilitate their professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and productive team environment.

Risk Management:

  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with business requirements and solution design.
  • Develop contingency plans to address potential issues.

Working Conditions

  • USD Monthly Payment
  • 100% remote opportunity
  • 10 business days of paid vacation per year (can be taken after 6 months in CT)
  • Up to 10 national holidays (either US or country of residence)
  • 5 days personal days off (can be taken after 3 months in CT)
  • Travel expenses covered when applicable
  • Referral program
  • Paid certification program
  • Personalized personal development plan (PDP)
  • Language platform

The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for ensuring that business requirements are documented, and every functional/business consideration is identified before implementing each project. This position must clearly understand and review/confirm with the client and internal departments before functional requirements are finalized - alternative approaches are suggested where viable. The Senior Business Analyst is also responsible for functional requirements that are completely documented and understood, along with innovative solutions with best practices identified and explored for most prevalent use cases. Consultant to business units and technical teams for detailed data availability, location, lineage, and quality. Works within the Development Life Cycle.

  • Ensures delivery according to project timelines. Coordinates with stakeholders to define go-live activities. Tracks progress performs follow-up communication, and documents resolutions to maintain project timelines. Analyzes possible impacts to the schedule for requested changes and makes updates as needed to the project timeline within reason.
  • Develops and executes presentations. Prepares and documents workgroup meetings and presentations. Facilitates meetings (in person and online) and conference calls to orient new clients, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and address concerns.
  • Works with the project manager to manage the project plan. Provides tasks, dates, and resource responsibilities based on the scope of the project. Provides statuses to work in progress and completed tasks.
  • Creates functional specifications. Collects, understands, and transmits business requirements for projects and translates into functional specifications, database designs, and detailed test plans.
  • Works with client to understand requirements. Partners with clients to gather all requirements to formulate business process specifications and translate those into application and/or operational functionality, understanding the value proposition(s) of the project and deciding when to advocate and when to compromise to arrive at mutually acceptable solutions.
  • Works with technical staff to translate requirements. Assists the technical team in translating application functionality into application architecture and the production of system functionality documents. Communicates business directives, goals, and needs to the technical team and serve as a client interface for managing user expectations and client satisfaction.
  • Works with operational business staff to translate requirements. Assists the operations team(s) in updating documentation and processes to accommodate the products offered. Communicates business directives, goals, and needs to the business team and serves as a client interface for managing user expectations and client satisfaction.
  • Manages development life cycle.
  • Creates and/or updates project documentation. Documents objectives, decisions, accomplishments, and deliverables for the work stream. Places documentation on the internal storage mechanism (Confluence) to provide a written account of the project activities.
  • Represents the business and/or project as the subject matter expert in the designated work stream.
  • Manages projects and processes as required.
  • Works with product team to stay abreast of overall product strategy, roadmap(s), and release management processes.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.
  • Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE

  • Five years of relevant experience as a business analyst in healthcare or health insurance, Medicare, and commercial business lines, or related industry.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and implement projects.
  • Demonstrated excellence in a rapid environment, with the ability to gather requirements, communicate product design requirements, and achieve high-quality results within specified timeframes.
  • Knowledge of, and the ability to apply, necessary software development practices and procedures.
  • Ability to apply the principles of independent logical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to comprehend the consequences of various problem situations and to refer them for appropriate decision making.
  • Ability to design program logic, prepares test data, and test programs.
  • Ability to review business requirements and compare to application for possible deviations from customer expectations.
  • Excellent triage, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with multi-functional teams to perform complex data analysis, data mapping and support a variety of business intelligence, reporting, analytical and data visualization needs.
  • Ability to make competent, independent decisions.
  • Experience working with mainstream BI reporting systems, ETL data integration platforms, and data modeling tools.
  • Thorough understanding of and ability to demonstrate the operational services.
  • Ability to create data flow diagrams and data models, including use case, activity, and workflow diagrams using VISIO.
  • Ability to convey pertinent information to operational and technical teams.
  • Strong presentation and analytical/problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in both a structured and unstructured environment.
  • Ability to support projects using a variety of project management methodologies (bimodal)
  • Ability to learn how to define all levels of business and technology requirements.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work with and empower others on a collaborative basis to ensure success of unit team.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed in an office setting with no unusual hazards.

Pay Range

Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $62,100 and $140,900.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is valued and we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment in any form. Candidates for the position stated above are hired on an "at will" basis. Nothing herein is intended to create a contract.

At Freddie Mac, you will do important work to build a better housing finance system and you’ll be part of a team helping to make homeownership and rental housing more accessible and affordable across the nation.

We will accept applications for this position until 10/4.

Position Overview:

Want to be part of technology that matters? Begin your technology career today by joining the Freddie Mac Enterprise Operations and Technology (EO+T) team through our College Hire program. The EO+T division is seeking true technologists to be part of our innovative organization. This 12-month cohort program designed for recent Information Technology/Information Systems/Business Information Technology or related technology grads will springboard you into a fulltime career with an industry leader building the future of technology for the housing/finance industry.

Our Impact:

The Enterprise Operations and Technology (EO+T) Division helps enable and transform Freddie Mac's business. We provide systems and technology that benefit the enterprise, customers, employees and our business partners. Our technology enhances the services we offer to our customers, and improves Freddie Mac's productivity, performance and security through use of innovative technology.

Your Impact:

What you’ll be doing -

Business Analyst

  • Serve as liaison between technology and business end-users

  • Elicit requirements from partners, translate, simplify and analyze the feasibility of requirements to promote business process enabling efficient design

  • Work with business owners and team leads to decompose large epics into manageable user stories. Develop mock-ups/wireframes, use cases, data visualizations, system requirements specification documents, user guides, and other supporting functional documents to support reviews and software release deliveries.

  • Lead project/team, facilitate cross-team coordination, tracking and following up on external dependencies

  • Develop project status dashboards, manage risks and impediments

  • Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications to partners

Participation in the program will support your continued professional development through access to targeted training courses and learning opportunities, as well as exposure to senior management. You will gain knowledge of technology for the financial industry all while enhancing your own competencies, by:

  • Expanding your leadership, business and analytical skills

  • Refining your personal brand and growing your internal network

  • Obtaining support and guidance from dedicated managers, experienced analysts and knowledgeable mentors

  • Deepening technological knowledge while learning about Freddie Mac’s key role in the mortgage market

  • Participating in organized community service events to complement your professional development with personal growth

  • Being eligible to be sponsored to earn key technical certifications

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, Business Analytics or related area, relevant experience and coursework

  • Experience with popular business tools (Windows, Microsoft Office, Visio, SharePoint, etc.)

  • Graduation no more than 18 months prior to January or June 2025 start date

  • Knowledge of Agile software development project methodologies preferred

  • Demonstrated analytical ability and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication

  • Organized, ability to meet deadlines, work independently, manage multiple priorities

  • Not quite sure you're a fit? Go ahead and apply! Freddie Mac's EO+T division looks for a wide range of skills and perspectives.

  • Ability to work effectively and productively in a team or independently

  • Willingness to try new things, fail fast and learn fast

Introduction

The Department of Corrections (DOC) is focused on public safety through the custody and supervision of those in our care. Corrections employees have the opportunity to positively impact the lives of others through careers in a variety of fields. Using cutting-edge research and evidence-based approaches, employees implement lasting change with a positive impact for the people of Wisconsin.
The Division of Management Services, Bureau of Technology Management is currently recruiting to fill an IT Business Analyst (IS Business Automation Senior) position. This position will be headquartered at the DOC central office in Madison, WI.
Position Summary

This position functions as a Business Analyst for commercial off-the-shelf solutions for Electronic Health Records (EHR) and other vendor applications (Oracle Health, Dentrix, and Clinical Reporting) for offender management. This position is central to understanding the DOC's division, bureau, and business needs and incorporating this understanding into developing and implementing third-party applications.
This position is also responsible for the assigned systems' complete system development life cycle, working extensively with vendors, customers, and technical staff. Scope of work includes working with vendors and business customers to create solution proposals, coordinate user acceptance testing, and provide application support to ensure appropriate application availability and efficient systems use. This position also provides technical support for resolving production defects promptly and efficiently, including extensive problem-solving of complex issues, root cause analysis, impact and risk assessment, and working with vendors and other technical resources to analyze options and recommend and implement solutions.

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in the United States (i.e., a citizen or national of the U.S., a lawful permanent resident, an alien authorized to work in the U.S. without DOC sponsorship) at the time of application. The Department of Corrections will conduct criminal background checks on applicants prior to selection to determine whether the circumstances of any conviction may be related to the job being filled. The Department of Corrections may conduct pre-employment drug screens. Any applicant who is offered employment in a position which requires a pre-employment drug screen must pass the screen as a contingency to employment. Applicants who fail or refuse the drug screen will not be given further consideration for employment.
Note: This position will be able to work 100% remotely but may be in the office as needed (first day will be in office to retrieve mobile equipment).

  • Experience collecting and analyzing business/user requirements, drawing conclusions, and recommending solutions.

In addition to the above, well well-qualified applicants will have:
  • Training and/or experience working with a Health Information Management (HIM) or Clinical Reporting (CR) system.

Permanent classified employees who are eligible for consideration as a transfer or voluntary demotion must complete the application process in order to be considered.

Your letter of qualification and resume should be limited to a maximum of two pages each.

Your submission will be evaluated by one or more job experts. The most eligible candidates will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. The Department of Corrections has created extra guidance to assist you in developing your resume and letter of qualification, if interested please click here .

Questions can be directed to Phia Vang, Human Resources Specialist at Phia.Vang@wisconsin.gov .

Current State employees are not eligible for non-competitive appointment.

Online application and materials must be submitted by 11:59 pm on 8/15/24, in order to be considered .

raw_job_description:
Overview

We are looking for an experienced technical data Analyst who is an expert at analytics methodologies as it relates to Gen AI for boosting analytics productivity and driving product data change management. We are enabling capabilities for data consumers and data producers and want the analyst to lead the development of customized solutions. We have an exciting opportunity to shape modern analytics, bringing together digital tools and GenAI LLMs to make a tangible impact on customer experience. If you have an excellent understanding of data architectures and the acumen to map the business needs to technology, analytical skills, and a passion for analytics solutioning, join us!

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience working with different data and analytics domains such as digital products, service operations, e-commerce marketplace, customer care, finance, and marketing.
  • Advanced proficiency in data modeling and mapping business needs into data design and modeling.
  • Drive the design, building, and launching of new data models and data pipelines in production with deep knowledge of ETL and data pipelines.
  • Experience influencing at senior leadership levels and driving cross-functional teams
  • Ability to simplify stories with data and be concise in the insights and how they drive outcomes with leadership and stakeholders
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and end-to-end, systems-oriented quantitative thinking
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and critical deadlines
  • Outstanding communication skills with both technical and non-technical colleagues
  • Proactive and inquisitive learner: seeks out and capitalizes on opportunities for change that enhance the business, rather than reacting to circumstances
  • Strong organization, time management, and task prioritization skills
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Finance, Advanced Analytics, a related field or equivalent work experience. Master’s Degree preferred

How you will lead

  • Discover and Execute on Opportunities for Automation: Partner closely with other technical data analysts, business analysts and engineers to lead a cross-functional roadmap spanning investments in tooling, customer experiences and scalable infrastructure resulting from deep empathy on user pain points.
  • Research and Solutioning for Change Management: You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a diverse toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them. You will convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations on the solutions. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner
  • Analytics Methodologies: You will synthesize learning and measurement plans for experiments and campaigns to define data collection requirements and identify opportunities to build durable components. By partnering with data engineering to scale and automate analytics on new products and initiatives, you will build solutions to drive discussions, facilitate decision-making, and provide actionable insights. You can identify the data needed for a business problem and ensure availability and quality of data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve.

Total Compensation Estimator Tool

Open Competitive Opportunity

This is a State-Wide Telework Position

This position serves as a Health Data Analyst for the EMS Community Health Care Program. This position Is a highly responsible and technical position requiring specific capabilities and skllls. This position speclflcally focuses on the use of demographic, health, and financial data to support the development and strategic growth of the EMS Community Health care Program pursuant to section 401.272, Florida Statutes.


Assist local EMS Agencies with the Interpretation of specified data for the purposes of planning, Implementing and enhancing local EMS Community Health Care programs.


This position serves as the liaison between the Community Paramediclne Program and the Office of Rural Health, Florida Rural Health Association, EMS providers and other specified community partners. Duties Include but are not limited to Identifying opportunities for data sharing.


Assists In the development of data collection strategies, methodologies and metrics relating to the evaluation of the economic and population health Impacts of EMS Community Health Care Program statewide.


Prepares data reports, summaries, and other written documentation of program activities required to support the EMS Community Healthcare Program. Examples of data sources used Include health, demographic and financial data.


Conducts continuous environmental scans of data sources or data driven research relating to EMS Community Healthcare or relatable programs.

Other duties as assigned Including providing assistance as needed in response to and recovery following natural or man-made disasters.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


  • Ability to analyze and organize statistical information to display results of data analyses in reports, charts, and graphs, using Microsoft Excel, Access, and/or Word, and ability to import/export data in various formats.

  • Ability to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, to interpret results of data analyses to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding of statistics and data, and ability to provide technical assistance to internal staff and external stakeholders on data-related issues.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and collaborative working relationships with others, both internally and externally.

  • Ability to work independently to plan, organize and complete work assignments.

  • Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects and assignments with rapid turnaround times.

Qualifications:

Work experience relating to public safety, public health, healthcare or Emergency Medical Services.


Perferred:

Associates degree or equivalent work experience relating to public safety, public health, healthcare or Emergency Medical Services.

Florida Driver’s License

Certified Florida Paramedic

State-Wide Telework Position

  • Nine paid holidays and one Personal Holiday each year;

(For more information, please click www.myfrs.com);

raw_job_description:
Job Description


Responsible for conceptualizing and creating advanced demand monitoring and customer behavior models; maintaining, enhancing, and improving the accuracy and effectiveness of existing model performance; providing consulting advice and tools to improve revenue management analyst performance and revenue maximization; and utilizing science models to support executive reporting and budget/revenue forecasting.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, enhance a variety of mathematical models (includes data collection, analysis, prototyping, testing, creation of production systems, and development of performance metrics)
  • Monitor model performance, re-calibrate, maintain, and recommend design enhancements.
  • Develop tools/reports for analysts and management to monitor business trends, forecasts, and customer behavior.
  • Aid upper management by way of ad hoc analyses to answer a variety of business-related questions
  • Consult/train analysts and management on use of science models and tools

Qualifications:

  • Minimum Education: Master’s Degree required
  • Discipline/Major: Quantitative discipline such as Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Math, Decision Sciences, or related field
  • Required Years and Area of Professional Experience: 7+ years’ experience preferred within a large corporation practicing revenue management or academic research on revenue management models and systems
  • Critical Professional Related Technical/Computer Skills: Experience in building mathematical models utilizing Data Mining/Operations Research/Statistics techniques, Proficient in SQL, Python, SAS/SPSS/R and Tableau desktop.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Self-starter who can work well across teams and move projects forward when information is incomplete or ambiguous with minimal guidance from the management team.
  • Ability to lead medium-to-large sized efforts across teams from inception to completion.
  • Ability to understand and build out the team’s analytical and technical framework in a way that efficiently and holistically supports performance objectives.
  • Ability to understand individual models as well as how those models interact across a variety of subject area.
  • Must demonstrate an ability to understand, analyze, and consider the interactions of various business variables, operational considerations, and data limitations in creating modeling that aligns with real-world behavior and allows users to draw insights, develop deeper understanding, and make better decisions that result in improved performance.
  • Ability to review modeling output against real-world behavior and make recommendations to manger, product management team, and senior-level leadership.
  • Ability to communicate sophisticated modeling concepts in easy-to-understand business terminology across various levels of users is important to the success of this role.
  • Ability to take on undefined business opportunities and develop analytical frameworks that create meaningful business context, deepen understanding of the business, create actionable opportunities, and propose solutions that are operationally feasible.
  • Ability to correctly define business problems, research and assess the effectiveness of various modeling approaches when given a specific business question, understand data limitations, anticipate downstream impacts, and create structure when existing structures do not already exist.

The range for this role’s salary $100,000-$135,000. Offers to the selected candidates will be made on a fair and equitable basis, taking into account specific job-related skills and experience.

  • Health Benefits:
    • Cost-effective medical, dental and vision plans
    • Employee Assistance Program and other mental health resources
    • Additional programs include company paid term life insurance and disability coverage
  • Financial Benefits:
    • 401(k) plan that includes a company match
    • Employee Stock Purchase plan
  • Paid Time Off
    • Holidays – All full-time and part-time with benefits employees receive days off for 7 company-wide holidays, plus an additional floating holiday to be taken at the employee’s discretion.
    • Vacation Time – All full-time employees at the manager and below level start with 14 days/year; director and above level start with 19 days/year. Part-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 84 hours/year. All employees gain additional vacation time with further tenure.
    • Sick Time – All full-time employees receive 80 hours of sick time each year. Part-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 60 hours each year.
  • Other Benefits
    • Complementary stand-by cruises, employee discounts on confirmed cruises, plus special rates for family and friends
    • Personal and professional learning and development resources including tuition reimbursement
    • On-site preschool program, wellness center, and health clinic at our Miami campus

Job Summary/Overview

The Master Data Analyst will play a key role in creating, maintaining and governing several of the company’s business systems and related master data. They will work hand in hand with Operations, Product Management and Engineering to setup and maintain master data records.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support and create accurate and effective master data standards, analysis, audits, processes and data maintenance strategies.
  • Responsible for the support and implementation of business strategies and roadmap of local master data initiatives.
  • Analyze, maintain, and enhance master data on various domains across the organization.
  • Work with business stakeholders to insure data consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.
  • Manage data and analytics projects at various levels of complexity and proactively communicate risks, issues, and status to leadership and key stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills, Competencies, and Abilities

  • Proficient at Microsoft Excel; PowerQuery and PowerBI proficiency preferred.
  • Excellent problem solving, analytical, creative, and communication skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Previous knowledge of SAP at user level is preferred.
  • Previous experience with ERP/ MRP systems data in a manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Knowledge of master data management concepts and approaches.
  • Able to plan, organize, and budget.
  • Able to work in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Possesses strong attention to detail and accuracy with excellent follow-through.
  • Able to work under pressure with multiple deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant technical area required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years working with master data or other database type solutions.

Responsible for conducting research and root cause analysis for customers with the goal of recommending and implementing new processes and solutions to operational deficiencies.   • Develop forecasting tools using current technology/systems (Access, Excel, Monarch, etc.)
  • Translate business requirements and assist IT with the development of technical specifications.
  • Develop solutions based on data analysis to increase business efficiency.
  • Lead or participate in internal and external project workgroup(s) and presentations.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for projects, implementations, system fixes and enhancements, etc.

Craftsman Technology Group is an employee-owned firm that supports mission-driven organizations. Our work spans community and economic development, community health, arts and historical institutions, and organizations fostering inclusive communities. We believe technology can be an effective vehicle for change.

  • Our mission: to help nonprofit organizations grow and thrive.

  • Our values: be transparent and honest; be fair and accountable; be independent and objective; and be good to our staff, our communities, and the world.

We are seeking a Business Analyst (BA) to join our Professional Services team who will bring these same values and passion to help nonprofit organizations. A BA is a client-facing full-time salaried intermediate-level position.

Job Summary:

In this forward-looking role, you will assist our nonprofit clients in defining workflows, requirements, and solutions for their Salesforce instance while meeting their holistic needs. You will participate in project discovery, design, configuration, training, and documentation with the goal of delivering an on-time and on-budget project. In this position, you will strengthen your existing skills in developing and configuring the tools and technology at the core of our clients' solutions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Understand clients' needs and facilitate their setting of project goals and objectives

  • Translate business process needs into actionable technical requirements

  • Facilitate client meetings efficiently

raw_job_description:
Under the limited leadership of the Immunization Unit Director, the Data Analyst IV will perform highly advanced data analysis and provide recommendations to the Texas Vaccine for Children (VFC) programs and relating to Public Health Informatics. The candidate must possess a strong epidemiology and biostatistics background which demonstrates expertise in data collection, data collation, data analysis, trend analysis and producing actionable recommendations based on data. This position serves as a Team Lead for a dynamic team of public health professionals to include Research and Program Specialists within the Texas VFC program. The Data Analyst IV provides advanced (senior-level) research, analysis, and guidance of Immunization Unit work by planning, conducting, and reporting on projects for the VFC program. The ideal candidate is experienced in program and data evaluation utilizing multiple methods of data collection and analyses. Experienced in working with large data sets, health and immunization-related data, and programming languages such as SAS and SQL.


Essential Job Functions:
Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.

(35%) Serves as Team Lead for group of Research and Program Specialists responsible for continuous assessment of VFC data quality validation, data quality assurance, data integrity, and coordinating and liaising with various disease programs who contribute data feeds to the Texas VFC Program. Reviews and validates all the statistical logics involved in data cleaning and management process to ensure consistency, integrity, and accuracy of data. Oversees the development, update, and maintenance of data dictionaries, data quality assurance documentation, and data management guidelines. Responsible for designing evaluation plans including development of evaluation designs, goals and objectives, project timelines, and instruments. Support visualization of data using various approaches to enable identification of inconsistent data patterns and data quality concerns and for public health results reporting. Oversees data documentations, protocols, analytic plans, reports, manuscripts and presentation of study findings applying epidemiologic methods and best practices in public health science. Provides guidance and appropriate training to epi team and ensures epi team are informed on latest guidance.

(25%) Works in cohesion with staff from other areas of the Immunization Unit, DSHS, HHSC and with staff from local and regional health departments. Assists in running statewide proficiency tests and provides feedback to stakeholders. Assists in leading communications between epidemiology and research teams within the Immunization Unit. Contributes to the development of data standards, addressing privacy and data reliability concerns, as well as playing an active role in agency-wide data integration projects. Represents the VFC program on committees, workgroups, and projects to meet research and data analysis needs. Represents the state at the national level on research and data analysis issues. Applies the principles and methods of Biostatistics to provide a Public Health component of grant proposals and progress reports.

(20%) Oversees and contributes to Public Health reports useful to DSHS staff, the public, public health, and medical communities. Assists, directs, conducts or participates in financial and budget studies as it relates to the cost of Vaccine Preventable Diseases. Performs statistical analyses using advanced statistical software, interprets results, and writes articles, and reports. Analyzes data and proposes Public Health studies based upon data gathered through VFC projects and studies. Ensures appropriate communication and dissemination of findings and recommendations. Develops and implements new policies, protocols, and practices within the VFC program for quality assessment of the data accessed to ensure that scientific and standardized systems and processes are implemented uniformly across the Unit.

(15%) Serves as resource data analyst/consultant and provides scientific/technical expertise to the VFC program and other areas in DSHS, other agencies, and/or the public in matters related to epidemiology and Biostatics. Prepares written manuscripts for publication in peer review journals. Using PowerPoint and other presentation tools, prepares and conducts oral presentations on infectious disease topics and outbreak response plans to various audiences. Assists in the preparation of summary reports for distribution to local and regional health departments.

(5%) Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency's obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.


Knowledge Skills Abilities:
  • Knowledge of reportable disease/health related information systems.

  • Knowledge of SAS, SQL, Tableau, ArcGIS, HL7 messaging and interfaces.

  • Knowledge of statistics and analyzing data sets; of running queries, report writing, and presenting findings.

  • Knowledge of data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.

  • Knowledge of record keeping, including security procedures for handling, protecting, and distributing confidential data.

  • Knowledge of epidemiology, medical or public health informatics, and immunization data.

  • Skill in analyzing problems and devising effective solutions.

  • Skill in conducting data searches, in evaluating and translating large amounts of data.

  • Skill in critical thinking for problem solving.

  • Skill in multitasking priorities.

  • Ability to compile, review, and analyze data.

  • Ability to prepare reports, to maintain accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Ability to lead, mentor, and provide guidance to other staff.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

  • Ability to develop and analyze measuring instruments with respect to reliability, relevance, and validity.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships and work with others as part of a team.


    • Registration or Licensure Requirements:
    None


    Initial Selection Criteria:
  • Master’s Degree or equivalent with two (2) years of direct experience in applied public health informatics.

  • Knowledge or experience with VFC data or similarly related health data.

  • Experience working with large relational databases in manipulating, analyzing and visualizing data sets.

  • Experience using including Microsoft Word, Excel (including VBA), Access, PowerPoint, Outlook, SQL, SAS, and other relevant software applications.



    • Additional Information:
    An in-basket exercise will be required at the time of the interview.

    Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. HHS agencies use E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work.

    Safe operation of either a state-owned vehicle or personal vehicle is required to conduct state business and an acceptable driving record must be maintained in accordance with DSHS Policy OS-3901, Fleet Operations and Management and Procedures and standards developed by the Texas Department of Public Safety.

    MOS Code:
    68S, 60C, HM, 230X, 4E0X1, 43HX, 43MX, 43EX

    HHS agencies use E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work.


    In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview.

About MVM, Inc.
Service, Support, Success are the pillars upon which MVM’s founders built the company, and they continue to serve as MVM’s core values. Along with our uncompromising insistence on integrity and ethical business practices, these values make us the service provider of choice for our customers and the employer of choice for our dedicated team members.

Working at MVM, Inc. takes a certain kind of person; we want someone who identifies with our values and is willing to challenge themselves both personally and professionally. We seek employees who are passionate about serving and making a difference in lives of others.
We’re looking to add a Business Analyst.
If you can envision joining a team where you will have the opportunity to provide mission driven results; then we are looking for you!
Job Summary:
The Business Analyst will work closely with MVM’s corporate personnel, program managers, and stakeholders to strategize ideas to improve business processes, develop cost benefit analysis recommendations and support implementation of improvements across operations. This role is remote.
Essential Functions:
  • Serve as an integral team member supporting the culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence throughout the company.
  • Collaborate across business managers and decision makers through interviews, observation, and facilitated working sessions to identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to review, evaluate, and propose new business solutions to improve operations, contract performance, business value and customer satisfaction.
  • Perform program audits, root cause analysis, gap analysis, and/or process mapping to streamline processes and resolve inefficiencies and operational issues.
  • Conduct cost benefit analysis projects to identify cost saving opportunities without jeopardizing operational excellence or customer service.
  • Oversee the analysis and business need for new technology and systems; Persuade internal and external stakeholders of the benefits of new technology or strategies.
  • Employ appropriate methodologies of problem solving to assist management teams in realizing and implementing solutions to solve problems.
  • Support the business in honing or establishing “best practices” and work with business managers to ensure policies, processes and procedures are updated and aligned.
  • Monitor the completion of tasks and project timelines and assist company executives in documenting and communicating program performance.
  • Conduct risk assessments of processes and tasks in the company.
  • Coordinate with different departmental teams to improve business operations, streamline processes and develop effective implementation plans to affect change.
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Qualifications:
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, finance, change management, project management or a related field OR at least 5 years’ experience in a related field.
  • 2-3 years’ experience as a business analyst, technical writer, project manager, or a related field.
  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • The ability to influence stakeholders, listen actively, and work closely with program owners to develop acceptable solutions.
  • Requires clear, strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with different departments, employees, multiple levels of management, and clients.
  • Must be committed to providing outstanding customer service.
  • Excellent documentation and technical writing skills.
  • Experience creating detailed reports and giving presentations.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, SharePoint, and Outlook. Visio preferred.
  • Familiar with analytical reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Knowledge of technology and an understanding of how technology can be used to implement process improvement and solve problems.
  • Self-starter with excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Produces high-quality deliverables with strong attention to detail.
  • Desired prior experience working with government contracts.
  • Desired Lean Six Sigma, Project Management Professional (PMP), ITIL Certification OR similar certification
Clearance:
  • Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment.
Security Requirements:
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Security Clearance.
  • Favorable credit check for all cleared positions.
  • Successfully pass a background investigation, drug screen.
  • US Citizenship
Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:
Consider into account the position at hand (i.e., lifting, pushing and pulling won’t be very necessary). Percentages should be modified to reflect the necessity for each position.
Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees.
Traveling: 10% - 20%
Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time.
Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time, must be able to lift up to 40 lbs.
Fine Motor Skills/Dexterity: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time.
Sitting: Sitting for prolonged and extended periods of time.
This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may revise duties as necessary without updating this job description.
We Offer…
  • Paid training, fun, talented and driven teammates
  • Knowledgeable, encouraging and present leadership
  • A diverse and community-minded organization
  • Career growth and learning opportunities for aspiring minds
  • A competitive benefits package, and fosters a highly skilled, energized and empowered workforce.
If you have what it takes, apply now!!
For more information about the company please visit our website at
www.mvminc.com
MVM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.
